textBlocks: It’s our 5th birthday and we’re ready to celebrate with you all! Welcome to Patch 6.3, Gilded Glory.

Welcome to Patch 6.3, Gilded Glory. We’re pouncing into this update ready to watch Worlds 2025 unfold and celebrate our 5th Anniversary! We’re so excited to celebrate 5 years together with you all. Thank you for playing and supporting Wild Rift and always sharing your feedback, hype clips, fanart, and more with us. You make the Rift what it is today. Now, let’s dive into all the goodies the team has planned for Patch 6.3!
 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 NIDALEE, THE BESTIAL HUNTRESS

 Raised in the deepest wilderness, Nidalee is a master tracker who can shapeshift into a ferocious pakaa jungle cat at
	will. Neither wholly woman nor beast, she viciously defends her territory from any and all trespassers, with
	carefully placed traps and deft spear throws. She cripples her quarry before pouncing on them in feline form—the
	lucky few who survive tell tales of a wild woman with razor-sharp instincts, and even sharper claws...

 Nidalee will be released on October 23 at 00:01 UTC.

 NEW SEASON

 Welcome to S19 Ranked Season! Prove yourself victorious throughout the ranks and earn this season’s ranked skin,
	Glorious Aigrette Nilah. The S19 Season will begin on October 24, 2025, at 08:00 (CST) and will end in January 2026.

 NEW WILD PASS

 New patch, new Wild Pass! Starting on October 23, 2025, at 00:01 UTC, you’ll be able to go down the rabbit hole and
	earn Wondertown Vex, Ascended Wondertown Vex, and an array of other marvelous goodies! Check out some of the goodies
	you can earn:

 Added the new Battle Ensign - Wondertown Vex and Wondertown series exclusive Emote [Perfect Score].

 Added Comeback skins: Psychic Detective Senna, Soda Pop Ahri, Ascended Soda Pop Ahri, Food Spirits Veigar,
 Ascended Food Spirits Veigar, Food Spirits Yuumi, Food Spirits Yuumi Frenzy of Tastes, Blackfrost Renekton.

 Added [Mini Pass Comeback Skin Track]: Blackfrost Renekton. This Comeback Track shares level progression with
 the Wild Pass Track of the season. Level up your Wild Pass level to simultaneously unlock rewards from both the
 Wild Pass Track and Mini Pass Track.

 NEW FEATURES

 Gilded Glory Patch theme

 Are you ready to claim your glory? We hope so, because the gates to glory are now open. The golden resolve of
 warriors ages past now burns eternal, illuminating the path for you to achieve your peak glory.

 Collect Golden Resolve to unlock hidden treasures! Complete matches to gather enough Golden Resolve and open
 treasure for rewards. There's even some exclusive chromas waiting to be claimed.

 There are grand event rewards awaiting for you! As the "Hero's Return" Event arrives, a flood of treasures will
 overflow! Log in during the event to receive generous rewards.

 The latest updates and more patch content are waiting for you, come play the Gilded Glory and see what's waiting
 for you!

 Apex Pass

 The Apex Pass will officially begin on October 25, 2025, at 00:01 UTC, featuring the brand-new skin, Inspiring
 Jarvan IV. This is the 2025 World Championship exclusive skin. Please note, this skin will not return for at
 least a year after its initial release. It will be priced at 500 Orange Gemstones.

 Upgrading your Pass will grant you “Apex Medallions”, the 2025 Worlds event currency, which can be used in the
 Collected Legends Limited Store to exchange for Inspiring Jarvan IV chromas and other special Worlds-themed
 rewards.

 Please note: After the season ends, any unused “Apex Medallions” will be automatically reclaimed and converted
 1:1 into Blue Motes.

 Collected Legends

 A new season of the Collected Legends is here with exclusive Rewards!

 Multiple Omega Squad Veigar exclusive chromas and limited Companion evolve items are now available.

 The World Championship Redeem Store is open for a limited time!

 Legendary Skin Selection Chests, exclusive chromas, and other high-value items will be available for a limited
 time only! From October 25, 2025, until the end of the season.

 We’ve also added one-click reward claims and other optimizations, so claiming your rewards are easier than
 ever

 There's also a new Mini Pass Return Track:

 Skins Pengu Cosplay Tristana and Dark Star Malphite, along with their related items, will soon be removed from
 the exchange store, redeem them while you can! They may return periodically in the future.

 New Player Login - Quick Start

 We’ve upgraded the account system! New players can now start playing immediately without registration. Existing
 players’ account data will remain unaffected and can log in as usual.

 Main Mode Champion score entrance

 Added a champions Follow feature. Players can follow their favorite champions, making the main mode interface
 display only those selected champions.

 Champion Score Protection

 In Ranked or Legendary Ranked, if a Champion’s score has reached the highest value for the current rank, you
 will now receive one Champion Score Protection.

 During this protection, losses will not deduct Champion Score.

 New “Random Skin” Feature

 During champion select, if a champion has two or more skins, you can now enable Random Skin Mode. Once
 activated, all owned skins for that champion will rotate randomly in preview, and one random skin will be
 selected for the match. There will even be a chance to trigger a special Easter egg!

 Floating Damage Text System

 We’ve noticed that current floating combat text does not clearly reflect actual damage impact, affecting your ability
	to judge key moments. To improve clarity, we’re making the following adjustments:

 Dynamic Size Adjustment: Floating text now scales dynamically with damage value and target level. High damage
 against low-level targets will appear more prominently.

 New Damage Type Icon: A new “Bonus Ability Damage” icon has been added. The “Critical” icon now appears only for
 crits, while extra ability damage uses its own symbol.

 Smite Bonus Damage now merges correctly in floating text.

 Overall, we hope these improvements will provide more clarity and make it easier for you to reach key combat
	information during fights.

 New “New Loadout” Tag Feature

 During the Ban/Pick phase, when a “Loadout Updated” message appears, you will now see a “New Loadout” tag in the
 Popular Loadout tab so you can quickly identify and apply the latest recommended setups.

 New “One-Click Replacement” Feature in Loadout

 Detects if Support roles are missing support items and recommends suitable builds.

 Detects if Jungle roles are missing Smite and suggests jungle builds.

 Recommends switching between Armor Boots and Magic Resistance Boots depending on enemy team comp you’re up
 against.

 OPTIMIZATIONS

 Ranked Mode Flow Optimization

 Reduced duration of some phases.

 Improved champion select with new recommendation tabs and filters.

 Added utility card usage reminders during selection.

 Single-Player Mode Optimization

 Renamed Single-Player Mode to Champion Training. You can now earn proficiency and Champion score while
 practicing.

 Vs AI Mode merged into Champion Training (original entry retained).

 These updates will now make it easier for you to practice new Champions more freely.

 Title System Overhaul

 The Title and Achievement systems have been merged into the Profile → Honor tab.

 Differentiated in-lobby and in-game title display and preview operations.

 Improved primary/secondary title selection flow.

 Added adaptive in-game title assignment, allowing champions with owned titles to automatically equip them in
 battle.

 Added title acquisition guidance.

 Self-Selection Chest Opening Experience Optimization

 Future Self-selection Chests will support batch opening, with improved filtering and sorting, making it easier
 to locate your desired rewards.

 New Champion Voice Lines

 To enrich in-game storytelling and show off more of our champion’s personalities, we’ve added new voice lines
 for several champions and skins, including voice previews during the ban phase for all champions. Check them out
 and let us know what you think!

 EVENTS

 FIFTH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION

 Happy Birthday… to us! We’re turning 5 and to celebrate we’re giving you a bunch of goodies! Thank you for playing
	our game and making Wild Rift what it is today.

 Fifth Anniversary Celebration will begin on October 23 at 00:01 UTC

 NIDALEE LANDS IN THE RIFT!

 Pounce, prowl, and take over the Rift! Celebrate this feisty feline's arrival onto the Rift.

 Nidalee Lands In The Rift! event will begin on October 23 at 00:01 UTC

 We’ve also made some optimizations to Senna’s Controls. When Senna performs a basic attack, it will not be interrupted by other abilities. After the basic attack ends, the ability cast will then trigger.

ITEMS

BATTLEFEST SEASON 3

 New Gameplay

 Stats Anvil

 Currently available only in the following Adventure modes: ARAM, URF / ARURF, Unbound Frenzy, Ultimate Spellbook,
	Doublecast, and Arena

 Let’s stack stats! Choose the attribute playstyle you are best at and let your opponents feel your overwhelming
 late-game powerspike!

 In certain Modes, a new “Anvil” tab will appear in the store. Players can spend 850 Gold to purchase it. Once
 purchased, a three-choice stat selection will appear in the upper-right corner of the screen - choose one to
 empower your champion! You can also pre-purchase, and once you have enough gold, the Forge will be bought
 automatically! Additionally, there is a small chance to trigger an Easter egg after purchasing, granting you a
 free anvil!

 Daredevil’s Gambit

 Welcome, Daredevils! Feeling risky? We offer a fully random champion selection option. Once chosen, the Champion
 cannot be swapped, but you will receive extra in-game benefits: an additional Anvil at the start and a discount
 on the Anvil’s price!

 In Self-Select Modes, five highly popular champions will also be randomly added to the selection pool. Choosing
 one of them grants a free Anvil at the start of the game!

 Prismatic Anvil

 As the number of Anvils increases, the quality of obtainable Anvils will also rise. There’s a chance to obtain
 the highest-tier Prismatic Anvil, which could grant utility cards that increase anvil efficiency, items
 mechanics or Anvil Core: which provides a percentage increase to all Anvil Stats!

 Gameplay Adjustments

 Unbound Frenzy

 New Champions

 Six new champions are joining Unbound Frenzy this time! What kind of mischief and changes will they bring this
	patch?

 Poppy

 Allies can help pick up her shield, her 1st ability creates a wall, her 3rd ability stuns enemies when
 colliding, her ultimate can now be freely aimed and, after the initial knock-up, slams enemies down for a second
 knock-up.

 Bard

 Bard can collect more chimes; his 1st ability continues flying after hitting a target, his 2nd ability’s effects
 are doubled, his 3rd ability can freely place portals, his ultimate now stasis-heals allies, and recasting it
 removes his own stasis.

 Kayle

 Upgrading Kayle’s ultimate evolves her basic abilities. Each attack applies a portion of the evolved ability’s
 effects.

 Garen

 Garen’s attacks generate whirlwinds, his 1st ability leaps and strikes enemies while reducing their Armor and
 Magic Resistance, his ultimate generates a massive whirlwind when he defeats an enemy champion.

 Gwen

 Gwen’s 1st ability gains enhanced effects within her 2nd ability’s zone, her 2nd ability can follow multiple
 movements, and attacks extend its duration, her 3rd ability can be cast multiple times, gaining stacking attack
 buffs, and her ultimate creates a field where needles refract.

 Irelia

 Irelia’s 1st ability deals area damage, her 2nd ability marks hit targets, her 3rd ability triggers multiple

 AAA ARAM

 Welcome to ARAM: Golden Legend Season! The Augments selection interface has been completely redesigned and now
	features a Golden Legend theme inspired by the Worlds 2025! In this season, many highly requested Augment cards are
	returning, along with brand-new additions. Like our special pro players’ exclusive Legendary Augments. Join your
	favorite pro players and play the newly upgraded AAA ARAM together!

 Starting Time

 Starting from this patch, AAA ARAM will be available simultaneously with the new season after each patch update
 and will remain available until a day before the season ends. Giving you and your friends even more time to
 queue up and play!

 New Augments

 This update introduces over 20 brand-new Augments. Some Augments have been upgraded to Legendary Augments, featuring
	unique pro player buffs, new Augment art, and even exclusive bonuses. Ever wanted to re-create Faker’s iconic Zed
	play? Now you can with the Legendary Augments! Make sure to try them all out, we’ve hidden some special easter eggs
	in a few. Additionally, after you obtain the special Augment “Champion Trophy,” you’ll gain one free refresh of your
	current three Augment Card selections. For full Augment effects and details, please check the Augment Archive
	in-game.

 Augment Comeback and Rotations

 Several popular Augments from previous patches have returned, including: Fury Aura, Magic Missile, Vanish, and the

textBlocks: Welcome to patch 6.2k! We’ve been keeping an eye on how the meta has been shaping up and we have a few adjustments to some outlier champions who have been dominating the Rift.

Welcome to patch 6.2k! We’ve been keeping an eye on how the meta has been shaping up and we have a few adjustments to some outlier champions who have been dominating the Rift.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

CHAMPION CHANGES
 This patch, Talon is swooping in with his claws even sharper than before as we’re giving his ultimate a little extra damage to help him be more of an assassin. We’ve also noticed that Olaf has been a little too hard to deal with in lane, so we’re adjusting some of his damage scaling, so he’s more in-line as a late-game champion. We’re also de-bugging the bug, Kha’Zix. We’ve nerfed his damage and increased his cooldowns, so that he stops evolving into such a menace on the Rift. Aurora’s early-game has been a little too strong, so we’re reducing some of her damage so that she doesn’t steamroll her foes in lane as much. And lastly, we’re slicing down some of Yone’s jungle prowess and tankiness.

textBlocks: Caw caw! Swain’s rework is making its arrival, along with some balance updates.

On the other hand, we also want Hecarim to gallop into those dives and teamfights, so we’re giving him some help. Additionally, we’re making some adjustments to Ezreal and Ryze, while also helping Seraphine hit a higher note with more balanced flexibility. And last but not least, Blitzcrank is getting some adjustments so some of the shock from his engages will be, well…less shocking .

At the same time, we’ve reworked parts of how his ability feels and numbers to ensure his power remains consistent across different builds, while still leaving room for counterplay. textBlocks: This patch we’re striking a balance between revving up some of our underperformers and cooling off the overachievers. Welcome to Patch 6.2e!

They say summer changes everyone. One minute you’re laning like always, thinking the game will never change, then suddenly, the tide shifts. Buffs start to roll in like heatwaves from the hottest summer you experienced as a kid, knocking the breath right out of you and nerfs hit you like those surprise summer thunderstorms you and your friends get caught in on the way back to the beach.

 Everything feels different in the summer… even the Rift. The meta’s getting a shake up, careful adjustments to bring harmony back to the chaos of clash and carry. And yeah, summer’s not a summer without a little glow-up. The Summer Party skins have also arrived and they’re bringing poolside charm and breezy confidence to the Rift.

It’s time to fall in love with your mains, your matchups, and maybe even the Rift again. Queue up and enjoy the salt air, summer breeze while taking down your enemies.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

CHAMPION CHANGES

 This patch we’re striking a balance between revving up some of our underperformers and cooling off the overachievers. Champs that thrive in the early game like Urgot, Viego, and Pantheon will be getting a surge of power to help boost their tempo. While those who have been performing a little tooo well like Rammus, Ashe, Varus, and Karma we’re putting on ice and telling them it’s time to chill out. These changes should clear some of the fog on the Rift and cause a fairer fight across all roles.

textBlocks: This patch we’re zeroing in on sharpening some champion identities and adjusting their power curves across all stages of the game. As well as nerfing some champions who have been dominating the game. Welcome to Patch 6.2c!

Dearest Patch Note Readers,

 We’ve opened the curtains and invited you to the event of the season, the illustrious Crystal Rose Gala. We hope you’ve enjoyed seeing everyone shine and sparkle, but while this event takes place, we can’t help but notice certain champions are on the Rift, causing mischief, while others seem to need a helping hand.

 Fear not though readers, for change is in the air. In this latest installment, known as Patch 6.2c, the balance of power is being artfully addressed by our developers. We’re polishing up some identities, and for those who have been dominating the Rift…well, they’ll be finding their reign gracefully curtailed.

 So, stretch your thumbs and prepare to tap into a patch of adjustments most fair.

 ~Wild Rift Balance Team

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

CHAMPION CHANGES

 This patch we’re zeroing in on sharpening some champion identities and adjusting their power curves across all stages of the game. Scaling champions like Nasus, Senna, Kalista, Jinx and Twitch are getting a lift. So, you can expect more late game bite from your favorite dog in the Baron Lane and some extra excitement from Jinx when she nabs those kills. We’re also making sure champions that are supposed to be strong in the early game, like Jayce, Vi, and Kha’Zix, are packing enough punch so they can successfully jump scare their foes in the jungle. Lastly, we’re also nerfing Ambessa, Corki and Kayle, since they’ve been dominating the Rift.

We’re grooooovin’ right on into Patch 6.2b. We’ve made a handful of balance changes, the return of AAA ARAM, Arena, ARURF as well as the launch of Space Groove Lux!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 GAME MODES
 AAA ARAM

AAA ARAM is back, and better than ever! To learn more about the AAA ARAM updates this patch read our recent Rift Report here .

 AAA ARAM will be available to play from July 31 00:01 UTC until October 22 00:01 UTC

 ARENA

 Along with AAA ARAM, Arena is returning too! Grab a friend and prove you’re the best of the best.

 Arena will be available to play from August 1 00:01 UTC until October 22 00:01 UTC

 ARURF

 All the fast pace action is back, this time with a dash of extraness!

 ARURF will be available to play from August 1 00:01 UTC until August 14 00:01 UTC

CHAMPION CHANGES
 This patch we’re packing a punch and a few pricks. Sett’s been hitting the gym and is beefed up and ready to throw it down even harder, especially during the laning phase. Talon is sharpening his blades to slice through his foes with more ease. You’ll also notice that Zyra’s damage is a little less thorny in lane, but we’re keeping her rooted in strengths. And last but not least, Singed is being slowed down. He’ll need more than just a trail of poison to breeze through the early game.

Since the nerf to Shield of Durand, AP builds on Galio have dominated. We're aiming to bring AP Tank builds back into the spotlight. Galio’s max health now contributes more to Shield of Durand’s damage reduction, and its effectiveness has been improved at close range. Additionally, Galio can now trigger his passive more to maximize its impact. We believe these changes will give Galio greater build flexibility and help him return to his role as a true mage-slaying sentinel.

textBlocks: We’re hot off the tails of our big 6.2 update! We made a lot of changes, so we’re following up with some needed balance changes.

Patch 6.2 brought a lot of new changes to the game. The team has been keeping a close eye on how all the changes have shaken up the meta and are delivering some balance changes to bring some champions back in line. Lets dive in!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW

 EMULATOR UPDATE

 Starting in Patch 6.2, Wild Rift will no longer support the use of emulators.

CHAMPION CHANGES

textBlocks: Aurora makes her arrival, marksmen get some sharp updates, our Player Behavior System is here, and soooo much more! Welcome to Patch 6.2

Tonight, on Wild Rift:

A brand-new arrival steps onto the scene. Aurora’s here, and she’s bringing more than just icy vibes. We’ve got a fresh ranked season, a marksman glow-up, and gameplay pace changes that’ll keep you on your toes faster than a surprise text.

But that’s not all, we’re also launching our new Summer Party skins, and our brand-new Player Behavior system is finally here! And let’s just say, good behavior has never looked this good.

Stick around, because this patch? It’s full of twists, turns, and quality of life updates that will make your head turn.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 NEW CHAMPIONS
 AURORA, THE WITCH BETWEEN WORLDS

 From the moment she was born, Aurora navigated life with a unique ability to move between the spirit and material realms. Determined to learn more about the spirit realm's inhabitants, she left her home to further her research and happened upon a wayward demigod who'd become twisted and lost to time. Witnessing his desperation, Aurora resolved to find a way to help her feral friend regain his forgotten identity—a journey that would take her to the farthest reaches of the Freljord.

 Aurora will be released on July 17 at 00:01 UTC.
 NEW FEATURES
 PLAYER BEHAVIOR SYSTEM
 With the launch of Patch 6.2, we’re introducing our first-ever Player Behavior System. To learn more about the new system, check out our in-depth article here .

RANKED SEASON 18

 We’re gearing up for the next season of ranked! You’ll be able to queue up for Season 18 of Ranked on July 18 at 03:00 UTC to earn this season's reward, Glorious Aigrette Galio. This season will end in October 2025, but please keep an eye on the Ranked interface for exact details.

 WILD PASS

 Fall down the rabbit hole with our latest Wild Pass, starring Wondertown Lillia and its upgraded version, Ascended Wondertown Lillia. Additionally, with this patch, we’re making a few updates to the Wild Pass, with better rewards and a more refined experience. Some of the other goodies you can earn in this Wild Pass are:
 New Battle Ensign Wondertown, Wondertown-themed emote.
 If you collect all the Wondertown theme items in the pass you’ll unlock an exclusive emote, Jumping For Joy, for free.

 Returning skins include: Supervillain Jhin, Ascended Supervillain Jhin, Supervillain Graves, Ascended Supervillain Graves, Superhero Vi, Ascended Superhero Vi, Hexplorer Shyvana, and Dragonslayer Kayle.

 We’ve optimized some of the missions that will help you level up your pass even faster:
 Increased mission XP Gains: Earn more XP per mission for faster leveling.

 Simplified Task Requirements: Lower difficulty and shorter completion time for a smoother experience.

 Broader Applicability: Mission designs are now compatible with all game modes.

 Redundant Missions Removed: Tasks like dragon/Baron kills, fruit collection, and forced lane/role assignments have been permanently removed.

 Optimized Mission Structure: Fewer total tasks, with increased XP per mission.

 Additionally, we’ve improved the returning skin experience:
 Treasure Chest Upgraded: Wild Pass Treasure Chest now becomes the “Wild Pass Trove.” After reaching the guaranteed draw threshold, you’ll now be able to directly select a desired skin as your final reward.

 New [Mini Pass Returning Skin Track]: Dragonslayer Kayle will be featured in the “Mini Pass Returning Skin Track,” which shares level progress with the current Wild Pass. By leveling up, players can simultaneously unlock rewards in both tracks.

 There is also a new bundle when you go to purchase your Wild Pass (Wild Pass & Mini Pass combo bundle):
 This bundle grants all core rewards from:
 The current Elite Version of the Wild Pass.

 The Elite Version of the upcoming Mini Pass (including its featured skin and chromas) . Note: The bundle includes Mini Pass discounts by default; additional coupons cannot be applied.

 Lastly, the “Battlecast” Mini Pass:
 After Wondertown ends, the new “Battlecast” Mini Pass featuring Battlecast Urgot and his chroma Battlecast Urgot (Black) will be available starting September 19, 2025.

 The Mini Pass will feature its own level progression, exclusive rewards, and task system. Wild Star Usage: Wild Stars can be used in both the Wild Pass and Mini Pass while active. Unused stars will be reclaimed after the Mini Pass ends.

 EVENTS
 AURORA LANDS IN THE RIFT!
 Everyone’s favorite magical champion has finally hopped on over to our Rift! Celebrate her arrival!

 Aurora Lands In The Rift will begin on July 17 at 00:01 UTC
 AURORA’S RUNETERRA ADVENTURE
 Aurora’s here, but now she’s ready to go on an adventure! Join her on her journey and have the chance to earn a special skin for free, Star Guardian Jinx: Exquisite Edition.

 Aurora’s Runeterra Adventure will begin on July 24 at 00:01 UTC
 ADVENTURE MODES
 SPELLBOOK ARAM
 We’re bringing back Spellbook ARAM with some new changes! Read about them more later in the Patch Notes!

 Spellbook ARAM will be available to play from July 18 at 00:01 UTC until July 31 at 00:01 UTC.
 ONE FOR ALL
 One for all, and all for fun! Queue up with your friends for some fun!

 One For All will be available to play from July 18 at 00:01 UTC until July 31 at 00:01 UTC.

SUMMONER’S RIFT
 The magic of Bandle City has begun to ripple, bringing some strange and wondrous changes to the Rift. Some bushes have quietly shifted position under the influence of magic, and scouts ahead report the sounds of boars and war drums echoing in the distance. Now, join us as we set off to explore these magical new changes in Bandle Rift.

 BUSHES
 We’ve adjusted the position of certain bush areas to improve map visibility and make it easier for you to control vision.

 Some bushes have also been removed to reduce the danger in certain zones of the map.

 EASTER EGGS
 Placing a ward in a bush has a chance to grant you a small gold bonus.

 Occasionally, small fish will gather in the river. When a champion walks by, they scatter in all directions.

 Destroying a Blast Cone may randomly trigger a festive firework effect!

 ENCHANTED PIGGY
 At 3:30 into the match, an Enchanted Piggy will spawn at both the Baron and Dragon pits.

 Defeating an Enchanted Piggy grants gold, experience, and summons a mini pig that automatically follows the player who landed the final blow.

 When the champion approaches an enemy attackable turret, the mini pig will charge into the turret, dealing true damage.

GAMEPLAY TEMPO ADJUSTMENTS
 To optimize your gameplay experience, we’ve made comprehensive adjustments to the overall tempo of the game, which will create a smoother overall pace. These changes aim to ease early-game coordination between lane players and junglers, reduce situations where you may face difficult choices or disagreements with your team, and lower the pressure of single mistakes. At the same time, these changes will also increase the impact if you have an advantage and diversify strategic paths to victory.
 We’ve made targeted changes to turrets, minion waves, strategic points, and the Nexus shield. Additionally, the stats and mechanics of epic jungle monsters have been adjusted. Both their spawn timings and rewards have been redistributed to better align with the new battlefield tempo.

BATTLEFEST SEASON 2

 ULTIMATE SPELLBOOK/SPELLBOOK ARAM

NEW SYSTEMS
 SOULFORCE AWAKENING PATCH THEME

You can also unlock some fun new titles like “Mega Extrovert” and “Relentless Grinder.” You can read more about Soulforce Awakening here .

 GRANDMASTER TIER NOW SPLIT INTO THREE SUBDIVISIONS — ASCEND TO CHALLENGER

DEFEAT-SIDE SVP UPGRADE The SVP system has been optimized to now include three performance-based tiers: Gold, Silver, and Bronze.
 Gold and Silver SVPs will now receive Fortitude compensation in Ranked matches, or Legendary Energy compensation in Legendary Ranked mode. Even in defeat, your impactful plays won’t go unrewarded!
 NEW STARLIGHT SYSTEM Win in Legendary Ranked to earn Starlight, which can be redeemed for Star Cores.
 In Ranked, consuming a Star Core grants one extra segment per win (max eight per season).
 Use the Win Exchange system for fairer and more efficient ranked climbing.
 RESOURCE MANAGEMENT CENTER

 You can now free up some space on your device by removing non-essential resources that do not affect gameplay. Like 3D champion skin models, 2D splash art, and more. This will help you enjoy a lighter, smoother gameplay experience!

ETERNAL STARMARK — TOTAL ELIMINATION TRACKER Starting in Patch 6.2, the total number of takedowns you achieve using a specific champion will be recorded across core and casual modes (excluding Duels, Co-op vs. AI games, and custom games.) Players can view these stats in the champion profile interface.
 COLLECTOR SYSTEM UPDATE Collector Level Rewards have been reworked into the Hall of Eternity.
 A new high-tier rank, “Beholder of Eternity”, has been added for top-level collectors. All previous Collector rewards are also now a part of the Hall of Eternity system.
 SYSTEM ADJUSTMENTS
 ROLE SELECTION SYSTEM In Ranked and Legendary Ranked modes, the original five position pre-selection has been updated to three role preferences: [Preferred Position], [Secondary Position], [Fill Position]
 Players who are assigned to their Fill Position will receive compensation rewards, subject to a weekly limit. Full five-player premades and players with in-game violations will not receive Fill Position rewards.
 SEASON-HIGHEST RANK DISPLAY In both the Profile and Profile card interfaces, the rank display for Ranked and Legendary Ranked has been updated. It will now show your highest rank achieved this season instead of your current rank.
 RANK RESET ADJUSTMENT If you’re in the Gold to Diamond II tiers, placement reset adjustments have been made for the new season, resulting in a slight overall increase in reset rank placement.
 CHAMPION MASTERY SCORE Ranked Match score cap raised from 4000 to 4500.
 Performance score cap per match reduced from 5500 to 5000.
 Total Champion Mastery score cap remains unchanged.
 Champion leaderboard thresholds: Provincial: 3000 → 4000, National: 4000 → 6000

 The champion score gain cap for Matchmade, ARAM, and 1v1 modes has been slightly reduced.

 A new score boost Indicator has been added! When score boosts are available, you can check the active boost mode, remaining bonus matches, and more directly from the mode selection screen.

 Profile Card Frame now supports public display of champion Honorary Titles.

textBlocks: Tick, tick, boom! Zilean makes his debut this patch, along with a new Wild Pass, Companion, and Balance Patch. Welcome to Patch 6.1d.
Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 NEW CHAMPIONS
 ZILEAN, THE CHRONOKEEPER
 Once a member of Icathia’s governing council, Zilean is a prodigious elemental mage who seeks mastery over time itself. After using his powers in an attempt to save his people from the Void, he now drifts through the past, present, and future, bending and warping the flow of time around him. Zilean has traveled from Runeterra’s mysterious creation, all the way to its seemingly inevitable ending, searching tirelessly for any strand of fate that might undo his homeland’s destruction.
 Zilean will be released on June 13 at 00:01 UTC
 WILD PASS
 A new challenger is entering the arena! Battlecast Nasus is your new reward in this Wild Pass! Queue up and play games with your friends to earn Battlecast Nasus and an array of other goodies.
 The Wild Pass will be released on June 13 at 00:01 UTC
 COMPANION
 A new companion has joined the fight, Winged Grace Iridescygn! They’ll be in the game on June 13, 00:01 UTC. Pick them up to join you on your star-studded adventures on the Rift.
 ADVENTURE MODES
 How is your journey in the stars going? We hope you’ve been taking a moment to stop and take it all in. While there’s a whole galaxy out there, there is always room for more stars. So, this patch we’re adding One For All and URF to the Adventure Star. Queue up with your friends to earn rewards and have fun.

CHAMPION CHANGES
 Welcome to Patch 6.1d! In this patch we have our Ambessa rework as well as a mini one for Fiora. Additionally, we’re continuing to keep an eye on the jungle and want to give a few more champions some buffs to help them be more viable picks, like Darius and Jax. Additionally we know that some of our other junglers have been struggling to keep up, so we’re also giving a handful of buffs to Nunu & Willump, Fiddlesticks, Pantheon, and Diana. With Fiddlesticks and Nunu & Willump getting some attention this patch, keep an extra eye out for a scarecrow in the bush or the wild snowball gank. To round things out, we’ve also got a few buffs for some mid laners and dragon laners who needed an extra boost, and we’re nerfing some of the champions that have been doing scary amounts of damage (looking at you, Nocturne; you’re scary enough as is).

In the current patch, Ambessa’s late-game cleanup and passive damage exceed reasonable counterplay, drifting off from her core design of precise positioning to trigger her passive. We're removing her passive refresh mechanic and shifting part of the damage into her first ability’s burst for better fight rhythm, while adding armor penetration and ability vamp to balance the tradeoff, plus her second ability gains new outplay depth.

championChanges.summary: Garen has been with us from the beginning and has been the sturdy tank for every team. But this patch, we’re reforging his might in the form of a fighter. We’ve updated the maneuvering of Judgment to better suit a tanky fighter who sticks to his target, and we’re rewarding him for staying in the fight longer. For Courage, the previously hidden damage reduction has been replaced with a more visible shield, giving opponents clearer combat feedback. We’ve also improved how much Garen gains from durability stats, allowing him to better balance offense and survivability.

textBlocks: Gaze up at the stars and enjoy all the goodies and fun that Patch 6.1 has to offer!

Hey everyone! Welcome to Patch 6.1! We hope you’re ready to be transported to a starry new galaxy, because with the arrival of 6.1, our new patch theme, Dual Nova, is also live! You’ll be able to gaze at twinkly stars in the Home Screen, the Shop, and even the Loading Screen. With the arrival of Dual Nova also comes Challenger’s Star and Adventure's Star too! Adventure’s Star isn’t live just yet, but Challenger’s Star is, and there are plenty of fun updates and improvements waiting for you inside. We’ve added a bunch of new goodies for you to earn on your Ranked climb this season, so we can’t wait to see you out there on the Rift while we try and reach new heights. In addition to the new theme, Ryze has also portaled his way onto our Rift and is making his grand debut! Thanks again, Faker, for the assist in helping us announce his arrival. We’ve also got a whole bunch of other quality of life updates and balance changes…Welcome to 6.1!
 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 RYZE, THE RUNE MAGE

 Widely considered one of the most adept sorcerers on Runeterra, Ryze is an ancient, hard-bitten archmage with an impossibly heavy burden to bear. Armed with immense arcane power and a boundless constitution, he tirelessly hunts for World Runes—fragments of the raw magic that once shaped the world from nothingness. He must retrieve these artifacts before they fall into the wrong hands, for Ryze understands the horrors they could unleash on Runeterra.

 Ryze will be released on April 17 at 00:01 UTC

 WILD PASS

 A new Wild Pass will be available once the patch launches, and fate is in your favor, because Wondertown Twisted Fate will be the skin for this wondrous Wild Pass! If you level up your Wild Pass to level 75, you’ll also be able to unlock Ascended Wondertown Twisted Fate, and earn tons of goodies on your way there! Additionally, a new Battle Ensign, Wondertown Twisted Fate, will be added to the Wild Pass Emporium, along with the limited-time return of Hexplorer Galio, Stargazer Karma, Ascended Stargazer Karma, Dream Raider Nasus, Ascended Dream Raider Nasus, Superhero Jayce, and Ascended Superhero Jayce!

 DUAL NOVA

 In our Patch Preview for this patch, we announced that in 6.1 we’d be introducing a special patch theme, Dual Nova! When you log in your home screen will transform into a magical galaxy, and you’ll be greeted by the fully lit up Challenger’s Star and the Adventure's Star. Surrounding them are sparkly constellations that you’ll be able to light up and earn rewards from as you play games. If you want to learn more about Dual Nova, check our article on it!

 ADVENTURE’S STAR

 As mentioned above and in our Dual Nova article , Adventure’s Star is still gathering cosmic energy, so it won’t be available until May 16, 00:00 UTC. Once it’s live, though, all casual modes will be there, and you’ll be able to earn points to upgrade your Battlefest medal by playing Adventure Mode games. You’ll be able to shine bright, reach challenger, and earn exclusive rewards along the way.

 Once Adventure’s Star is live, you’ll notice a few of the matchmaking changes we’ve made. Your grade for each mode will be used as a matchmaking criteria for that mode. We’ve also made some matchmaking adjustments in ARAM and AAA ARAM. In 6.1, the likelihood of solo, duo, and trio parties being matched against full parties has been reduced to narrow the skill gap between the two teams. We’ll also be clamping down on win-trading parties in both of these modes this patch with some countermeasures.

 RANKED SEASON

 Ranked Season 17 will be launching on April 18 at 03:00 UTC+0 and will end in July 2025. To celebrate the season, a new Ranked skin, Glorious Airgrette Janna, will be blowing into the Reward Track for you to earn! Glorious Crown Ziggs, Glorious Orianna, Glorious Lulu, Glorious Jinx, and Glorious Tryndamere will also be making a return this season, so keep an eye out for notifications in the Ranked portal for more information.

 RANKED UPDATES

 With the arrival of Challenger’s Star, we’ve also made the following updates to Ranked Rewards:

 Rewards are now easier to obtain, including the Ranked Reward skins, which will allow you to enjoy and focus more on your Ranked climb! It will now only take five games to earn them.

 We’ve removed Season Rewards, Season Collections, Promotion Rewards, and Legendary Ranked Rewards.

 The Ranked Store has been moved to the Collected Legends Redemption Store.

 Added Weekly Rewards, Ranked Season Rewards, Legendary Season Rewards, and Beginner’s Rift Expedition to Main Modes.

 Increased and improved the rewards available in the new, consolidated reward system.

 Adjusted time to earn Ranked Season Skins, it will now take five games.

 Added tier rewards and monthly ranking rewards for Legendary Ranked.

 With the retirement of the Season Rewards system, Season Rewards Boost Cards will expire at the start of the new season, changing to XP boost cards!

 Additionally, as we mentioned in our Annual Letter, we’re going to continue to take a look at the Ranked experience and make updates to improve it. We’ll continue to keep an eye on these and make adjustments as needed. The new mechanics for Patch 6.1 are:

 Rising Star: Receive one bonus Mark when you win a Ranked game with an S rating in Gold or lower.

 Remake for unbalanced team compositions: If your team composition is deemed unbalanced for Ranked, a remake vote will be triggered at the end of the champion selection phase. If a player on the team with the unbalanced composition votes to remake, the game will be terminated and the EOG summary displayed. Conditions for a remake vote are:

 Your team is not a full party.

 4 or more selected champions are marksmen/mages.

 And last but certainly not least, we’re also introducing a new rank-up event. If you rank up to Masters during the event, you’ll earn the title “A Master’s Mark: Trailblazer,” which can be used for the rest of this season. You’ll also receive the Ranked Wings cosmetic, which will be displayed in various locations on your profile during the season and permanently displayed in your Season Trophy Case.

 LEGENDARY RANKED UPDATES

 Legendary Ranked, where the best of the best rise to the top, has also received the following updates this patch:

 Updated tier names. Warrior has now been removed and the following are renamed:

 Commander → Legendary Commander

 Guardian → Legendary Master

 Vanquisher → Legendary Grandmaster

 Immortal → Legendary Challenger

 The Legend tier remains unchanged

 We’ve also added the Legendary Energy system. When you get an S or A rating or achieve Great Player in a game, you’ll now earn more Legendary Energy. The better you play, the more energy you will earn.

 We’ve made adjustments to the Legendary Ranked champion pool. Instead of the current Champion Score of 1,000 or higher, you can now use any champion with an all-time highest Champion Score of 1,000 or higher, giving you more flexibility in your champion choices.

 We’re introducing a new bonus to welcome players to Legendary Ranked! There will be Mark-loss protection for your first loss of the season.

 Lastly, we’ve adjusted Legendary Ranked tier carry-over rules. Your Legendary Ranked tier and final Ranked tier in the previous season will now grant Legendary Point bonuses at the start of a new season.

 CHAMPION SCORE SYSTEM

 With some of our adjustments to Legendary Ranked, we also wanted to take a look at Champion Score, and make sure it was a competitive system. We’ve made the following adjustments:

 We’re decreasing the base Champion Score obtainable in lower Legendary Ranked tiers and increased the weight of Legendary Ranked Factor in comparison to S15.

 We’re lowering the base Champion Score obtainable in all Ranked tiers and adjusted the Game Score and Game Performance Score weightages. Fewer games are now needed to reach maximum Champion Score.

 We’re adding the Legendary Challenge, available on Saturdays and Sundays after Legendary Ranked starts. You can earn bonus Champion Score, Legendary Ranked Factor, and Legendary Energy in Legendary Challenge. These bonuses have a separate upper limit distinct from the original obtainment limits of each rank and will count toward your ranking on the leaderboard.

 We’re also revamping the Lane Icons and increasing them from five to eight different icons. The Lane Level system remains unchanged.

 Levels 4 and 5 have been added to Master of Versatility. Go challenge yourself and reach even greater heights!

 COLLECTED LEGENDS: NEW SEASON, NEW GAMEPLAY

 We’ve made the following updates for this Collected Legends Season:

 Added new patch rewards, including Chroma skins, exclusive Companions, and other exciting rewards.

 Rewards are now easier to obtain and there are even more rewards available now! For every card set you complete, you will receive a Surprise Chest. Collect all five card sets in a collection to obtain the grand reward for that collection and unlock the next collection.

 It’s now easier to obtain the cards you want! The probability of duplicate cards dropping in card packs, especially duplicate Gold cards dropping in Prismatic Card Packs, has been greatly reduced.

 Recurring Reward Chests: If you earn all three grand rewards in the current phase before the next phase is available, you'll be switched over to a Recurring Collection, a new feature where you can repeatedly earn chests for rewards.

 More Surprise Easter Eggs have been added. Game Reward card packs now have a chance to trigger Easter Eggs. When triggered, you will receive Easter Egg bonuses when claiming the card packs.

 Crafting cards for your collections is now easier with the convenient "Craft All" button on the card set screen. You can now craft several cards with a single tap as long as you have enough Omnishards.

 Opening card packs now takes less time with the handy "Open All" button that lets you open more than one card pack at the same time.

 ANTI-CHEAT

 We're continuing to increase the capabilities of our anti-cheat system, Embedded Vanguard, to combat cheating in Wild Rift. Starting soon after the launch of this patch, if we detect a cheater in a match, that match will be terminated with no wins or losses distributed to unaffiliated players, the cheater will be banned.

 You can read more about Embedded Vanguard and our anti-cheating efforts on Wild Rift here .

SYSTEM UPDATES AND OPTIMIZATIONS

 Enchantment Purchase

 When you buy mid-tier boots different from the boot enchantment in your loadout, the boots in your loadout bar will be automatically updated to match the enchantment you've bought, letting you buy them more easily.

 For example, if your loadout contains Steel-plated Teleport but you bought Mercury's Treads, the loadout bar in the Item Shop will be automatically updated to Mercury's Teleport.

 After buying an enchantment, you can exchange your boots for other mid-tier boots of the same enchantment in the Item Shop. The exchange cost is calculated using the same rules as other items.

 Single-Player Mode

 Optimized the Laning Training and Simulation Training mode screens.

 Optimized the behavior of AI bots in Laning Training.

 Optimized the victory conditions for Laning Training.

 Expanded the AI bot champion pool for Laning Training and Simulation Training, providing you with a larger selection of champions commonly used in lanes different from their conventionally assigned lanes to practice with.

 Player Behavior Mail

 Upgraded Chroma skin artwork. Secret designs have been upgraded to include color-changing art. The artwork in the game loading screen and Collections - Skin tab will change to the same color scheme as the secret design.

 Simplified the Chroma Raffle Draw, making it easier for you to draw Chroma skins. Standard Chroma skins can now be directly purchased, and an option that lets you purchase a full set of Chroma skins (1 secret design + 6 standard designs) has been added.

 Removed Detectors. Any unused Detectors will be converted into Scanners at a ratio of 2:1 (values will be rounded up, e.g.: 3 Detectors → 2 Scanners).

 Companion Mementos

 Upgraded the Companion Memento system: Optimized gameplay experience and upgraded the rewards. Collect more Companions and play games for a chance to obtain Orange Gemstones, Collected Legends Gold Card Packs, and other rare rewards.

 Added new yellow dot notification display options and optimized notification displays on some screens.

textBlocks: Grab your purplest pj’s, your hammer, and swing into patch 6.0d with the arrivals of Pajama Guardian Lulu and Poppy!

Welcome to Patch 6.0d! We hope you brought your best, purplest pair of pajamas, because it’s time for the most fun sleepover ever! Pajama Guardian Lulu is making her debut in our new Wild Pass! It’s also the last season of ARAM and Arena before we have some more galactic adventures, so make sure to grab your friends for some fun. Oh, how could we forget? Poppy and her hammer are also swinging their way onto the Rift and bringing some fun surprises with her. Oh! Wasn’t Ke supposed to talk to the team about that Poppy skinline? Maybe we’ll get some updates on that this patch too…
 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 NEW CHAMPIONS
 POPPY, KEEPER OF THE HAMMER
 Runeterra has no shortage of valiant champions, but few are as tenacious as Poppy. Bearing the legendary hammer of Orlon, a weapon twice her size, this determined yordle has spent untold years searching in secret for the fabled “Hero of Demacia,” said to be its rightful wielder. Until then, she dutifully charges into battle, pushing back the kingdom’s enemies with every whirling strike.
 Poppy will be released on March 28 at 00:01 UTC.
 WILD PASS
 *Yawn* Rubs Eyes Oh! What’s that? Time for a new Wild Pass? And Pajama Guardian Lulu is the new reward? That’s enough to wake us up from our slumber to log in and progress our pass to earn her!
 The new Wild Pass will be available on March 13 at 00:01 UTC
 EVENTS
 WILD PASS SPRINT
 Punch your ticket and take part in the Wild Pass Sprint event, where you can flash through challenges and earn some cool new rewards!
 The Wild Pass Sprint Event will begin on March 13 at 00:01 UTC.
 POPPY’S CHALLENGE
 Poppy and her hammer are swinging onto the Rift this patch; welcome her to the Rift by joining her in this new challenge!
 The Poppy’s Challenge Event will begin on March 28 at 00:01 UTC.
 POPPY’S APRIL FOOL’S MISCHIEF
 Now, what kind of mischief is Poppy getting into…

 The Poppy’s April Fool’s Mischief will begin on March 28 at 00:01 UTC.
 GAME MODES
 ARAM AND ARENA FINAL SEASONS
 This patch will be the final season for ARAM and Arena, but have no fear! We’re just prepping for some groovy galactic adventures that will be right around the corner. For all the collectors out there, remember you’ll have to hit the rank required to earn the new emotes before they're gone! Additionally, rewards will be given based on your historical highest achievement, learn more in-game!

 Since it’s the last season, we’ll also be extending until May 15 at 00:01 UTC , and Arena’s final season will begin March 14 at 00:01 UTC and end on April 16 at 00:01 UTC.
 HEXTECH ARAM EXTENDED
 You’ve been loving the hexfication of ARAM so much, we’re extending it a little bit longer through this patch. Let us know which augments you’ve been enjoying the most!
 Hextech ARAM will be available to play until April 16 at 00:01 UTC.

Corki’s reworked performance didn’t land quite how we wanted it to, so we’re boosting his Attack Speed per level and reducing his ultimate’s downtime. This will help him better weave basic attacks between abilities for more sustained damage output.

 Attack Damage per level: 3 → 3.5

Big One Charge Time: 20s → 16s

We've improved Annie's mid-game laning and ganking potential, allowing her to leverage her strengths earlier and provide more support for her teammates.

As a marksman, Lucian struggles to pose a significant threat to enemies in the mid-to-late game. To address this, we've made him more agile in mid-game fights while also boosting his damage for the later stages.
Attack Damage per level: 4 → 4.5
We've increased Ezreal's late-game damage. This should ensure that he remains a significant threat, even in the later stages of the game.
Movement Speed: 335 → 340
Damage bonus: 120% Attack Damage + 30% Ability Power → 130% Attack Damage + 30% Ability Power

Wukong has struggled to sustain after taking a solo fight during the laning phase. Additionally, his high mana costs have limited his ability to consistently trade with his foes. To help him out, we've improved his sustain and reduced his mana costs. Now, he no longer needs Manaflow Band to compensate for his early-game insufficient mana problems.

Cooldown of empowered ability: 12/10/8/6s → 10.5/9/7.5/6s

Mordekaiser tends to struggle during the laning phase, so we’ve strengthened the damage he can do in lane. However, we’ve also slightly toned down his terrifying Realm of Death to keep him more balanced overall.

Irelia is a dominant force in lane, especially in the hands of skilled players. However, she often struggles to find impact in mid-to-late-game teamfights. To balance this, we've reduced her early-game pressure while increasing her late-game survivability.

In the current patch, Ekko’s burst damage is overly strong, and his mobility and survivability make him difficult to punish. So, we’re reducing his jungle clear speed and burst potential while also increasing the early cooldown of his ultimate. Now, he’ll need better scaling and more strategic positioning to take down his opponents.

Passive damage: (3% + 0.02% Ability Power) lost health → (2% + 0.015% Ability Power) lost health
We’re slowing down Ambessa’s jungle clear speed while also reducing her overall damage and sustain. She’ll now need to be more cautious when choosing her moment to strike.
Damage: 1 + champion level*4+(2%+0.02% bonus Attack Damage) → 1 + champion level*3+(1.5%+0.02% bonus Attack Damage)
Damage to monsters: 110% → 100%
Health regeneration: (50/75/100 + 50% bonus Attack Damage) to (150/225/300 + 100% bonus Attack Damage) → (25/50/75 + 45% bonus Attack Damage) to (75/150/225 + 90% bonus Attack Damage)

GAMEPLAY CHANGES
 ITEMS
 Manamune
 Compared to the other Tear of the Goddess items, Manamune stacks at a slower pace. We've improved its stacking efficiency, so if you choose this item, you can be more effective in the mid-game.

 Mana Charge:
 Increases max Mana by 10 every time mana is spent or launch a basic attack → Increases max Mana by 15 every time mana is spent or launch a basic attack

 Stoneplate Enchant
 In teamfights, Stoneplate Enchant has been providing too large of a shield and making certain champions too tanky. We’re reducing the shield value to bring it more in line.
 Stoneplate (active)
 For every enemy nearby, gain an additional shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of maximum health → For every enemy nearby, gain an additional shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of maximum health

 Glorious Enchant
 We're making some adjustments to Glorious Enchant so that it is a more appealing buy for champions who can utilize it.
 Glory (Active)
 Range of triggering shockwave: 200 → 250

 [Optimization] Mechanism: After casting the shockwave, the original 15% bonus movement speed will not be removed

 Locket Enchant
 With the addition of Forbidden Idol, Locket has been providing too much shielding in the mid-to-late game. So, we’re adjusting its shielding power.
 Locket (active)
 Shield value: 60~390 → 60~330

 Magnetron Enchant
 We're introducing a new mechanic to Magnetron to improve its usability, especially for champions who rely on quick repositioning.
 Magnetron (Active)
 [New] Mechanic: gain 30% of bonus movement speed for 1.5s upon reaching target position

 RUNE CHANGES
 Empowerment
 Currently, Empowerment has been underperforming. We’re increasing its damage amplification effect to better highlight its mix of burst and sustained damage potential.
 Under vulnerable state, all damage received increases by 8% → Under vulnerable state, all damage received increases by 9%

 SUMMONER SPELL
 Cleanse
 Cleanse provides a reliable way to remove crowd control during the lane phase while also mitigating multiple crowd control effects at a relatively low cost. To create a better counterplay window for opponents and improve the experience for control-based champions, we’re increasing its cooldown and reducing its immunity duration.
 Cooldown: 100s → 110s

 Time of immune to CC: 0.75s → 0.25s

 SYSTEM
 Enchanted Ensemble
 The Enchanted Ensemble has been extremely effective at pushing and in some cases, has directly ended the laning phase in-game , which can in return place too much pressure on laners. To help with this, we’re reducing the damage it can do to turrets.
 Damage of hitting turret: 60% turret’s maximum health → 50% turret’s maximum health

 Baron Nashor
 When Baron Nashor is defeated early in the game, the buff it grants to minions has been too difficult for some champions to deal with. So, we’re adjusting its effectiveness to make early Baron sieging more manageable.
 Damage reduction of empowered minions from enemy champions: 60% → 50%~60%

 Gwen
 Damage received: 100% → 105%

 Lillia

 Kayn

 Damage of Darkin form: (7%+0.06% bonus Attack Damage) target’s maximum health → (5%+0.03% bonus Attack Damage) target’s maximum health

 Fiora

Al-turret Ego
 Damage of basic attack: 120% Attack Damage + 90% Ability Power → 100% Attack Damage + 60% Ability Power

 Heart of Gold
 Maximum stack: 99999 → 19999

 Releasing March 13 @ 00:01 UTC

championChanges.summary:
Currently Corki doesn’t meet our expectations as a mixed damage marksman. His Special Delivery mechanic on his second ability, Valkyrie, requires him to dive deep into the bogeys who have been on his tail all game. This conflicts with how marksmen and mages normally position, which has made it difficult when deciding how to build him each game. So we wanted to emphasize his role as a burst-oriented marksman and shifted his gameplay focus to a mix of basic attacks and abilities. We know how fun it is to pick up the Package though, so we’ve kept it a part of his kit while making sure you don’t feel like you have to go for reckless engagements with it. Please note that some of Corki’s stats might be tweaked upon release, but we will communicate any changes with you.
 Corki’s rework will be live on March 6 PST.

textBlocks: We’ve got a bogey on our tail! Corki’s rework, the launch of Gnar, balance changes, and more. Welcome to Patch 6.0c!

Welcome to Patch 6.0c! We’re continuing to stay in our Yordle era and will be launching Gnar, as well as Corki’s rework this patch, and thank goodness for that! We’ve had some bogeys on our tail, so we’re glad he’ll be able to lend us a hand. Additionally, we will be bringing back ARURF and One For All, and of course, we will have some of our other standard balance changes.
 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 NEW CHAMPIONS
 GNAR, THE MISSING LINK
 Gnar is an excitable yordle whose playful antics can erupt into a toddler’s outrage in an instant, transforming him into a massive beast bent on destruction. Frozen in True Ice for millennia, the curious creature broke free and now hops about a changed world he sees as exotic and wondrous. Delighted by danger, Gnar flings whatever he can at his enemies, be it his bonetooth boomerang... or an uprooted tree.
 Gnar will be released on February 21 at 00:01 UTC.
 EVENTS
 GNAR!
 To help welcome Gnar to the Rift, complete missions and earn some free goodies!
 The GNAR! Event will begin on February 21 at 00:01 UTC.
 TOGETHER UNDER THE CRESCENT
 Join your favorite poros again as they fill the night with music, friendship, and food! There will be a mini-game to play, sleepy poros to wake, and plenty of rewards to earn!
 The Together Under the Crescent Event will begin on March 01 at 00:01 UTC.
 SPRING ROTATING MODES
 With us rotating some gamemodes in, we wanted to give you a way to track them. The Spring Rotating Modes will act as a little in-game calendar, telling you when and what modes are rotating! It will also grant you some goodies!
 The Spring Rotating Modes Event will begin on March 07 at 00:01 UTC.
 GAMEMODES
 ARURF (ALL RANDOM ULTRA RAPID FIRE)
 Stretch those thumbs, because ARURF is making its return this patch! Hop in with friends for some fast, fun, and random gameplay!
 ARURF will return on February 21 at 00:01 UTC.
 ONE FOR ALL
 With the release of Gnar, we thought it would be the perfect time to bring back One For All! I mean, five Gnars flinging their boomerangs around the Rift? Sign us up!
 One For All will return on March 07 at 00:01 UTC.

textBlocks: Wild Rift Patch Notes 6.0

Welcome to the first patch of the new year! Prepare to portal into the world of Yordles this patch with new Yordle champions, a new Yordle themed Rift, a Yordle themed pass and events, and an overpowering new mode. This patch also includes a durability update that will increase the health and resistances for almost all champions to make your fights last a little longer and allow for more skill expression.
 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 NEW CHAMPIONS
 Yordles have arrived! Thanks to the wonderful magic of Bandle City, three popular Yordle champions are joining the fray in this patch. Who says Yordles are mere squirts? They pack some serious punch!
 Rumble, the Mechanized Menace, is the first Yordle hero to hit this patch! A young inventor with a temper, the feisty Yordle uses nothing more than his own two hands and a heap of scrap to construct a colossal mech suit outfitted with an arsenal of electrified harpoons and incendiary rockets. Rumble brings explosive AoE damage to every team fight—he's impossible to ignore!
 Rumble will go live with Patch 6.0 on Jan 9 at 00:01 UTC
 Gnar, the Missing Link. Don't be fooled by that fluffy, adorable face, this little guy's got a mean streak! Gnar is a mercurial top-laner who can switch between a small, nimble ranged form and a hulking melee beast once his Fury is fully charged. Watch out when he goes big!
 Gnar will be released later in the patch cycle.
 Poppy, Keeper of the Hammer, has no shortage of valiant champions, but few are as tenacious as Poppy! Bearing the legendary hammer of Orlon, a weapon twice her size, this resilient top-laner charges headlong into battles and dominates duels. Fragile foes, beware!
 Poppy will be released later in the patch cycle.
 New Features
 Ranked Season 16
 We're gearing up for Ranked Season 16, which kicks off on January 10 at 00:01 UTC and is expected to end in April 2025. For more details, keep a lookout for notifications at the Ranked games portal!
 In addition to the release of the Season 16-exclusive skin Glorious AigretteCorki, Glorious Crown Braum from Season 13 will also be returning to the Ranked Store.
 Bandle City Adventure
 All of the events in patch 6.0 will be be displayed in an interactive Bandle City-themed experience that showcases all of the details and prizes of current and upcoming events. Be sure to check it out!
 New Wild Pass
 The new Wild Pass Psychic Detective Kennen will join the Rift soon after patch update! You can also gain the Ascended Psychic Detective Kennen at Level 75, upgrade your Wild Pass and unlock more rewards! The Splendor Opus skin series inspired by traditional Peking Opera will also be live with patch upgrade, and many exquisite New Year limited skins will return!

SUMMONER'S RIFT
 Bandle Rift
 With the Hextech craze over, it's time for the Rift to don a new look! Magic from Bandle City engulfs the Rift and fills it with a mysterious power! With Hextech Rift's themed mechanics being replaced by new Bandle Rift mechanics, an exciting and magical journey awaits you in the Rift!

 We also designed a bunch of easter eggs based on the Yordle champions' colors and characteristics, and also memes from players that will surely bring a smile to your face. As you collect more of them, there will be a surprise waiting for you!
 Enchanted Mushrooms
 [New] Mechanics:
 Starting from 1 minute into the game, mushrooms will spawn behind the turrets, picking them up grants you gold.

 A mushroom will spawn every 3 seconds, up to 6 mushrooms.

 Mushrooms will keep spawning throughout the entire game and will only spawn behind the outermost turret that can be attacked.

 Mushrooms that spawn behind Outer Turrets grant 2 gold; Mushrooms that spawn behind Inner Turrets grant 3 gold; Mushrooms that spawn behind Inhibitor Turrets grant 5 gold.

 You can destroy the opponent's Enchanted Mushrooms, but you will not gain any gold.

 Enchanted Buff
 [Retained] Mechanics:
 Starting from 7.5 minutes into the game, newly-spawned Red Brambleback and Blue Sentinel will evolve into Empowered Red Brambleback and Empowered Blue Sentinel. After being defeated by the jungler, they will drop Crest of Cinders and Crest of Insight respectively, and can be picked up by a teammate to gain the same buff.

 [New] Mechanics:
 Starting from 12 minutes into the game, newly-spawned Red Brambleback and Blue Sentinel will evolve into Evolved Red Brambleback and Evolved Blue Sentinel. After being defeated by any player, all surviving teammates will receive Crest of Cinders or Crest of Insight buff.

 Enchanted Gates
 [New] Mechanics:
 Spawn Mechanics:
 From 7.5 minutes to 11.5 minutes into the game, four pairs of one-way Enchanted Gates will spawn. Players can use them to teleport from the team's base to their jungle.

 From 12 minutes into the game to end of the game, two pairs of two-way Enchanted Gates will spawn. Players can use them to teleport between one of the team's jungle to the other.

Using the Enchanted Gate:
 A 1.5 second channeling time is required to use the gate.

 Once a pair of the gates is used by any player, both gates will enter a 15-second cooldown. Enchanted Gate on cooldown cannot be used by any player.

 Enchanted Ensemble
 [New] Mechanics:
 At 5 minutes into the game, a new neutral epic monster, Enchanted Ensemble, will spawn at the original location of the Rift Herald.

 Enchanted Ensemble Abilities:
 Upon entering combat, the three instrument monsters will combine into Rift Herald.

 Basic Attack: Melee attack.

 Get Flattened!: After charging for a brief period, Rift Herald slams into the ground, dealing physical damage and knocking back targets in an area.

 After Rift Herald exits combat, returns to its original location and heals back to full health, if it does not enter combat within 5 seconds, it will leave its combined state and split into the three instrument monsters.

 Enchanted Ensemble defeat reward:
 The killer will have all their abilities' remaining cooldown reduced by 75%.

 The killer can summon Enchanted Ensemble, and it will assist them in destroying the enemy turret.

 Summoned Enchanted Ensemble Abilities:

 After being summoned, Rift Herald will directly head towards the nearest turret.

 After entering turret range, it will start charging and slam into the turret, dealing damage to it.

 After slamming into the turret, Rift Herald will split into the three instrument monsters.

 The instrument monsters will use basic attack, gaining stacking Attack Speed each time they attack.

 Baron Nashor
As T-Hex Mecha will not be in the new Bandle Rift, we provide more rewards for defeating Baron Nashor by buffing the minion-empowering effect he gives.
 [Adjusted] Mechanics:
 Baron Nashor is influenced by the magic of Bandle City and gains new abilities. Slaying him also grants new rewards.

 He spawns for the first time 12 minutes into the game and respawns 3.5 minutes after each time he is slain.

 Slaying Baron Nashor grants the Hand of Baron buff that boosts the Attack Damage, Ability Power, Armor, and Magic Resist of all allied champions and reduces recall time.

 While Hand of Baron is active, newly-spawned allied minion wave will be empowered:
 Each minion wave now consists of two melee minions (Super minions will replace them as usual), a siege minion, and an Enchanted Trumpet minion.

 Melee Minion: Gains bonus damage reduction.

 Siege Minion: Uses ranged attack and can deal splash damage. Gains bonus damage reduction.

 Enchanted Trumpet Minion: Upgraded version of caster minions. In addition to using basic attacks, it will also heal allied minions. Gains bonus damage reduction

 Super Minion: Gains bonus damage reduction.

 Abilities:
 Baron's Gaze (Passive): Baron Nashor's target is slowed and deal less damage to him.

 Soundwave Overture: Emits a powerful soundwave, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and reducing their Armor and Magic Resist.

 Notes Deluge: Rains down musical notes, dealing magic damage to enemies nearby where the notes land and turning them into musical instruments for a short period.

 Rousing Symphony: Plays a frenzied melody and marks an enemy, dealing magic damage to the marked target and nearby enemies multiple times.

 Elder Dragon
 The chain lightning effect of Elder Immolation was removed in the new Bandle Rift and replaced by a burn effect, which was also buffed to compensate for the durability adjustment made to Champions to reduce the length of games.

 [Adjusted] Mechanics:
 Elder Immolation: Deals damage to enemies while burning them, dealing 450 true damage over 3 seconds. When dealing damage to an enemy champion with less than 15% of their maximum health, it will detonate that champion with Dragon Flame, dealing true damage equal to 100% of their maximum health.

GAMEPLAY CHANGES
 CHAMPION ENDURANCE CHANGES
 We've increased all champions' endurance.
 Low survivability often made teamfights and skirmishes feel too sudden and chaotic. To address this, we've increased the survivability stats of all champions. You can now expect longer battles with more opportunities to show off your skills. This update aims to improve the game's pace and enhance the fun of tactical decision-making during combat.
 As part of this endurance update, we've increased base stats for all champions, including Base Health, Health per level, Base Armor, Armor per level, Base Magic Resist, and Magic Resist per level.
 Meanwhile, we've reduced the healing, shielding, and durability provided by most items. While increased endurance makes these effects more impactful, we've adjusted them to avoid overly long matches or unkillable opponents.
 In addition, for balance reasons, we've made targeted adjustments to a few champions, runes, and summoner spells to ensure they align with the endurance update in this patch.
 We have listed in-detail stats changes for champions, items and runes at the end of this patch notes, please refer to it for more information.

 [Item Filter Tab]
 [New]
 Added an accessibility tab in the Item Shop interface to help players find items that suit their needs faster without searching in other tabs.

 [Cooldown Optimization for Switching Active Item]
 [Optimized] Mechanics:
 If you switch your active enchantment that is not on cooldown, there will no be cooldown penalty.

 If you switching your active enchantment that is on cooldown, the new active enchantment will inherit the cooldown of the previous one, up to a cap of 20 seconds.

 [Self-Cast Button]
 [New]
 Added a self-cast button next to the cancel button of target abilities that can choose between yourself or other units (such as Lulu's Help, Pix! or Lissandra's Frozen Tomb) as the target. Drag the self-cast button upwards to cast the ability on yourself.

 [Quick cast Empowered attacks]
 [Optimized] Mechanics:
 After enabling this feature in the Settings, only when the auto-aim target is a locked-on target, enemy champion, or clone, you will automatically follow up with attacks after casting an ability that empowers attacks. This helps prevent empowered attack from being wasted on low-value targets, such as minions or fruits.

 [Manual Aim Time Limit]
 [New]
 Viktor's Death Ray and Rumble's The Equalizer: Added Manual Aim Time Limit setting. When aiming manually, if no sliding gestures are detected within the time limit, the starting point of the trail will be automatically selected for you (Tap the back button at the top left to cancel). You can then continue dragging the ability button to select the end point of the trail.

 As the war between sweetness and saltiness goes into stalemate, humans grow tired of these tastes and are just going through the motions of fighting for their factions. Looks like it's time to add some SPICE to their life! With a maniacal laughter, the Chili Immortal descends upon the world on their Spicy Nimbus and does their wild magic—weird, fiery peppers start growing everywhere in the Rift! With that, he makes a declaration: From now on, spiciness shall rule over all other tastes. This plunged the world into a new age of multi-sided war. Many were unwilling to accept this new flavor that appeared suddenly—until a wanderer takes a leap of faith and tries the weird pepper. After a loud bang, the wanderer undergoes a complete transformation: their face becomes red and shiny, and is brimming with energy. But more importantly, they gained superhuman powers and could jump ten times higher than usual! It has become obvious that the weird pepper, now known as Devilish Pepper, brings various benefits and no one wants to miss out on this great opportunity.
