SYSTEM CHANGES
 Mission System Removal
 Removed the old mission system. The old Skin Fragments for the "Dark Star Malphite" skin have been converted into corresponding items and stored in your vault, with 2 Wondrous Gems, 100 Condensed Ores, 30 A Small Gifts, 1000 Blue Motes and 1000 XP as unfinished progress compensations. Other rewards are moved into the Collected Legends, more details are available within the game itself.

 Renamed Poro Energy to Condensed Ores, which can be used to purchase a wider variety of items. Condensed Ores can be converted into Condensed Motes at a 1:1 ratio. Use Condensed Motes to redeem rewards at the Collected Legends Redemption Store.

 Certain rewards such as guild rewards, Rift Star rewards, and Wild Pass rewards have been added to Collected Legends card packs. More details are available within the game itself.

 Collected Legends
 Upgraded the old mission system to the new Collected Legends system. New activity rewards such as the exclusive skin "Pengu Cosplay Tristana" and Orange Gemstones have been added.

 Collected Legends simplifies the daily in-game goals, allowing you to accumulate and obtain free exclusive rewards just by focusing on the gameplay experience.

 There are four Collected Legends seasons a year, with each season split into three phases. Completing 3, 6, and 10 legendary card sets in each phase will grant you one of the three rewards corresponding to that phase respectively.

 You can obtain card packs of varying rarities by completing Collected Legends missions and by receiving other rewards. Card packs grant different collectible cards, which can then be used to complete card sets.

 Card packs may contain cards of different rarities, as well as Blue Motes and XP.

 To earn Prismatic Card Packs, perform well in games to fill up your Prismatic Card Pack Energy. Not only do Prismatic Card Packs contain cards, they may also contain skins.

 Added the new time-limited currency "Condensed Motes". Condensed Motes can be used to redeem Skin Chests, Pose Chests, Boost Cards, and other items from the Collected Legends Redemption Store.

 Added the new item "Wondrous Gem", which can be used to redeem exclusive rewards such as exclusive skins, Dark Star Malphite, and Dark Star Malphite Chroma skins from the Collected Legends Redemption Store. More rewards will be added in future patches.

 For more details about the Collected Legends system, please refer to its in-game tooltip.

 Unbound Frenzy Periphery System
 With the Chili Immortal and Devilish Peppers as core elements, we've overhauled the Unbound Frenzy mode's entire gameplay, as well as its look and feel. This new mode is bound to be an unprecedented experience!

 Added a brand-new Champion Archive for the Unbound Frenzy mode, allowing you to view details about the mode's champion enhancements. Once the Unbound Frenzy mode is officially launched, play it to receive a Companion and an exclusive title!

 Easter Egg Collection and Time-Limited Collection
 Added a new Easter Egg Collection to the Normal tab, allowing you to view easter eggs that you've picked up while playing the time-limited mode. While the time-limited easter eggs are still available, collecting them will even grant certain interesting rewards.

 Gameplay Preview
 Added the feature to preview casual modes. Using this feature allows you to view all of the casual modes that'll become available in the coming month. You can even pre-register for your favorite modes.

 SYSTEM OPTIMIZATIONS
 Loadout Optimizations
 Optimized player experience of selecting corresponding lanes and modes in Loadouts: Added the Lane and Mode tabs to the Loadout Recommendation screen. You can now rapidly filter out lanes/modes corresponding to their loadouts via these tabs.

 After copying a loadout, the original Confirm notification panel has been optimized into the Confirm Replacement panel, allowing you to freely select the loadouts to be replaced. This resolves the current issue of players accidentally replacing their original loadouts.

 When you are currently using a loadout that is completely identical to a popular loadout, a new Selected icon notification will be added to the identical loadout.

 Added a feature to share around-game loadout codes: After you have configured your loadout, you can convert it to a loadout code that can be copied and sent to friends. Once sent, they only need to copy the loadout code to the "Loadouts"-"Loadout Search" page to retrieve and use the corresponding loadout.

 Highlight Optimizations
 Added numerous in-game highlight announcements. When you perform well in games, a highlight announcement will be triggered based on the type of feat that you accomplished.

 Added a Personal Performance EOG summary screen that includes highlights, data displays, Game Performance Score, and Champion Score/Mastery. This EOG screen is only added for Normal PVP, Ranked, and Legendary Ranked games.

 Casual Mode Page Optimizations
 Overhauled the Casual Mode page, with the mode's front cover now updated to include visuals that are more relevant to the mode itself. Added a new graphical rules page. Secondary page portals related to this mode have been unified in order to highlight the uniqueness of this mode.

 Social Feature Optimizations
 In-game interactions between players will now be summarized in the commendations screen, allowing you to view data such as which players assisted you and who coordinated with you the most. Two new types of interactions, the "Thanks" and the "High-five", have also been added so that you can express your gratitude to other players.

 Optimized the Like feature so that you can give a Like on the Data Statistics panel, as well as view the number of Likes received by your teammates.

 Champion and Lane Screen Revamp
 Revamped the Profile-Champion and Lane screens, with an emphasis on displaying content relating to certain modules such as player champions, lanes, and Master of Versatility.

 Added a secondary tab for champions. When you tap on a champion, you can now view details such as past Honorary Titles for that champion and champion configurations for the current season.

 Lane Stat Adjustments
 Revamped Lane Levels such that they are no longer calculated using champions' highest seasonal scores. Instead, they're now calculated using lifetime highest scores.

 All slots are now unlocked by default and do not require players to unlock them by increasing Lane Levels.

 Tiers 1 and 2 have been adjusted to include four champions each. The Tier Factor of Tier 3 Champion Scores has been reduced from 5% to 0%.

 Increased max Lane Level to Lv. 25. Icons corresponding to the various Lane Levels have been reassigned according to the revamped levels in the new patch.

 The aforementioned adjustments will take effect once a new season begins. When that happens, Lane Levels will be recalculated for all players based on their champions' lifetime highest scores.

 Master of Versatility Stat Adjustments
 Master of Versatility Revamp
 Adjusted requirements for reaching each of the three levels for Master of Versatility. Reduced Lane Score requirements for the first two Master of Versatility levels. Added a new Champion Score requirement.

 The aforementioned adjustments will take effect once a new season begins. When that happens, Master of Versatility levels will be recalculated for all players based on their Lane Scores and Champion Scores.

 Real-time Scoring Screen
 Added a real-time scoring portal for champions and lanes to Ranked and Legendary Ranked, allowing you to easily view your current Champion Scores, Lane Scores, and Master of Versatility progress.

 Gifting Optimizations
 The Gifting feature has been upgraded. Personalize greeting cards and gift bundles with the unique memories that you and your friends have shared.

 Show your sincerity with new Surprise and Birthday Gift Bundles.

 The new "Quick Create" and "Emote Input" features allow you to write personalized gift messages more easily.

 The new "Signature" feature allows you to address the gift's recipient with an intimate nickname. It's bound to surprise them!

 Collection Score Expansion
 Added the "Nebula Collector" and "Cosmic Connoisseur" levels to the Collector system.

 Added Collection Score badges for players to display their statuses. Players can also unlock and obtain rare Collection Score rewards.

 Companion System Optimizations
 Added a new Companion nighttime environment in order to create a more immersive Companion system. You can freely switch between daytime/nighttime environments in the Companion system. Alternatively, you can let the environments switch automatically based on the current time on your device.

 The environment that you select will also display your Profile and Mini-Profile Card.

 Stellar Bonds Level Expansion
 Max Stellar Bonds level has been increased to Lv. 8. New perks have also been added, including a Badge of Prestige and a dynamic icon border.

textBlocks: How are we feeling after the Arcane Season 2 premiere? But there is no time to rest because we have a brand new game mode for you!

Strap in friends, it’s the patch right after the premiere of Arcane season 2. While this is a deceptively short patch note, it packs a punch, much like my favorite Arcane character. There might be something else coming soon… but we can’t reveal it just yet. We have a brand new game mode for you, as well as your regularly scheduled balance updates. Welcome to patch 5.3b.
 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 We’re adjusting Warwick’s abilities for a smoother playing experience.

 Base Stats
 Base mana: 300 → 340

 Base mana regeneration: 9 → 16

 Growth Attack Damage: 3.6 → 4.5

 (P) Eternal Hunger
 Damage: (12~46) + 15% bonus Attack Damage + 10% Ability Power → (12~61) + 20% bonus Attack Damage + 10% Ability Power

 (1) Jaws of the Beast
 Adjust how enemy is targeted

 [Removed] Hold: Warwick also clamps on the target, leaping behind them and following their movement

 [New] Tap: Lunges forward and bites the target enemy

 Drag: Leaping behind targets and following their movement

 Mana consumption: 40/45/50/55 → full level 40

 (2) Blood Hunt
 [New] Active casting increases Warwick’s vision range, which ignores terrains (up to 1300)

 [New] Increase sense range of active casting (full map)

 Cooldown: 80/70/60/50s → 70/60/50/40s

 (3) Primal Howl
 [New] Recasting Primal Howl within 1s does not trigger fear effect, and 45% cooldown is returned; if fear is triggered, then no cooldown reduction

 Mana consumption: full level 40 → full level 30

 (4) Infinite Duress
 The first stage of Infinite Duress is no longer target-directed ability, but a ranged one

 Hit effects will be changed to 4 times while suppressing target

 [New] Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his Movement Speed, 5s within landing his next basic attack will be empowered

 [New] If the empowered basic attack hit target successfully, he leaps to the target, dealing damage while suppressing the target

 NEW FEATURES
 SHOWDOWN
 With the Season of Arcane 2 premiering last weekend, we have a new limited-time game mode for you all to enjoy! Showdown is a game mode where all players can choose an ultimate item immediately at the beginning of the game, and unlock their powerful effects as the game progresses.
 Here are some ultimate items that you can expect in Showdown:

 Chemtech Exoskeleton
 Escape death through immunity while boosting your damage, regenerating your health back, and turning the tide!
 In the Balance: Upon taking lethal damage, become immune to death for 3s (1s for ranged champions). During this time, getting champion takedowns restores 30% of your max Health and resets In the Balance's cooldown. (60-45s cooldown)

 Overcharged: Increases damage by 10% plus an additional bonus based on missing Health. The total bonus damage is capped at 25%

 Shimmer
 Ignore the terrain to move freely, strike your enemies at unexpected positions, and get away after harvesting their souls!

 Ambidextrous Shot: Every third attack launches an additional attack

 Buff yourself or your teammate? You choose!
 Amplified Crescendo: Buffing abilities buffs 2 additional nearby allied champion

 Choral Song: Increased shield strength and heal potency by 100%

 Warden's Power Shield
 Flip a coin and experience the power of exceptional sustainability, damage reduction, and you get to ignore penetration! See how long you can last in a team fight.
 Verdict: Take 30% reduced damage and toss a coin every 5 seconds. If it lands on heads, you heal for 15% of your max Health. If it lands on tails, a lightning bolt strikes at your location, dealing 10% of the target’s max Health as true damage to nearby enemies.

 Iron Law: Armor Pen and Magic Pen are ignored when taking ability damage.

 Hextech Arm Cannon
 Which random effect will you get? Bonus CC, true damage, or doublecast?

 Bejeweled: Damaging abilities can Critically Strike, gaining bonus Critical Rate based on the number of upgraded items you have (20% + number of upgraded items × 7.5%)

textBlocks: Look out! A Warlord behind you!

Who’s excited for the new season of Arcane? I cannot wait until I get to see my favorite character on the big screen again. And she’s coming to Wild Rift too?! Head into battle with Ambessa and watch your enemies shake in fear. We also got new events, new skins, and did we mention Arena is coming back this patch as well? Oh and your regularly scheduled balance changes. Welcome to patch 5.3a.

Her role as matriarch is no different, requiring great cunning to empower the Medardas while leaving no room for failure or compassion. Embracing the merciless ways of the Wolf, Ambessa will do whatever it takes to protect her family's legacy, even at the cost of her own children's love.

Heimerdinger has been difficult to lane against as he sits in the safety of his turrets. We’re adjusting his fighting abilities to allow his opponents to catch their breath.

Damage dealt by turret on-hit: 5/11/17/23 + 35% Ability Power → 5/10/15/20 + 35% Ability Power

 Damage of turret laser: 30/55/80/105 + 55% Ability Power → 30/50/70/90 + 55% Ability Power
Damage: 70/95/120/145 + 60% Ability Power → 60/85/110/135 + 60% Ability Power
Damage: 85/130/175/220 + 60% Ability Power → 70/120/170/220 + 60% Ability Power
Modekaiser greatly benefits from sustain which can make him difficult to counter in Lane. We’re moving some numbers around to give his enemies room for counterplay.
Damage per second: 4.5 + 0.5 per Level + 30% Ability Power → 4.75 + 0.25 per Level + 25% Ability Power

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 ITEMS

 SERYLDA’S GRUDGE

 We’re adjusting Armor Penetration on items so players can see immediate
 benefits when choosing the item.

 Last Whisper:

 +16~33% armor penetration → +33% armor penetration

 MORTAL REMINDER

 We’re adjusting Armor Penetration on items so players can see immediate
 benefits when choosing the item.

 Last Whisper:

 +16~33% armor penetration → +33% armor penetration

 TERMINUS

 Terminus is a great item that provides both attack and defense stats. We’ve
 found the damage makes it overwhelming in the early game, so we’re adjusting
 it slightly.

 Stats:

 Attack Damage: 40 → 35

 WIT’S END

 Wit’s End provides great damage and magic resistance, and has very high
 cost-efficiency. We’re adjusting the numbers so it remains in line with other
 items.

 Stats:

 Magic resistance: 50 → 45

 At Wit's End:

 Basic attacks deal 15-80 bonus magic damage →
 Basic attacks deal 15-65 bonus magic damage

SYSTEM CHANGES

 HEXTECH ELDER DRAGON

 We lowered the damage dealt by Hextech Elder Dragon to champions. Now players
 can focus more on combats with enemies while fighting to slay the dragon.
 Meanwhile, we boosted the Aspect of the Dragon received by taking down Hextech
 Elder Dragon, providing higher damage buff in subsequent combat.

 Hextech Elder Dragon:

 Damage of chain lightning to a single target: 100% → 80%

 Damage of chain lightning to multiple targets: 50% → 30%

 The Aspect of the Dragon:

 When dealing damage, call down chain lightning on the target. The chain
 lightning ricochets to nearby enemies, dealing 100 →
 200 true damage on each hit. If the chain lightning hits
 only one target, then deals bonus 100% → 30% true damage
 (1s cooldown).

 HEXTECH MIMIC

 Hextech Mimics have been upgraded. Taking down Hextech Mimics automatically
 bring them to all players in the team and assist them to attack on the
 enemies’ turrets.

 Mechanism adjustment:

 After defeating the Hextech Mimic, all allied champions gain Micro Mimics
 that can help them push lanes →
 After defeating the Hextech Mimic, all allied champions gain Micro Mimics
 automatically, duo lane players gain 2 Micro Mimics and other players gain
 3.

 HEXTECH TOOL KIT

 Deceleration Ray now deals damage to monsters too.

 Mechanism adjustment:

 Deceleration Ray deals damage and slows down enemy champions →
 Deceleration Ray deals damage and slows down enemy champions and
 monsters.

 GALIO’S AEGIS

 Galio’s Aegis is returning for a limited time! If you missed it last time,
 here’s the rundown:

 Players that lose a match will not lose ranking if they achieve S-Level
 rating.

 S-Level rating compensation takes precedence over events and Ranked Loss
 Shields cards. If triggered, will not consume those cards or event bonuses.

 Players that lose a match will be compensated for 50% of their current Rank
 Fortitude if they achieve A-Level rating.

 Ranked Loss Shields and A-Level rating compensation can trigger at the same
 time.

 If there is an event that compensates for loss and it is triggered, A-Level
 rating compensation will not occur.

 Players will need to meet the following conditions to receive Galio’s Aegis

 Platinum rank or above.

 Match duration is greater or equal to 600s.

 No negative behavior during the match.

 Galio’s Aegis is live right now! Let us know your thoughts as we continue to
 improve your ranked experience.

textBlocks: Heimerdinger has arrived!

We've been teasing him endlessly and now he’s finally here, Heimerdinger, our first champion for 5.3 to lead us into the world of Arcane. And with him, a birthday event, login rewards, and your regularly scheduled balance updates (and there are a lot of them). Welcome to patch 5.3
 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 NEW CHAMPIONS
 HEIMERDINGER, THE REVERED INVENTOR
 A brilliant yet eccentric yordle scientist, Professor Cecil B. Heimerdinger is one of the most innovative and esteemed inventors Piltover has ever known. Relentless in his work to the point of neurotic obsession, he thrives on answering the universe's most impenetrable questions. Though his theories often appear opaque and esoteric, Heimerdinger has crafted some of Piltover's most miraculous—not to mention lethal—machinery, and constantly tinkers with his inventions to make them even more efficient.
 Heimerdinger will be released on Oct 17 at 00:01 UTC.
 NEW FEATURES
 RANKED SEASON 15
 We're gearing up for Ranked Season 15, which kicks off on October 18 at 00:00 UTC and is expected to end in January 2025. For more details, look for notifications in the Ranked games portal!
 In addition to Glorious Crown Jhin, our season-exclusive skin, Glorious Crown Xin Zhao from Season 12 will also be returning to the Ranked Store to join in on the action.
 WILD PASS
 The new Wild Pass, Dream Raider Kha'Zix, will be available after the patch update. Level up your Wild Pass to Lv. 75 to unlock Ascended Dream Raider Kha'Zix and earn goodies along the way. A new Battle Ensign, Dream Raider Kha'Zix, will also be added to the Wild Pass Emporium, along with the limited-time return of Ascended Superhero Jayce, Ascended Supervillain Jhin, Ascended Soda Pop Ahri, Unleashed Dream Raider Thresh, Superhero Jayce, Supervillain Jhin, Soda Pop Ahri, and Dream Raider Thresh!
 A new Elderwood Xayah Mini Pass will go live after the Dream Raider Kha'Zix Wild Pass ends. While the Mini Pass is available, Pass levels, rewards, and missions will be adjusted based on the Mini Pass. Wild Stars can be used for both the Wild Pass and Mini Pass when available. Any unused Wild Stars will automatically expire at the end of the Mini Pass.
 FIRELIGHTS REIGNITE
 In Firelights Reignite, you'll learn about the Firelights' origins and how the street gang was formed in Arcane . The story is presented in chapters, with each main chapter featuring several interactive objects that give insight into the story. While you don't need to complete event missions to unlock the story chapters, doing so will earn you additional rewards. After the patch ends, the Firelights Reignite story will be added to Collections, allowing you to revisit it in future patches.
 RANKED TIER COUNT DISPLAY
 Based on the total times you reached Master and above in Ranked or Immortal and above in Legendary Ranked, additional visual effects will be added to the display effects for the tiers.
 The icons for the highest tier you've ever achieved and your tier in the current season at the bottom right of your profile

 Tier loading screen border when entering a game

 Icon border

 Seasonal player emblems displayed in your Profile and the lobby

 RIFT ADVENTURE LOG
 In the Rift Adventure Log, you can learn about updates and changes in the latest patch and play through tutorials. Level up in Battle Academia to unlock the Rift Adventure Log, and complete missions to earn a permanent exclusive title.
 STELLAR BONDS
 Stellar Bonds is a monthly subscription to a paid rewards program that offers perks like daily rewards, rebates, and customization items.
 There are two subscription plans: Stellacorn's Gift and Celestial Blessing. Each purchase gives you 30 days of access to the plan's perks, and plans are available for direct purchase only. Every 30-day subscription purchased earns you XP that levels up Stellar Bonds.
 As you level up Stellar Bonds, you will also unlock more perks. Perks gained from leveling up Stellar Bonds only take effect while you have an active subscription to Stellacorn's Gift, Celestial Blessing, or both.
 Stellacorn’s Gift - $4.99 Exclusive Store Chest: Players can buy one extra "Loot Lucky Chest (Weekly)" from the store each week.
 Champion Purchase Discount: 10% off when purchasing champions with either in-game currency or blue motes.

 Celestial Blessing - $34.99 Exclusive Store Chest: Players can buy two extra "Loot Lucky Chests (Weekly)" from the store each week. If only Stellacorn's Gift is active, players get one extra purchase per week.

 If only Celestial Blessing is active, players get two extra purchases per week.

 If both Stellar Bonds are active, players can buy three extra chests per week.

 Match Experience Boost: 50% increased experience after each match.

 Skin Trial for All: Receive 10 free [All Team Skin Trial] rights, usable up to twice per day in ARAM and URF modes for 30 days. This can be activated during champ select, allowing the entire team to use a random skin of the selected champion.

 Exclusive Sidebar Notification: Access to Celestial Blessing-exclusive sidebar notifications during the Stellar Bonds period.

 Personalized Collectibles: Use Celestial Blessing-exclusive items, such as icon border, homeguard trail, and spawn tag during the Stellar Bonds period.

 Reject Teammate Feature: Gain two extra "Reject Teammate" uses per week.

 Champion Purchase Discount: 10% off when purchasing champions with in-game currency or blue motes. If both Stellacorn's Gift and Celestial Blessing are active, the discount remains 10% and does not stack.

 Stellar Bonds will be available on Oct 22 at 00:01 UTC.
 FACEBOOK SHARING FEATURE
 Sharing on Facebook is now supported! Post your game highlights and victories on Facebook straight from the game and share your joy with your friends! (Unavailable in Russia)
 EVENTS
 CHEERS TO ARCANE
 Who’s ready for season two of Arcane? We still have a few weeks to go until the premier. But in the meantime, join us and explore everything Wild Rift has to offer along your journey into the world of Piltover and Zaun! Check out all the events and earn rewards while playing.
 Cheers to Arcane begins Oct 17 at 00:01 UTC
 HEIMERDINGER’S TECH FRENZY
 Heimerdinger has come baring gifts! From daily login rewards to rewards for playing and winning, he has something for everyone.
 Heimerdinger’s Tech Frenzy begins Oct 17 at 00:01 UTC
 FOURTH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION
 It’s our birthday! Don’t stress we are not expecting a present from you, instead, we got something for you! Log in daily for goodies and a visit from our special friends, Nunu & Beelump.
 Fourth Anniversary Celebration begins Oct 17 at 00:01 UTC
 ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION RAFFLE PARTY
 How lucky are you feeling? Test it out at our new event! Earn tokens by completing missions and draw for goodies!
 Anniversary Celebration Raffle Party begins Oct 24 at 00:01 UTC
 BATTLE CHALLENGE
 The rewards just keep rolling in! Complete missions by playing games and earn blue motes and more!
 Battle Challenge begins Oct 24 at 00:01 UTC

GAME MODE CHANGES
 ARENA
 Arena will no longer be accessed through a separate tab but through the Normal tab. Whenever the mode is available, tapping the portal there will take you to the Arena lobby.

 The Arena Hextech Lab will be closed, and we will not be releasing Augments that are unlocked with Energy Stars for the time being. Any Augments that you have already unlocked can still be used.

 SINGLE-PLAYER MODE AND PRACTICE MODE
 [New] Feature
 Added Simulation Training and Laning Training modes. In these modes, players can try out single-player laning simulations for all three lanes at varying difficulty levels.

 More difficulty level options will be introduced over time for both modes to cater to players of different skill levels.

 Added a feature that automatically pauses the game when it is interrupted.

 [Optimized] Feature
 Consolidated the Offline Mode and Practice Mode portals into a unified screen where players can select the mode they wish to play.

GAMEPLAY CHANGES
 NEW ITEMS
 HEXTECH SOULSTEALER
 Base Stats

 Ability Haste: 20

 Soul Hunt
 +15 Magic Penetration

 Wandering Soul
 Every time you take down an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them, your ability cooldowns are reduced by 25%. You steal 15% of their base Movement Speed for 10 seconds and 75% of their Ability Haste until they respawn. Ability Haste stolen this way stacks.

 HEXTECH STORMRAZOR

 HEXTECH BLACK CLEAVER

 HEXTECH ZEKE’S CONVERGENCE
 Base Stats
 Total cost: 2700g

 Max Health: 350

 Harbinger

 NEW RUNE
 INSPIRATION: IXTALI SEEDJAR
 [Removed] Existing item: Ixtali Seedjar

 [New] Plants hit by you or your allies drop seeds. When picked up, the seed replaces your trinket for 60 seconds and grants you Movement Speed. The seed takes 1 second to mature after it is planted at a target location. Seeds can be picked up 2 minutes after the game starts Bonus Movement Speed: 40% (decays over 2.5 seconds)
 Cooldown: Each plant has a unique 45-second cooldown

 RUNE CHANGES
 KEYSTONE: FLEET FOOTWORK
 [New] At 100 Energy stacks, your next attack gains 100% Attack Speed

 INSPIRATION: SWEET TOOTH
 Whenever you or a nearby ally eats a Honeyfruit, gain 15 gold → Whenever you eat a Honeyfruit, gain 15 gold

SYSTEM CHANGES
 GAME
 HEX ELDER DRAGON
 Mechanics
 The Elder Dragon has gotten a Hextech upgrade and new abilities! Slaying it also grants new rewards.

 Like all the other dragons, it takes flight when entering combat, knocking back nearby enemies.

 The Elder Dragon's attacks call down chain lightning which strikes up to 3 enemies within range. The fewer enemies hit by the ricocheting chain lightning, the higher its damage.

 Takedown reward changes The player who slays the Elder Dragon gains the Aspect of the Dragon buff. Aspect of the Dragon: When dealing damage, call down chain lightning on the target. The chain lightning ricochets to nearby enemies, striking up to three targets and dealing 100 true damage per hit. If the chain lightning only strikes one target, it deals an extra 100% true damage. (1s cooldown). Executes enemy champions below 15% Health.

 T-HEX MECHA
 New ability 1 for the T-hex Mecha! The T-Hex Rampage will provide stronger mobility, a must when you’re stampeding toward the enemy team. We’re also making the minion buff map-wide to ensure flexibility when choosing where to split your resources when pushing for the win.
 Base Stats
 Attack Damage: 380 – 952 → 265 – 665

 Health: 4,000 – 11,800 → 5,000 – 11,800

 Armor: 80 – 158 → 80 – 230

 Magic Resist: 50 – 102 → 50 – 15

 (1) T-Hex Rampage
 [Removed] Existing ability: Missile Blitz

 [New] T-Hex Rampage: After a brief delay, charges in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies along the path. Stops upon knocking back an enemy champion or colliding with terrain.

 Physical damage: 115% Attack Damage

 Distance: 700

 [New] Deals 1,200 bonus physical damage to minions.

 [New] Cooldown: 10s

 (2) Amplifying Field
 Cooldown: 15s → 8s

 Shield: 80% of Attack Damage → 70% of Attack Damage

 Movement Speed: 15% → 20%

 (3) Irontail Sweep
 Cooldown: 8s → 6s

 Damage: 50% of Attack Damage → 90% of Attack Damage

 [New] Deal additional 1200 physical damage on minions

 Improved the indicator's display.

 (4) Laser Ray
 Damage to Champions and minions per second: 80% of Attack Damage → 100% of Attack Damage

 Cooldown: 40s → 20s

 Your Movement Speed reduction during Laser Ray: 150 → 80

 Mechanics
 After you mount the T-Hex Mecha, all newly spawned minions on your team will gain the Hand of Baron buff for a set duration. The buff's effects scale with game time.

 The T-Hex Mecha also grants the Hand of Baron buff to nearby minions, which has the same effects as the buff granted to newly spawned minions. The buff does not stack.

 The Hand of Baron buff reduces the champion damage that minions take: 60–70% → 45–60%

 Baron buff reduces 20% of damage taken by ally minions from enemy minions.

 HEX RIFT SCUTTLER
 [New] Mechanics
 After the Rift Scuttler is slain, all allied champions who participated in the takedown during the last 8 seconds before the kill will receive a shared 25% gold bonus on its bounty.

 [Adjusted] Mechanics (Normal modes only)
 For the first 7 minutes and 30 seconds of the game, Rift Scuttler mechanics will remain unchanged.

 Rift Scuttlers that spawn after 7 minutes 30 seconds into the game will evolve into a stronger version that grants new effects upon takedown: Rift Scuttlers in the Baron lane: Spawns a Speed Shrine that grants vision and bonus Movement Speed. It also opens a gate at the back of the Baron pit, which can only be accessed by the team that slays it.
 Rift Scuttlers in the Dragon lane: Spawns a Speed Shrine that grants vision and bonus Movement Speed. This Speed Shrine periodically moves up and down the river.

 HEXTECH TOOL KIT
 [New] Mechanics
 Hextech Tool Kit refresh mechanics in the jungle:
 Every 100 seconds in the early game (from 1 minute 10 seconds to 8 minutes 30 seconds into the game and while neither team has an outer turret destroyed yet), a Hextech Tool Kit mark will be added to a monster in each team's jungle. Monsters that can be marked include: Red Brambleback, Blue Sentinel, Greater Murk Wolf, Crimson Raptor, Ancient Krug, and Gromp. Epic monsters and Rift Scuttlers will not be marked.

 When your jungle's marked monster is killed by an allied champion, it drops a Hextech Tool Kit that despawns after 20 seconds. Picking it up grants a random Hextech Tool.

 The markers for the monster in your jungle (displayed on the minimap and as an indicator on the monster itself) are only visible to your team. The marked monster only drops a Hextech Tool Kit when killed by allied champions.

 Marks last for 50 seconds. If the marked monster is not killed within the time limit, the mark will disappear. If the monster is engaged in combat when the mark expires, the mark will remain until the monster exits combat.

 Picking up a new Hextech Tool Kit will replace the old one if they already have one.

 Hextech Tool Kit cannot provide the same item consecutively

 The same player in a single game will only pick up the Siege Cannon once

 [New] Items Jungle Rover Spawns a ward that guards the section of your team's jungle nearest to you.
 When an enemy champion enters the section, the ward pursues and reveals them for three seconds before disappearing.

 If the ward loses the target or if the target leaves the jungle, it detonates and grants vision of nearby enemies for three seconds.

 Hextech Lens Scans a larger area for 10s, warning against hidden enemies, revealing invisible traps, and revealing and disabling nearby enemy wards. While Hextech Lens is active, attacks instantly destroy traps and wards.
 Sweeping Lens and Hextech Lens cannot be active at the same time.

 Hextech Mood Module Target: all allied champions → only yourself
 Health restore: 15% missing health → 15% max health

 IXTALI SCORPION
 [Adjusted] Mechanics
 After summoning the Ixtali Scorpion, you will gain the gold it earns plus the gold and XP from minions that are killed nearby it, even when you're far away from the Ixtali Scorpion.

 PING SYSTEM UPGRADES
 New smart ping button
 The smart ping button can be dragged to interface elements to send related pings (includes abilities, gold farmed, death timer, Baron/Dragon buffs, wards, and more).

 The smart ping button can also be dragged to targets in the environment to send related pings (includes turrets, brush, champions, wards, Red Brambleback, Blue Sentinel, epic monsters, Hexgates, Hextech Tool Kit, and more).

 Upgrade for frequently used pings: Added a feature where the frequently used ping button can be dragged to elements in the environment to send related pings (includes turrets, brush, champions, wards, Red Brambleback, Blue Sentinel, epic monsters, Hexgates, Hextech Tool Kit, and more).

 New ping notifications: When dragging the frequently used ping button and smart ping button to elements (includes the minimap, interface elements, and targets in the environment), a preview of the ping will be displayed, allowing you to check the ping's target and information before sending.

 Removed the old 4-button display

 WARD ALERTS & SWEEPING LENS OPTIMIZATIONS
 [New] Ward alerts
 When an enemy enters the field of vision of a ward that belongs to your team, a timely alert will be sent to allied champions nearby.

 [Optimized] Sweeping Lens
 When a champion uses the Sweeping Lens, a new circular countdown timer will be displayed

 SHOWDOWN
 In Summoner's Rift, you get to select an Ultimate Item at the start of the game, and then build and upgrade it with mission rewards obtained through combat. You can harness the regenerative power of Chemtech Exoskeleton to gain immunity to lethal damage, or activate Pow-Pow & Fishbones to go beyond the limits of your Attack Speed and gain additional strikes. You can use the buff sharing effects of Echoes of the Heart to extend to them the benefits of the buffing abilities you use. Alternatively, if you're feeling lucky, you can also try out the Hextech Arm Cannon or Warden's Power Shield—the random surprises they give can be pretty cool! But beware of surprise attacks from enemies carrying Shimmer as they can ignore obstructive terrain and move freely around the Rift with Phantom Stride, so don't take your eyes off the enemy! Go beyond the standard gameplay to unlock the ultimate evolution, champions!
 RANKED
 MASTER TIER OPTIMIZATIONS
 Starting from Season 15, the Master tier will be split into three divisions.
 New rewards for the two new divisions will be added to the existing seasonal rewards for reaching Master tier, as well as the Master tier rewards in Promotion History.
 RANKED BANNING PHASE ADJUSTMENTS AND OPTIMIZATION
 The banning phase will no longer be available to players ranked Gold and below. They will proceed directly to champion selection after matchmaking is successful.
 PERSONALIZATION
 IN-GAME CHAMPION TAG AND CHAMPION RECOMMENDATION
 Added a champion recommendation feature to Normal and Ranked modes. It recommends champions with similar playstyles based on your Champion Mastery levels and the champion you've selected, helping new players and those looking to try different champions explore other options.
 TITLE OPTIMIZATIONS
 [New] Feature
 A quick-send button for titles has been added in-game. When the conditions for displaying your title in a game are met, you can quickly send it from the Quick Chat messages panel.

 [Optimized] Feature
 Consolidated the multiple entry points from which you can access the screen to adjust title settings. The entry points for title and title background settings have been unified into the "Select title" tab in the list of features in Profile.

 Optimized the title screen to distinguish between Rift Titles and ARAM Titles.

 Added a button that sends you to a screen where you can preview title backgrounds to the Season Rewards screen.

 Optimized title detection: When the title you have selected as the first-in-line to be displayed expires and is no longer usable, the system will check whether your second-in-line title is applicable for use.

 BATTLE ACADEMIA: THEMATIC PATCH OPTIMIZATIONS
 Whenever a new thematic patch goes live, we will be introducing the new or modified gameplay elements through tutorials and missions to ease players into the changes.

 You can also learn about the general gameplay and map changes for each theme in the Rift Adventure Log.

 You can accumulate progress by completing missions. Reaching certain milestones will unlock rewards.

 “LOOK FOR PARTY” OPTIMIZATION
 Added the Pre-Game Party Up feature. If you wish to join a friend's party but they are still in a game, you can send them an advance request to join their party for the next game while waiting for them to finish their current game.

 Party invitation features have been added to the friend list in the lobby, allowing you to invite friends to party up without having to create a party first.

 CUSTOM GALLERY
 Custom Gallery has been upgraded with clearer and more convenient controls.

 Added several new backgrounds for you to get creative with, including Crystal Rose, Garden Party, and more. More backgrounds will be added in future patches, so keep an eye out for them!

 The process for unlocking backgrounds in Custom Gallery is now more player-friendly. You can unlock a background for use if you own half or more of the skins from any of its gallery's skin collections. Tapping the button at the bottom right corner of any locked background allows you to view the conditions for unlocking it.

 A filter for skins has been added to help you quickly find the skins you're looking for. A special mark has also been added to the bottom left of the icons of skins with multiple poses. Be sure to check them out!

 You can now customize your galleries' names, which will also be displayed in the gallery's share image. It's time to show off your masterpieces to your friends!

textBlocks: New Rift, New champion, New skins, New items. Whatever you’re looking for, we got it with patch 5.2!

The fierce battle between Light and Ruin has finally come to an end, dispelling the dark miasma hanging over the Summoner’s Rift. Ingenious Hextech creations have taken over the battlefield, bringing new possibilities to the Summoner’s Rift as they await discovery. What is the most exciting part of this patch for you? The new champion? The new Rift? The new Skin line? Let us know! Welcome to patch 5.2.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW
 NEW CHAMPIONS
 LISSANDRA, THE ICE WITCH
 As the reclusive leader of the Frostguard, many believe Lissandra is a living saint whose followers bring healing and wisdom to the tribes of the Freljord. The truth is perhaps more sinister, as she uses her elemental magic to twist the power of True Ice into something dark and terrible, entombing or impaling any who would reveal her deepest secrets. Indeed, the legacy of her past may yet be the beginning of the end for Runeterra.
 Lissandra will be released on July 18 at 00:01 UTC.
 NEW FEATURES
 RANKED SEASON 14
 We'll be kicking off Ranked Season 14 real soon! In addition to welcoming the new season-exclusive skin, Glorious Crown Ziggs, Glorious Armada Ashe from S11 will also be returning to the Ranked Store. Don't forget to keep a lookout for announcements at the Ranked games portal when S14 starts!
 WILD PASS
 The new Wild Pass, Food Spirits Amumu, will be available after the patch update. Level up your Wild Pass to Lv. 75 to unlock Ascended Food Spirits Amumu and earn lots of rewards while making your way there! What's more, a new Battle Ensign, Food Spirits Amumu, will also be added to the Wild Pass Emporium, along with the limited-time return of Ascended Psychic Detective Ekko, Ascended Dream Raider Thresh, Ascended Dream Raider Nasus, Psychic Detective Ekko, Dream Raider Thresh, Dream Raider Nasus, and Psychic Detective Senna!
 ITEM BUILD RECOMMENDATION
 Recommend an item build to your teammates during a game to help them decide on a build that would better suit the team’s current needs.
 If you’re uncertain about your item build, use Quick Chat to ask your teammates to recommend an item build.
 QR CODES TO TEAM UP
 Scan the lobby QR code or enter the lobby access code to directly join the lobbies!
 LOOK FOR PARTY
 We’ve added the “I Play” option to Party Finder. You can now select the lanes you wish to play as a filter for a list of lobbies that match your preferences.
 When openly recruiting for specific lobbies, the party leader can set tier and lane requirements for a game experience that tailors to their needs better.

 Added a “Search for Party” button in the lobby for quicker access to Party Finder.
 Party Finder will remember your previous filter settings. Each time you enter Party Finder, lobbies will be filtered based on your previous settings

 A new weekly mission: “Look for Party” has been added.
 Every week, get Surprise Energy and other rewards when you play a game that was matchmade through Party Finder.

 FREE TO PLAY
 All previous Champions will be free to play from July 19 to Aug 1! Who are you most excited to try out?
 [HOTFIX] SINGLE PLAYER
 We’ve added a new single player mode where a player teams up with 4 AI allies to fight against 5 AI enemies.
 Single player mode can be played when not connected to the internet, however, you will need internet to login in order to access the game mode.

 After logging in, the game mode can be found under custom games tab.

 EVENTS
 ADVENT OF WINTER
 Winter is coming, and with it, a new event! Play games and complete missions to win prizes!

 The Advent of Winter event begins July 18 at 00:01 UTC
 RIFT ADVENTURE
 Earn Patch Tokens by participating in events throughout Patch 5.2 and redeem them for rewards!
 The Rift Adventure event begins July 18 at 00:01 UTC
 THE RIFT REBORN CHALLENGE
 Explore the New Hexified Summoner’s Rift and complete challenges to win goodies!
 The Rift Reborn Challenge event begins July 18 at 00:01 UTC
The most feared Noxus Commander has not been able to cleave through his enemies as easily as he had hoped. These changes will sharpen his Axe and ready him for battle!
True Damage: 100/200/300 + 75% bonus Attack Damage → 125/250/375 + 75% bonus Attack Damage
We’re adjusting some numbers around Garen to make sure he’s in line with his peers.
Base Health: 650 → 630
Health Regen: (2% + 0.2% per level) missing Health → (1% + 0.3%* per level) missing Health

Cooldown: 8s at all Levels → 9/8.5/8/7.5s

 Duration: 3s at all Levels → 2/2.5/3/3.5s
Damage reduction in the first second: 80% → 70%
We hope she’s even smoother to play now.

Optimized the mechanic where Rend goes into cooldown when Kalista takes down her target with it.

 Optimized the timer displayed at the indicator bar when Kalista is tethered to her ally.

 Optimized the display of the Health threshold where Kalista executes enemy champions with Rend.

 Magic Resistance per Level: 2.5 → 2
Damage: 60/120/180/240 + 50% Ability Power +3/4/5/6% maximum Health of enemy target → 60/115/170/225 + 50% Ability Power + 2/3/4/5% maximum Health of enemy target
Just because she has a broken blade doesn’t mean she should be hitting like a wet paper towel. Now she will be able to pop off against whomever stands against her.
Cooldown: 13s → 12s
Bonus Attack Damage: 20% → 25%

ARAM CHANGES
 GAMEPLAY
 HEXTECH ARAM
 In the Howling Abyss, when players level up at level 3/6/9/12/15, they can choose an Augment to empower themselves.

 ARENA CHANGES
 NEW ARENA SEASON
 NEW SYNERGY SYSTEM
 Each Augment now belongs to a specific Synergy type. Players can gain Synergy powers and become stronger by collecting Augments of the same Synergy type.

 Each Synergy type has 3 quality tiers: Silver, Gold, and Prismatic. The higher the tier, the stronger the effects.

 AUGMENT UPDATES
 Added 15 new Augments, such as the Summoned Creature and Quest series.

 ITEM UPDATES
 Added Soul Weep, Perplexity, Hellfire Hatchet, The Golden Spatula, and other Arena-exclusive items.

 NEW HEXGATE MECHANIC
 Players can now make use of Hexgates to poke opponents and make a comeback when their team is at a disadvantage, allowing more room to devise battlefield strategies.

 PACING CHANGES
 Reduced the Health lost in each round and increased the margin of error for the teams.

 CHAMPION ENDURANCE CHANGES
 Reverted the changes applied to the resistance stats of Tank items.

 Increased boot item stats.

 POWER FLOWER CHANGES
 Consuming Power Flower reduces the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 40% and Ultimate ability by 30%.

 HEXTECH LAB CHANGES
 The following Augments that must be unlocked before they can be used during the last season have been added to the random pool: Pressure Cooker, Ethereal Weapon, Fury Aura, and Clothesline.

 In the new season, the 4 Augments that must be unlocked before they can be used will be replaced with: Quest: Be Steel, Your Heart, Quest: Golden Spatula Winner, Al-turret Ego, and Dying Whispers.

GAMEPLAY CHANGES
 BATTLEFIELD CHANGES
 Hextech innovations join the fray in the Rift! We are bringing fresh challenges to the battlefield in the form of new Hextech Rift Heralds and a Hexified Baron Nashor. After slaying Baron Nashor, a T-Hex Mecha will drop at your team's fountain. Mount the T-Hex Mecha, rally your teammates, and get ready to lead a concerted charge toward the enemy Nexus!
 HEXGATE
 Added a Hexgate at each of the four jungle areas of the Summoner's Rift.

 After the 4:30 mark, players can use the pair of Hexgates in their team's half of the map (red/blue) to teleport from one gate to the other.

 After use, Hexgate will go under cooldown for 40s.

 HEXTECH TOOL KIT
 During the early game (from the 1:10 mark to the 8:00 mark), while both teams' outer turrets have not been destroyed, a Hextech Tool Kit will periodically spawn in each lane where the minion waves meet. If the minion waves do not meet, then it will spawn at another location that is relatively fair to both teams.

 Hextech Tool Kit can be claimed by either team. It lasts for 50 seconds after it spawns and will disappear if it is not opened.

 Picking it up grants a random single-use active Hextech Tool. If not used within 45 seconds, the Tool will automatically expire.
 Super Reactive Reagent: Consume the Super Reactive Reagent. You can now change to a random size and gain the corresponding buff.
 Shrink: Reduces size by 30% and increases Movement Speed by 30% for 7 seconds.

 Enlarge: Increases size by 35%, dealing 15% more damage for 7 seconds.

 Minion Disposal Unit: Instantly kill minion targets, gaining bonus gold and bonus XP.

 Hextech Tracker: Summon 2 Hextech Trackers to pursue nearby enemy champions. On contact, the champion is revealed and slowed by 30% for up to 5 seconds, based on the distance traveled during pursuit.

 Hextech Mood Module: Use the Hextech Mood Module to motivate your teammates. All allied champions gain a small amount of gold and after 3 seconds, restore 15% of their missing Health.

 Siege Cannon: Set up a Siege Cannon that can fire 3 cannonballs at turrets. Each cannonball deals true damage equal to 7% of a turret's max Health.

 Exploding Puppets: Summon an Exploding Puppet that lasts up to 60 seconds. When the puppet is killed by enemies or expires, it detonates in a small area, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

 Deceleration Ray: Place a laser transmitter that shoots out a ray after a short delay, dealing 80 magic damage and slowing enemy champions hit by 30% for 2 seconds.

 RIFT CREATURES
 A new random neutral epic monster, either the Hextech Guerrilla Turret or Hextech Mimic, will spawn at the original location of the Rift Herald 5 minutes into the game.
 HEXTECH GUERILLA TURRET
 Attack
 Single-target ranged attacks that cannot be dodged.

 Apex Laser Cannon
 The Hextech Guerrilla Turret condenses a beam and charges for a short period before firing a laser beam that deals physical damage to enemies in a line.

 Imprecise Strike Missiles
 The Hextech Guerrilla Turret locks onto an enemy and fires 6 cannonballs around their location. The bombardment deals physical damage.

 Takedown Reward
 Destroy the Hextech Guerrilla Turret to be able to summon it anywhere on the map.

 Once summoned, the Hextech Guerrilla Turret will move toward the nearest minion wave and attack on seeing enemy minions.

 The Hextech Guerrilla Turret preferentially targets enemy turrets over enemy champions.

 The Hextech Guerrilla Turret has a maximum of 100 energy, which begins to deplete the moment it is summoned. Engaging turrets costs 6 energy every second, while attacking other units or being outside of combat consumes 1 energy every second. The Hextech Guerrilla Turret self-destructs once all energy is depleted or when its Health falls to zero.

 [HOTFIX] Base Stats
 Attack Damage: 150 → 185

 HEXTECH MIMIC
 Attack
 Single-target attacks that cannot be dodged.

 Mimic Leap
 The Hextech Mimic leaps up and slams onto the ground, knocking back and dealing physical damage to enemies while becoming stunned itself.

 Mimic Charge
 The Hextech Mimic dashes forward, charging into enemies and dealing physical damage, repeating 3 times.

 Takedown Reward
 Destroy the Hextech Mimic to gain 3 Micro Mimics that follow you around.

 The Hextech Mimic will spawn Hextech Mimic Cores behind outer turrets. Cores despawn after 4 minutes.

 Standing near a Hextech Mimic Core briefly will spawn 3 Micro Mimics that follow you around. The next time you approach an enemy turret, the Micro Mimics will dash toward the turret and detonate themselves to deal damage to the turret.

 You will not be able to activate the Hextech Mimic Cores if you already have Micro Mimics following you around.

 Micro Mimics follow you around for 4 minutes and will disappear if they fail to launch an attack before the time is up.

 BARON NASHOR
 Baron Nashor has undergone Hexification and gains new abilities. Slaying it also grants new rewards.
 Baron Nashor spawns for the first time 12 minutes into the game and respawns 3.5 minutes after each time he is slain.

 Slaying Baron Nashor grants the Hand of Baron buff that boosts the Attack Damage and Ability Power of all allied champions and reduces recall time.

 Slaying Baron Nashor strengthens the cannon minions in your next minion wave.

 Slaying Baron Nashor drops a T-Hex Mecha at your Nexus.

 Attack (Frontal: Shoots laser beams; Rear: Impales enemies behind him with a spike)
 Attacks the nearest unit and reduces their Movement Speed and damage.

 Hextech Pulse
 Emits a pulse that radiates outward, dealing damage and reducing Armor and Magic Resist.

 Hextech Plasma
 Spits out 3 balls of plasma, slowing and dealing damage to enemies in the area where they land.

 Hextech Ray
 Charges briefly before shooting forth 3 rays, dealing considerable damage to enemies hit.

 Tentacle Spikes
 Erects a spike behind him, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies in a cone.

 T-HEX MECHA
 Slaying Baron Nashor drops a T-Hex Mecha at your fountain.
 Players can stand on the T-Hex Mecha to mount and pilot it.

 Champions can pilot the T-Hex Mecha by standing on it for 2 seconds.

 The T-Hex Mecha has its own abilities and Health Stats.

 Once its Health falls to zero or when the Hand of Baron buff expires, the T-Hex Mecha ejects you from the cockpit and disappears.

 Your perspective is elevated when piloting the T-Hex Mecha, and your movements also become slower.

 While enemy debuffs and ally buffs do not affect the T-Hex Mecha, the damage it takes as a percentage of its Health is reduced.

 The T-Hex Mecha deals less damage to neutral monsters. Enemies have vision on you while you pilot the T-Hex Mecha.

 The T-Hex Mecha can empower nearby minions, granting them damage reduction and increasing their Attack Damage.

 Attack
 Fires a barrage of gatling shots.

 Missile Blitz
 Charges up, and after a delay, bombards in a circular area, dealing varying degrees of damage to champions, monsters, and structures.

 Amplifying Field
 Grants Movement Speed/shield buffs to nearby teammates.

 Irontail Sweep
 Sweeps its tail forward in a cone, knocking back enemies.

 [HOTFIX] Cooldown: 15s → 8s

 Laser Ray
 Charges and fires a ray. Can move slowly while casting this ability. Cooldown applies.

 Emergency Evacuation
 When the T-Hex Mecha's Health falls below a certain percentage, the pilot can choose to dismount.

 [HOTFIX] Base Stats

 Ability damage and shield value increase together with Attack Damage of T-Hex Mecha

 Movement Speed: 345 → 360

 BARON PIT AND TERRAIN CHANGES
 Hexification reaches the Baron pit and its surrounding terrain. The region also changes as random neutral epic monsters spawn.

 HEXIFICATION OF MONSTERS AND THEIR CAMPS
 The Hextech style has been applied to non-epic monsters and their camps for a brand-new aesthetic.

 This Hexification of non-epic monsters does not affect their combat mechanics or stats.

 TURRETS

 Health: 3500 → 4000

 IXTALI SCORPION
 Added a minimap countdown and icon for the Ixtali Scorpion.

 Added a VFX for when the champion cannot summon it after being attacked.

 Fixed the issue where the Ixtali Scorpion and Hextech Guerrilla Turret disrupt the Movement Speed boost in the base for players.

 [NEW] ECLIPSE

 Hitting an enemy champion with 2 separate attacks or abilities within 1.8 seconds deals bonus physical damage equal to 6% of the target's Max Health (3% for ranged champions), and grants you a shield that absorbs damage equal to 160 + 40% bonus Attack Damage (80 + 20% bonus Attack Damage for ranged champions) for 2 seconds.  When taking champion damage, gain a non-stacking shield that absorbs damage equal to 30 + 10% of Ability Power + 5% of bonus Health for 3 seconds (for ranged champions, the shield absorbs damage equal to 60% of this value). Triggers every 3 seconds.

 [HOTFIX] Psychic Projector no longer conflicts with Rabadon’s Deathcap

 [NEW] RAVENOUS HYDRA

 REMOVAL OF LIGHT AND RUIN THEMATIC ITEMS

 RUNE CHANGES
 INSPIRATION: HEXTECH FLASHTRAPTION
 Channels for 2 seconds and blinks a certain distance, up to 400 units. Channel durations shorter than 1 second still count as 1 second (200 → 150 units ). Cooldown is 20s → 25s

 SYSTEM OPTIMIZATIONS
 CHAMPION SCORE CHANGES
 Lowered the cap on Champion Score obtainable in Ranked and increased the cap on Champion Score obtainable in Legendary Ranked.

 Added "Legendary Ranked Factor" and "Master of Versatility" levels.

 LEGENDARY RANKED OPTIMIZATIONS
 Players with outstanding performance in games will earn a small number of bonus points.

 RIFT GUIDE INTERFACE CHANGES
 Optimized the Rift Guide's display and UX to improve readability and functionality and introduce battlefield mechanics to new players in a way that is easier to understand.

 Updated the Rift Guide with content about new battlefield mechanics: Baron lane map changes, the Ixtali Scorpion, cannon minions, Dragon Soul mechanics, the Ice Dragon, and Hextech-related adjustments.

 Optimized access to the Rift Guide and display of the portal leading to it.

 TUTORIAL OPTIMIZATIONS
 We are introducing a new way of offering tutorials to new players. While keeping the rewards consistent, different tutorials will be offered to players based on their level of gaming experience.

 Improved the laning guide in the champion selection section of the tutorial.

 Adjusted champion selection for new players from the original 5 (Ahri, Master Yi, Jinx, Seraphine, and Garen) to 3 new champions (Annie, Xin Zhao, and Miss Fortune).

 New player tutorials and Battle Academia tutorials will now be unlocked in phases. Some tutorial missions have also been adjusted. Once new player tutorial missions are completed, Battle Academia will be unlocked.

 Some pop-up windows will be removed for players below level 20 to simplify the game's system interface for them.

 Guides introducing the various game modes will be shown to players over time as they level up.

 Added a player guide for core gameplay systems.

 Removed some outdated in-game tips for new players trying out their first few games. We've also adjusted and added some new in-game tips. New players will now trigger in-game tips based on what happens in their games.

 Optimized the Champion Tips interface so that players can learn about champion abilities more quickly.

 Added a handy feature for players to quickly recall and purchase items. When players have sufficient gold to purchase an item, its icon will light up. Tap on the item icon to recall and return to the fountain to complete the purchase. (This feature can be toggled on or off in Settings.)

 FLASH COMBO OPTIMIZATIONS
 Prioritize flashing in the direction of movement for an enemy champion as the target.
 PRE-GAME COMMUNICATION OPTIMIZATIONS
 Added an emote button to allow you and your teammates to easily showcase your personalities.
 If you like the skin that your teammate is using, tap on them and let them know. There's no need to be stingy with compliments!
 PURCHASE OF RUINATION STORY CHAPTERS
 The story of Kalista, Spear of the Argent Throne, may have ended, but if you haven't unlocked all the chapters, don't worry! You can still purchase and read them in Patch Collections.

patches.title: Wild Rift Patch Notes 5.1c

championChanges.summary: Zed is not doing so hot compared to other assassins, especially in the early game. We’re tweaking some of his numbers to ensure he’s keeping up.

changes.text: Damage of the mark: 25/40/55% damage dealt while the mark is active → 30%/42.5%/55% damage dealt while the mark is active

championChanges.summary: Wukong hasn’t been able to clear Jungle camps as fast as other Junglers, resulting in him lagging behind. These changes will make sure he’s able to keep up the pace so he can better help out his lanes as well.

You know when you shuffle your feet and then touch a door handle? That little static shock is what playing Kennen has been feeling like lately. Not ideal. We’re buffing his base stats as well as his damage and cooldown so he can really bring the tempest.

changes.text: Passive damage: 35/45/55/65 + 70/80/90/100% Attack Damage + 30% Ability Power → 45/55/65/75 + 70/80/90/100% Attack Damage + 30% Ability Power

championChanges.summary: As an offensive support, Rakan is more fragile than a baby bird (with prettier feathers). How can we expect him to fly into the enemies when he’s crumbling so easily? We’re tweaking his numbers so he can finally soar.

changes.text: Shield value: 35/70/105/140 + 65% Ability Power → 50/80/110/140 + 65% Ability Power

championChanges.summary: Diana’s been feeling a little underwhelming lately. I guess the recent eclipse is pretty distracting. We’re gonna make sure her spells still pack a punch though.

changes.text:
Damage: 25/40/55/70 + 20% Ability Power → 25/40/55/70 + 25% Ability Power
 Shield value: 40/60/80/100 + 40% Ability Power → 50/70/90/110 + 40% Ability Power
 Increase in shield value after 3rd sphere detonation : 40/60/80/100 + 40% Ability Power → 50/70/90/110 + 40% Ability Power

championChanges.summary: All that armor on her isn’t just for looks! It should mean something, so we’re buffing Vi’s survivability to make sure she can go toe to toe with any enemy Junglers that come her way.

Shyvana is a champion that needs time and farm to ramp up to reach her final form. However, the overall speed of the game recently has been outpacing her. We’re buffing her numbers to make sure she’s able to keep up.

changes.text: Grants 12 → 15 stacks of Draconic Bloodline by taking down enemy champions, slaying the Rift Herald or Baron Nashor
Damage per second: 35/50/65/80 + 30% bonus Attack Damage → 40/55/70/85 + 30% bonus Attack Damage

championChanges.summary: Gragas has not been performing up to par so we are making him a little tankier to be suitable for any situation the Rift might throw at him.

textBlocks: Look out Maokai saplings incoming!

Look! Up in the sky! It’s a bird! It’s a plane! It’s Maokai’s sapling aimed straight at you! Hope you weren’t sitting in a bush or anything. Let’s find somewhere comfy to go over the rest of this patch note. We have some fun new game modes to try out, a brand new Wild Pass to grind, and our regularly scheduled balance changes. Welcome to Patch 5.1c!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 MAOKAI, THE TWISTED TREANT

 Maokai is a rageful, towering treant who fights the unnatural horrors of the Shadow Isles. He was twisted into a force of vengeance after a magical cataclysm destroyed his home, surviving undeath only through the Waters of Life infused within his heartwood. Once a peaceful nature spirit, Maokai now furiously battles to banish the scourge of unlife from the Shadow Isles and restore his home to its former beauty.

 Maokai will be released on June 14 at 00:01 UTC.

 NEW FEATURES

 ARENA: RUINOUS MIGHT

 We got a new NPC and some new augments! Come try it out!

 Arena: Ruinous Might will be available on June 6

 URF x LEAGUE OF DRAVEN

 You’re Draven and they’re Draven and everyone is Draven!

 Urf x League of Draven will be available on June 17

 EVENTS

 MAOKAI’S TRIVIA

 New champion alert! Complete missions to earn goodies!

 The Maokai’s Trivia event begins June 14 at 00:01 UTC

 NOW SHOWING: ROTATING MODES

 Try out our line up of different games modes such as PVP, ARAM, Ranked and special game modes such as URF and One For All and earn goodies!

 The Now Showing: Rotating Modes event begins June 17 at 00:01 UTC

 WILD PASS SPRINT

 Login and complete Wild Pass missions to earn prizes!

 The Wild Pass Sprint event begins June 21 at 00:01 UTC

patches.title: Wild Rift Patch Notes 5.1b

championChanges.summary: Our resident lonely mummy has been finding it difficult to deal effective damage, both to Jungle creeps and in team fights. These changes will make sure his tears are a lot more substantial now.
It’s been difficult approaching Asol considering his range. We’re adjusting the numbers on his skills to make sure he remains a reasonable opponent.

changes.text:
Maximum range of starfire: 750~902 → 750~848

 Movement speed during Breath of Light: 155 → 133

championChanges.summary: Brand is a glass canon that can shatter as soon as an enemy looks at him late game. We’re improving his survivability to make sure he’s able to set the Rift aflame.
Garen has not been doing so hot in the laning phase lately. These changes will make sure he’s able to fully scale during laning phase and contribute to later team fights.

changes.text: Health regeneration: (1+ champion level × 0.2)% lost health → (2 + champion level × 0.2) % lost health

Duration of damage reduction: 2/3/4/5s → 4s at all levels

 Damage reduction at the 1st second: 70% → 80%

championChanges.summary: Graves is getting some tweaks so he can pop off harder with the new Infinity Edge!

changes.text: Damage of each bullet increased by equipping with Ruin - Infinity Edge: 40% → 50%
Damage of the first phase: 45/65/85/105+80% bonus AD → 55/75/95/115 + 80% bonus AD

championChanges.summary: Jarvan IV is primed for fighting at all stages of the game, but he’s been looking fragile recently. We’re tweaking his defensive stats so he can stay standing on business.

changes.text:
Shield: 80/120/160/200 + 4% maximum health + number of enemy units nearby × 1.6/1.9/2.2/2.5% maximum health → 100/140/180/220 + 5% maximum health + number of enemy units nearby × 1.6/1.9/2.2/2.5% maximum health

 Slow: 20/25/30/35% → 30/35/40/45%
Attack speed increased by active ability casting: 20/25/30/35% → 25/30/35/40%

championChanges.summary: Kayle is getting some base stat buffs to help her get through early and mid game smoothly while maintaining her power as a strong late game champion.

changes.text: Active damage: (8/9/10/11% + 0.02% AP) lost health → (9/10/11/12% + 0.02%AP) lost health

championChanges.summary: Kayn has been dealing way too much damage recently. We’re adjusting his numbers to bring him back down to earth.
We’re further optimizing Meditate so you can sustain damage reduction even if its channeling is interrupted. This will give Master Yi more opportunities to show off his swordsmanship in team fights.

changes.text: [New] Damage reduction effect during the first 0.5s of channeling will continue after the channeling is interrupted
True damage from attacks: 35/45/55/65 + 30% bonus AD → 40/45/50/55 + 25% bonus AD

championChanges.summary: Miss Fortune is getting an overhaul to her passive, Double Up and Strut! We hope these changes will make her feel smoother to play as she chases down her enemies. Miss Fortune’s rework will be live on May 30 at 00:01 UTC

changes.text:
[Removed] Deals bonus physical damage when attacking a new enemy target

 [New] Applies Love Tap when attacking enemy champions or epic monsters. At 3 stacks, increases Miss Fortune's damage to the target by 8% (increasing with champion level)
[New] The second hit from Double Up will Critically Strike and apply 3 stacks of Love Tap

[Removed] Active: Triggering Love Tap during the cooldown of Strut reduces the cooldown by 2s

 [New] Active: Attacking targets with full stacks of Love Tap reduces the remaining cooldown of Strut by 1s.

championChanges.summary: Pyke stun lasts a long time, making it difficult to play around. We’re changing how long it lasts to ensure fair counterplay.

changes.text: Stun time: (1.5+1.5% Armor Penetration)s → (1.25+1% Armor Penetration)s

championChanges.summary: Rammus is getting a speed boost so he can zoom around the Rift and help his laners faster!

changes.text: Rolling movement speed: 35 + champion level × 2 → 60+ champion level × 1
Movement speed increases by: maximum 105% + level × 5% → maximum 115% + level × 5%

championChanges.summary: Riven is getting a reset on her ult so you can have the dream Riven highlight clip you’ve also been dreaming of hitting! (Check your replay!) Riven’s rework will be live on May 30 at 00:01 UTC

changes.text: [New] During Blade of the Exile, every takedown of a target resets the number of Wind Slash casts she has and extends this ability's duration for 3s more, up to 12s.

championChanges.summary: We’re improving Swain’s base stats and damage so he can shine in both laning and team fights.

changes.text:
Base Magic Resist: 32 → 36

 Magic Resist per level: 1.5 → 2

Damage of the first bolts: 50/80/110/140+ 38% AP → 55/85/115/145 + 42% AP

 Damage of each subsequent bolt: 10/20/30/40 + 5% AP → 10/20/30/40 + 7% AP

championChanges.summary: Talon is rampaging through the Jungle. We’re making some changes so his opponents can fight back.

changes.text:
Ranged damage: 95/120/145/170 + 100% bonus AD → 75/100/125/150 + 100% bonus AD

 Health regeneration from taking down enemies: 10~70 → 35~70

Damage of the first phase: 60/70/80/90 + 50% bonus AD → 50/60/70/80 + 45% bonus AD

 Damage of the second phase: 60/100/140/180 + 90% bonus AD → 50/90/130/170 + 90% bonus AD

championChanges.summary: Viego can be a lil tricky to play and we’re not afraid to admit that. But we do want players to enjoy the range of complexity that comes with playing the Ruined King. We’re tweaking his abilities and making him easier to maneuver and smoother for his ability casts.

changes.text:
The length of time Viego has to wait to ult after possessing the enemy’s soul: 1.5s → 1s

 Health regen: 2% + 2.5% every 100 bonus Attack Damage + 2% every 100 Ability Power + 5% every 100% bonus Attack Speed → 5% + 4% every 100 bonus Attack Damage + 2% every 100 Ability Power + 5% every 100% bonus Attack Speed

Passive:

 Bonus damage of attacks: 3/4/5/6% target’s current health → 4/5/6/7% target’s current health

 Damage of the second hit: 20% Attack Damage + 15% Ability Power → 30% Attack Damage + 15% Ability Power

 Active:

 Damage: 25/35/45/55 + 70% Attack Damage → 25/35/45/55 + 80% Attack Damage

Minimal stun duration: 0.25s → 0.4s

 Increased size and speed of Black Mist

Cast range: 425 → 500

 Duration of precast animation: 0.5s → 0.37s

 Radius of damage range: 275 → 300

 Bonus damage: (12/16/20 +5% bonus AD)% target’s missing health → (12/16/20+7.5% bonus AD)% target’s missing health

textBlocks: Spoiler alert we are shipping not one, but two champion reworks this patch! Tune in and check it out.

Ok, no new champion this patch, but we are cooking up something else. We have a new mode for Final Stand coming out, new events, a new skin line, and not one but two champion reworks! Welcome to patch 5.1b.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW

 NEW FEATURES

 FINAL STAND: CHALLENGE MODE

 Were you playing Final Stand and thought to yourself, gee I wish this could go on forever? Now it can, with Challenge Mode! Continue your adventure as Kalista and see how long you can last against the Iron Order.

 Final Stand: Challenge Mode will be available on May 16.

 JOURNEY TO MASTERY

 Miss Fortune and Riven are getting an overhaul in this patch! Try them out and earn rewards like Poro Energy!

 The Journey to Mastery event begins May 30 at 00:01 UTC
 PRIDE 2024

 Show off how you celebrate Pride with us. We have a new event, emblem, icon, and chests! Visit Riot's Community Pride Hub all month long where we'll be celebrating you - the fan artists, cosplayers, streamers, and community groups that make our communities sparkle. Keep your eyes peeled for the link to come!

 The Pride 2024 event begins June 1 at 00:01 UTC

textBlocks: Come one come all, It’s Viego time.

Long have we awaited, our favorite Ruined Monarch is finally here on the Rift (soon™). And with him, a first for Wild Rift: Final Stand, our newest PvE mode. If that wasn’t enough, we’ve got new events, skins, and Companions. Last but not least, your regularly scheduled balance updates are here as well. Welcome to patch 5.1a.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 VIEGO, THE RUINED KING

 Once ruler of a long-lost kingdom, Viego perished over a thousand years ago when his attempt to bring his wife back from the dead triggered the magical catastrophe known as the Ruination. Transformed into a powerful, unliving wraith tortured by an obsessive longing for his centuries-dead queen, Viego now stands as the Ruined King, controlling the deadly Harrowings as he scours Runeterra for anything that might one day restore her, and destroying all in his path as the Black Mist pours endlessly from his cruel, broken heart.

 Viego will be released on May 8 at 00:01 UTC.

NEW FEATURES
 FINAL STAND

 Our first PVE mode is here! Play as Kalista as she fights off waves of the Iron Order. Will you be the last one standing? Of course, we also have missions to complete and goodies to claim!

 Final Stand will be available on April 30 at 00:01 UTC.

 EVENTS

 INK SPLENDOR

 Play games, complete missions, and earn goodies such as Skin Vouchers, Rift Emblem, and Kill Bauble!

 The Ink Splendor event begins April 28 at 00:01 UTC

 LEGACY OF THE EAST

 Looking for the opportunity to finally get your hands on Jade Dragon Wukong (Special Edition) or Dragon Fist Lee Sin (Special Edition)? Now’s your chance! Not feeling those two? We also have the Calligraphia pool available for draws. The first 5x roll will have a guaranteed premium reward! For drop rates, head to our Player Support page .

 The Legacy of the East event begins April 28 at 00:01 UTC

 SPENDER’S SPLENDOROUS GIFTS

 During the event period when you reload on Wild Cores, reaching milestone amounts will earn you rewards such as Skin Vouchers, Calligraphia Keys, and more!

 The Spender’s Splendorous Gifts event begins April 28 at 00:01 UTC

 VIEGO’S ARRIVAL

 Join us in welcoming Viego’s arrival with his new event! Complete missions and earn rewards!

 The Viego’s Arrival event begins May 8 at 00:01 UTC

textBlocks: Join Kalista and sail into Patch Notes 5.1!

Shadow and mists are creeping over the Rift, and we’re here to take you along for the ride! Dive deeper into the lore of Ruination, starting with our favorite speared mistress, Kalista. We have gameplay changes decked out in misty themes, a new ranked season, and a new skin line that’s sure to pack a punch. Welcome to Patch 5.1!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

HOTFIX

 KALISTA

 Kalista is hot off the press but needs to be hotter in Lane. She's also struggling to keep up in team fights. We’re tweaking some numbers to ensure her spears will deliver her vengeance!

 Base Stats
 Attack Damage per level: 3 → 3.5
 Health per level: 104 → 120

 (1) Pierce
 Damage: 50/110/170/230 + 105% Attack Damage → 60/125/190/255 + 105% Attack Damage

 (3) Rend
 Initial Damage: 15/30/45/60 + 65% Attack Damage → 30/45/60/75 + 70% Attack Damage
 Damage of each following spear: 7/11/15/19 + 26/28/30/32% Attack Damage → 10/15/20/25 + 30/34/38/42% Attack Damage
 LIGHT - HORIZON FOCUS

 Horizon Focus has been doing too much damage so we are adjusting its numbers slightly.

 Hypershot
 Damaging an enemy champion with an ability from 600 units away reveals them for 6 seconds and increases damage dealt to them by 12% → 9%
 LIGHT - INFINITY ORB

 Infinity Orb’s price isn’t accurately reflecting the amount of value offered so we’ve adjusted it as well.

 Base Stats
 Cost: 3200 → 3400g
 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 KALISTA, THE SPEAR OF VENGEANCE

 A specter of wrath and retribution, Kalista is the undying spirit of vengeance, an armored nightmare summoned from the Shadow Isles to hunt deceivers and traitors. The betrayed may cry out in blood to be avenged, but Kalista only answers those willing to pay with their very souls. Those who become the focus of Kalista's wrath should make their final peace, for any pact sealed with this grim hunter can only end with the cold, piercing fire of her soul-spears.

 Kalista will be released on April 11 at 00:01 UTC.

 WILD PASS

 Make a big splash with Food Spirits Fizz, our newest Wild Pass! Ascended Food Spirits Fizz awaits you at level 75. There will also be a new Battle Ensign available in the Wild Pass Emporium, along with a limited-time return of Hexplorer Galio, Hexplorer Shyvana, Hexplorer Tristana, Stargazer Karma, and Ascended Stargazer Karma!

 RANKED SEASON 13

 Glorious Crown Braum will be kicking off Ranked Season 13! Joining him will be Glorious Armada Jarvan IV, our Season 10 skin, available through the Ranked Store.

 EVENTS

 RUINATION: KALISTA’S ODYSSEY

 Join Kalista and travel deep into the heart of the Shadow Isles. Unlock narrative comics to witness the Blessed Isle’s storied transformation into Shadow Isles.

 The Ruination: Kalista’s Odyssey event begins April 12 at 00:01 UTC

 PRESENTS FOR PRESENCE

 Login daily and claim prizes like Blue Motes and Orange Gemstones!

 The Presents for Presence event begins April 21 at 00:01 UTC

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 NEW ITEMS

 TERMINUS

 Base Stats

 Total price: 3200g

 Attack Damage: 40

 Attack Speed: 30%

 Build Path

 Recurve Bow (1400g) + B. F. Sword (1500g) + 300g

 Shadow

 Attacks deal 35 bonus magic damage on-hit.

 Juxtaposition

 Alternate between Light and Dark on-hits when attacking. Light attacks grant 5-8 Armor and Magic Resist for 5 seconds on hit. Dark attacks grant 11% Armor Pen and Magic Pen for 5 seconds on hit. Each on-hit effect stacks up to 3 times.

 REMOVED ITEMS

 HULLBREAKER

 ITEM CHANGES

 NEEDLESSLY LARGE ROD

 Base Stats

 BLASTING WAND

 THEME: LIGHT AND RUIN

 As blessings wane, darkness spreads. The Black Mist shrouding the Shadow Isles expands, encroaching into the Rift. This dark miasma not only saps the vitality of the surrounding plants but also affects some player items.

 Weapons charged with mist from the Shadow Isles now possess an even more destructive power, but also inflict a powerful backlash on the wielder.

 To counter the darkness and protect the Rift, followers of light have infused their weapons with benisons, enhancing them with the power of light to rival the forces of ruin.

 Ability Power: 80 → 90

 Maximum Health: 150 → 0

Marked enemies are revealed and detonated at 3 stacks, inflicting a new mark and dealing 90 + 25% Ability Power as magic damage to the target.

 LIGHT - HARMONIC ECHO

 Harmonic Echo

 Moving and casting abilities builds Harmony. At 100 Harmony, your next healing or shielding ability cast on an ally restores 130 → 135 + 10% Ability Power as Health to your target and up to 3 nearby allied champions.

 [New] Every 10 Ability Haste you have increases healing by 1%.

 LIGHT - RIFTMAKER

 Base Stats

 Cost: 3200g → 3300g

 Ability Power: 80 → 90

 [New] Fiendish Codex (100g) + Hextech Alternator (1400g) + Amplifying Tome (500g) + 400g

 Void Corruption

 When in combat with champions, gain 1 stack of Corruption every second. Each stack increases the damage you deal by 3% → 2.5% , up to 3 → 4 stacks. At maximum stacks, the additional damage provided by Corruption becomes true damage

 LIGHT - YOUMUU’S GHOSTBLADE

 Base Stats

 Cost: 3000g → 3200g

 Momentum

 Moving builds Momentum, granting up to 40 → 50 Movement Speed and 5-10 Armor Pen at 100 stacks. Attacking removes all Momentum, but Armor Pen will last for 3 seconds after .

 LIGHT - DAWNSHROUD

 Base Stats

 Cost: 2700g → 3000g

 Dawnbringer

 If you are within 400 units of an enemy champion, and you immobilize a champion or are immobilized, reveal all nearby enemy champions for 3 seconds and deal 80 + 5% bonus Health as magic damage, and heal yourself for the same amount for 3s . (3s cooldown)

 RUIN - RABADON’S DEATHCAP

 Base Stats

 Ability Power: 100 → 90

 Overkill

 Increases Ability Power by 20 - 45% → 20 - 55% (based on level)

 [New] Cinders

 Reduces your base Health by 10 - 100.

 RUIN - BLADE OF THE RUINED KING

 Base Stats

 Cost: 3200g → 3000g

 Thirst

 +10% → 12% Physical Vamp

 Ruined Strikes

 Attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 7% of the enemy's current Health on-hit. (Melee attacks deal 10% → 9% ). Minimum damage: 15. Maximum damage vs. monsters: 60.

 Reduces your base Health by 10 - 100.

 RUIN - INFINITY EDGE

 Base Stats

 Cost: 3400g → 3200g

 Infinity

 Critical Strikes deal 205% → 225% damage instead of 175%.

 Reduces your base Health by 10 - 100.

 [New] Withering

 Reduces your Attack Damage by 1 - 15

 RUIN - WARMOG’S ARMOR

 Warmog's Heart

 If you have at least 950 → 1150 bonus Health and have not taken any damage during the last 6 → 4 , restore 5% maximum Health per second.

 [New] Strength of Will

 Restores 0.3% max Health per second.
