 Reduces your Attack Damage by 1 - 15.

 RUIN - STERAK’S GAGE

 Sterak's Fury

 Triggering Lifeline increases size, empowers you, removes all crowd control effects on you (except Airborne), and grants 30% → 50% Tenacity for 8 → 4 seconds

 [New] Guilt Bearer

 Reduces your Movement Speed by 5

 NEW RUNES

 [NEW] KEYSTONE: EMPOWERMENT

 Hitting an enemy champion with 3 consecutive attacks deals 40-180 bonus adaptive damage and makes them Vulnerable, increasing all damage they take by 8% for 6 seconds.

 Once Vulnerable, your attacks to the target deal 6-20 bonus true damage. When the target exits the Vulnerable state, Vulnerability enters cooldown and cannot be applied to any enemy for the next 6 seconds.

 [NEW] KEYSTONE: ARCANE COMET

 Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location. When a comet hits an enemy champion, the next comet's damage increases. (8-16s cooldown)

 Damage: (30 to 100) + (Total hits on enemy champions) + 35% bonus Attack Damage + 20% Ability Power

 [NEW] RESOLVE: ONSLAUGHT

 Gain 5% Tenacity plus additional Tenacity based on the number of enemy champions alive nearby. Total gainable Tenacity is capped at 20%.

 [NEW] DOMINATION: PSYCHIC WAVE

 The next attack after damaging a champion with an ability, and vice versa, creates an explosion that deals adaptive damage ((22 to 50) + 15% bonus Attack Damage + 7.5% bonus Ability Power) in a small area. Deals 70% damage when used by Ranged champions. (6s cooldown)

 RUNE CHANGES

 DOMINATION: EMPOWERED ATTACK

 Every 10 → 8 seconds, the next attack will be empowered, dealing 35-50 bonus adaptive damage (against champions only) .

 REMOVED RUNES

 Keystone: Kraken Slayer

 GAMEPLAY

 IXTALI SCORPION

 An elemental magic circle has been added to the alcove in the Baron lane.

 Between 2 minutes to 12 minutes, champions can summon the Ixtali Scorpion into the battlefield when they stand on the magic circle for a short time.

 The Ixtali Scorpion uses ranged AoE attacks and assists players in pushing lanes when summoned. All gold gains obtained go to the champion that summoned it.

 The Ixtali Scorpion can be summoned again 75 seconds after its death.

 RUINED FRUIT

 Scryer’s Bloom, Blast Cone, and Cryoblossom can also become Ruined, resulting in a Ruined Fruit when they spawn. After being destroyed, Ruined Fruit generates a cloud of green smoke for 7s. Ally Champions will be in stealth in the green smoke. Enemy champions will not be in stealth in the smoke. If vision is provided in the smoke, ally champions will be revealed.

 SLOW RESIST

 Adjusted the interaction between slow and slow resist effects in some champions' abilities.

 The slow effect from Tryndamere's Mocking Shout is now affected by slow resist.

 The slow effect that Blitzcrank applies to himself in Overdrive is now affected by slow resist.

 Self-applied slow effects caused by abilities are not affected by slow resist for other champions.

 Slow effects caused by Fear, Charm, or when the target is pulled towards a direction are not affected by slow resist.

 When slow is applied multiple times, slow resist will be calculated individually for each instance of slow first. The final slow effect will then be calculated based on the total number of slow stacks the champion has.

 SUPER LONG-RANGE ABILITY DISPLAY

 Targets within the range indicator of super long-range abilities (e.g., Lux's Final Spark, Jinx's Super Mega Death Rocket!, and Ezreal's Trueshot Barrage) will trigger the ability mini-cam. If multiple enemies are within the range indicator at the same time, the mini-cam will display the enemy nearest to the champion.

 GAME EFFECTS OPTIMIZATIONS

 STRATEGY PANEL OPTIMIZATIONS

 The strategy panel now opens up to the Scoreboard tab by default.

 SITUATIONAL SMART QUICK CHAT MESSAGES

 Quick Chat messages will be generated and recommended in real-time based on factors including but not limited to the champion you are using, the lane you are in, enemy activity, which stage of the game you are in, and how much gold you have.

 When recommended Quick Chat messages are available for you in a particular setting, they will be displayed in the Quick Chat section.

 No more than 2 smart in-game Quick Chat messages will be recommended at any one time.

 Smart in-game Quick Chat messages will not overwrite the Quick Chat messages you have set outside of a game. They can be scrolled along with Quick Chat messages set by other players.

 FLASH COMBO

 Added a toggle for Flash Combo in Settings.

 SKINS

 Soul Fighter Kalista

 Releasing April 11 @ 00:01 UTC

 Soul Fighter Gwen

 Releasing April 11 @ 00:01 UTC

 Soul Fighter Jhin

 Releasing April 11 @ 00:01 UTC

 Releasing April 11 @ 00:01 UTC

 Releasing April 11 @ 00:01 UTC

 Glorious Crown Braum

 Releasing April 12 @ 00:01 UTC

EXTRA BITS

 Fixed the issue where if players tap the cheering up Poro icons in the loading screen, the in-game chatbox may not appear.

 Fixed the issue where casting Flash in the direction of the target knocked Airborne by Jarvan IV's Demacian Standard-Dragon Strike combo causes the target's Airborne indicator bar to reset.

 Fixed the issue where Aurelion Sol's Singularity can be used to kill a summoned Rift Herald.

 Fixed the issue where Warwick follows Aurelion Sol's movement after clamping on to him with Jaws of the Beast while Aurelion Sol is dashing with Astral Flight.

 Fixed the issue where damage from Zoe's First Strike would awaken targets she had put to sleep.

 Fixed the issue where Lux's allies do not receive the second phase of Prismatic Barrier's shielding when it is cast at maximum distance.

textBlocks: Welcome to Patch 5.0c!

Time flies! Look at that, we are on the last patch of 5.0! We got not one, not two but three events for you this patch! As well as a new champion, some new skins, and of course, our regularly scheduled balance changes. Welcome to patch 5.0c.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 KINDRED, THE ETERNAL HUNTER

 Separate, but never parted, Kindred represents the twin essences of death. Lamb's bow offers a swift release from the mortal realm for those who accept their fate. Wolf hunts down those who run from their end, delivering violent finality within his crushing jaws. Though interpretations of Kindred's nature vary across Runeterra, every mortal must choose the true face of their death.

 Kindred will be released on March 29 at 00:01 UTC

 EVENTS

 NAUTILUS PASS

 Wards on the streets are saying there’s a new Warden in town! Play through missions and earn rewards!

 The Nautilus Pass event begins March 21 at 00:01 UTC

 KINDRED’S TRIVIA

 Spoiler alert, Kindred is coming out this patch! (It’s still a spoiler if you skipped the previous section.) Show off your knowledge and earn rewards!

 The Kindred’s Trivia event begins March 29 at 00:01 UTC

 NAME THAT CHAMPION

 Kindred is tumbling through the Rift, and trailing behind them is a new champion! Careful now, don’t get too close or you might get poked. You can earn guesses through completing missions, and if you guess correctly, there’s a big prize waiting!

 The Name That Champion event begins March 29 at 00:01 UTC

[HOTFIX] Kindred has tumbled onto the Rift and been delivering death in both Lanes and Jungle alike, dominating in games. We’re dialing back their early damage so their opponents are able to fight back.

Base Attack Damage: 70 → 66

 Base Armor: 40 → 37

 Base Health: 630 → 600
Damage: 65/90/115/140 + 70% bonus Attack Damage → 50/75/100/125 + 70% bonus Attack Damage

Damage of Wolf’s Pounce: 80/105/130/155 + 70% bonus Attack Damage + target (8 + 1* stack(s) of Mark of the Kindred) % missing Health → 80/105/130/155 + 70% bonus Attack Damage + target(8+0.5* stack(s) of Mark of the Kindred) % missing Health

 Damage of Wolf’s Pounce on target with low health：80/105/130/155+70% bonus Attack Damage + target (12+1.5* stack(s) of Mark of the Kindred) % missing Health → 80/105/130/155 + 70% bonus Attack Damage + target (12+0.75* stack(s) of Mark of the Kindred) % missing Health
We’re buffing Braum’s damage so he can protect his team better both in the early game, as well as in teamfights later on. Now when he shouts, “stand behind me!” You can trust he will stay there.

Base Attack Damage: 54 → 58

 Base Mana: 300 → 380
Time of stunning: 1~1.5s → 1.25~1.75s

Damage Reduction: 28/32/36/40% → 35/40/45/50%

 Bonus Movement Speed: 10% → 15%
Graves hasn’t been measuring up against other Junglers, especially when he falls behind in items. We’re tweaking some numbers around so he can keep up.

Base Attack Damage: 64 → 66

 Base Health: 570 → 630
Jayce hasn’t been as impactful in the later stages of the game like we hoped. These changes will improve his survivability so he can hammer through more teamfights.

Base Mana: 345 → 420

 Base Health per level: 112 → 120

 Base Armor per level: 4.3 → 5
Shock Blast Cooldown: 8s → 7.5s
His AOE damage has been through the roof lately. We’re adjusting the numbers to make sure he’s consistent with his opponents.

Bonus Movement Speed: 110% → 100%

 Damage: 70/125/180/235 + 70% Ability Power → 60/110/160/210 + 70% Ability Power
Damage per 0.5s: 30/60/90 + 15% Ability Power → 20/55/90 + 13% Ability Power
Lee Sin is able to gain advantages early and deal massive amounts of damage to his enemies. These changes will give his opponents a chance to catch their breath.
Base Health: 650 → 630
Damage: 100/300/500 + 200% bonus Attack Damage + 10/13/16% target’s maximum Health → 100/250/400 + 200% bonus Attack Damage + 10/13/16% target’s maximum Health
We’ve buffed Morgana’s ability to protect her teammates so she can shine both as a damage dealer and a support. We are also tweaking her damage to monsters so she’s more in-line with other Junglers.
Damage to monsters: 225% → 195%
Duration: 4s → 5s
Nautilus hasn’t been as tanky as he should be. These changes will let him soak up all the damage he needs to for his carries to shine.

Shield value: 55/65/75/85 + 11/12/13/14% maximum Health → 55/65/75/85 + 12/13/14/15% maximum Health

 Damage: 40/50/60/70 + 40% Ability Power → 50/60/70/80 + 40% Ability Power
Our blossoming popstar could use some more limelight. These changes will help her reach the stardom she deserves late games!

Cooldown: 23/20/17/14s → 22/19/16/13s

 Bonus Movement Speed: full level 20% → 20/22.5/25/27.5%

 Shield: 60/80/100/120 + 40% Ability Power → 60/90/120/150 + 35% Ability Power

 Healing: 6.5% + 0.01% Ability Power→ 7.5% + 0.01% Ability Power
We are toning down Syndra’s damage so she’s not overpowering the other mages in-game. She is still going to be a strong late game carry, but not unreasonable to deal with.
Ability Power increases when gaining 120 Splinters of Wrath: 15% → 12%

Our newest Noxian assassin has been clearing the Jungle real fast so we’re nerfing his damage to monsters. We’ve also noticed he’s pretty slow vaulting over walls which is subpar for an assassin of his caliber. Now he’ll be able to go through terrain more flexibly.
Damage to monsters: 120% → 90%
Increase Talon’s speed of vaulting over terrains and turrets by 10%
Who told him he can disable the Nexus?!
Disable no longer applies to enemy Nexus.
The Monkey King is getting his highly anticipated rework this patch! Now he should be able to survive longer in teamfights, deal more damage, and have more room for outplays.
Base Health Regen: 9 → 12

[Removed] Crushing Blow: Attacks apply marks on the target and deal bonus damage from each stack, maximum to 5 stacks.

 [New] Stone Skin: Wukong gains stacks of Stone Skin when he attacks enemy champions with base attacks and abilities. Each stack grants him 10 -18 armor and 1.5% max health regeneration every 5s, up to 3 stacks.

[Removed] Health Regen.

 [New] Passive: Golden Staff adds an empowering effect on Wukong’s base attacks every 12s. Takedowns will reduce Golden Staff’s passive Cooldown by 2s. The Cooldown of the passive will be reduced by 2s per level, and killing enemy champions will refresh the Cooldown.

 Damage of empowered base attack: 40/60/80/100 + 35/40/45/50% Attack Damage → 50/70/90/110 + 35/40/45/50% Attack Damage
[New] Now the clone can move with the joystick control and can mimic (3) Nimbus Strike to dash.

[Removed] Multiple dashes to the same target.

 Damage: 60/95/130/165 + 80% bonus Attack Damage → 80/120/160/200 + 80% bonus Attack Damage

Damage: 220% Attack Damage + 8/12/16% target maximum Health → 220% Attack Damage + 10/14/18% target maximum Health

 Wukong rework will be live on March 21 at 00:01 UTC

Yuumi has been protecting her best friends a little too well. These changes will make sure she’s measuring up against her opponents and allows players to have more decision making power when it comes to her abilities.

Adaptive power: (8/14/20/26 + (5 + 0.25 per level)% bonus Attack Damage) or (16/28/40/52 + (5 + 0.25 per level)% Ability Power) → (8/14/20/26 + (2+ 0.15 per level)% bonus Attack Damage) or (16/28/40/52 + (2 + 0.15 per level)% Ability Power)

Cooldown: 75/65/55s → 85/75/65s

 Root Duration: 1.75s → 1.5s

CHAMPION CHANGES

 How’s everyone liking Doublecast so far? We’re rolling out a few tweaks to some champions to make sure they can all shine equally!

 SYNDRA

 Damage : 100% → 90%

 SAMIRA

 Damage: 107% → 100%

 TWITCH

 Damage: 92% → 100%

 Damage received: 105% → 100%

 DRAVEN

 Damage received: 100% → 90%

 Damage received: 100% → 90%

 Damage received: 100% → 90%

 KAI’SA

 Damage: 97% → 100%

 Damage received: 100% → 95%

 JAYCE

 Damage: 105% → 110%

 ANNIE

 Damage: 100% → 105%

 Damage received: 100% → 95%

 ORIANNA

 Damage: 95% → 100%

 Damage received: 105% → 100%

 HECARIM

 Damage: 85% → 100%

 ZED

 Damage: 90% → 100%

 LEONA

 Damage: 95% → 100%

 Damage received: 105% → 100%

 NASUS

 Damage: 95% → 100%

 Damage received: 100% → 95%

 VLADIMIR

 Damage: 110% → 100%

 SWAIN

 Damage: 100% → 110%

 THRESH

 Damage received: 100% → 90%

 FIDDLESTICKS

 Damage: 100% → 110%

 ORNN

 Damage: 100% → 105%

 Damage received: 100% → 95%

 GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 We’ve noticed the length of some Doublecast games are dragging out too long. The pace of the game can get sluggish, especially in late-game. Meanwhile, the buffs from Baron Nashor and Elder Dragon are not strong enough to push a team to ending the game. We’re tweaking both to make sure players are gaining worthwhile advantages with these buffs.

 THE HAND OF THE BARON BUFF

 Buff Duration

 100s → 120s

 Minion Damage Reduction from nearby Champions

 65% → 67%

 Champion Damage reduction

 5% → 10%

 ASPECT OF THE DRAGON

 Buff Duration

 90s → 120s

 Execution

 Dealing damage to an enemy below 15% → 20% of their maximum health will execute them

 Champion Damage reduction

 5% → 10%

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 ITEMS

 BERSERKER’S GREAVES

 We’re buffing the cost efficiency of Berserker’s Greaves to make it a great option for champions that rely on attacks.

 Base Stats

 Attack Damage: 18 → 20

 Attack speed: 30% → 35%

 DIVINE SUNDERER

 Divine Sunderer hasn’t been offering players the best value for their gold compared to other items. We are adjusting its price and stats to make it consistent with other items.

 Base Stats

 Full price: 3450g → 3400g

 Maximum Health: 400 → 425

 GARGOYLE

 We’re buffing Gargoyle’s active so tanks can effectively use the shield in fights. We’re also changing the damage reduction to disappear when the shield is broken.

 Stoneplate

 Gain a shield absorbs damage of (20% → 25% ) of maximum Health, decaying in 4s (75s Cooldown → 60s Cooldown )

 [New] If the shield breaks early, damage reduction will end.

 SPEAR OF SHOJIN

 Spear of Shojin hasn’t been having a great performance in the early game. We’re buffing its power in lane, while making sure it’s not overpowered for teamfights.

 Dragon Awakening

 Increases Ability Haste of basic abilities by 25% for (8s → 10s ) after casting an Ultimate, and grants (30% → 25% ) bonus Movement Speed that decays over 3s. Scoring a takedown within (8s → 10s ) refreshes the ability's duration. (20s Cooldown)

 [New] Rising Dragon

 +5% Movement Speed

 STORMRAZOR

 Stormrazor has been getting outshined by its fellow marksman items. We’re buffing its passive to make it a more valuable pick up again.

 Paralyze

 Energized Attacks gain (50 - 120 → 65 - 135 ) bonus magic damage and slow enemies by 75% for (0.5s → 0.75s )

 TRINITY FORCE

 Trinity Force’s passive’s name has been changed so it no longer shares the same name as the one Black Cleaver has.

 Rage → Valor

 RUNE CHANGES

 CONTRACTION: HEXTECH FLASHTRAPTION

 The channeling time has been optimized for when it’s been less than 1s.

 [New] When channeled for less than 1s, you will dash the distance as if you channeled for 1s.

 CONTRAPTION: ITEM CRAFTING

 Item crafting has been too expensive to use, so it’s been sitting unpicked, gathering dust. To make it a more appealing pick-up, we are adjusting the amount of gold needed to purchase an item outside.

 Passive

 Generate a stack every 180 seconds. You can buy items outside the fountain, which costs 1 stack and an additional (150 → 50 ) Gold

 SKINS

 Releasing March 21 @ 00:01 UTC

 Releasing March 29 @ 00:01 UTC

 Battle Academia Jayce

 Releasing April 3 @ 00:01 UTC

 Battle Academia Caitlyn

 Releasing April 3 @ 00:01 UTC

textBlocks: Champion changes, item changes, new events, we got it all!

Surprise! We are back two weeks early! We just missed y’all too much. The things announced with the last patch notes will still come out as scheduled (like Talon coming on the 23rd), and we still have lots more in store for you this patch! Fun new events, and your regularly scheduled champion changes. Welcome to patch 5.0b.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

EVENTS

 TOGETHER UNDER THE CRESCENT

 A brand new event is coming up where you can play through missions, gift friends rewards, collect login lanterns, and try out a new mini-game! Join us under the crescent moon, bring a friend and we will see you on the Rift!

 The Together Under The Crescent event begins March 8 at 00:01 UTC

 GAME MODE

 DOUBLECAST

 Who’s ready for double trouble? Double Cast is a whole new way to experience your favorite skills! Now, you can cast the same skill twice, setting up some epic combos. Grease up your fingers and prepare for faster and more thrilling battles!

 Doublecast begins March 8 at 00:01 UTC

textBlocks: February will be a big month for us, and likewise, we got a big patch for you!

February is a month to celebrate family, friends, and DRAGONS! Join us and celebrate how you want, with a new champion, with the new event, or on Arena. That’s right Arena is back! Sit down, grab a drink, and welcome to Patch 5.0A!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 TALON, THE BLADE’S SHADOW

 Talon is the knife in the darkness, a merciless killer able to strike without warning and escape before any alarm is raised. He carved out a dangerous reputation on the brutal streets of Noxus, where he was forced to fight, kill, and steal to survive. Adopted by the notorious Du Couteau family, he now plies his deadly trade at the empire's command, assassinating enemy leaders, captains, and heroes… as well as any Noxian foolish enough to earn the scorn of their masters.

 Talon will be released on February 23 at 00:01 UTC.

championChanges.summary: The long-awaited Aurelion Sol rework is here! These changes will make sure he can deal more effective damage and crowd control during team fights.

changes.text:
[Removed] Center of the Universe
 [New] Cosmic Creator
 [New] Aurelion Sol's damaging abilities turn enemies into Stardust, which in turn empowers his abilities. (1) Breath of Light: This ability's bursts deal additional magic damage equal to (3% of Stardust stacks)% of the target's maximum Health.
 (2) Astral Flight: Increases the maximum flight distance by (62.5% of Stardust stacks)%.
 (3) Singularity: Increases the ability's execution threshold by (2.6% of Stardust stacks)% and its impact area.
 (4) Falling Star/The Skies Descend: Increases the ability's impact area.

[Removed] Starsurge
 [New] Breath of Light
 [New] Aurelion Sol breathes starfire for 3.25 seconds, dealing magic damage equal to (0.5 x (the champion level) + 8/11/14/17 + 12% Ability Power) every 0.2 seconds to the first enemy hit and revealing them. 50% of that damage is dealt to nearby enemies. For every second that the breath hits the same target, Aurelion Sol deals a burst of magic damage equal to (15/20/25/30 (increasing at Levels 5, 9, and 13) + 45/55/65/75 + 35% Ability Power + (3% of Stardust stacks)% of the target's maximum Health). If the target is a champion, Aurelion Sol gains 1 stack of Stardust. Damage dealt based on the target's maximum Health is capped at 100 against monsters. Damage ratio to monsters: 40%
 Aurelion Sol can move slowly while casting Breath of Light.
 At maximum ability level, Breath of Light's duration is extended infinitely.
 When Breath of Light is channeled for fewer than 0.25 seconds, it will go into a 1-second cooldown.

 [HOTFIX] Mana consumption per 0.5s: 10/14/18/22 → 10/12/14/16
 Damage per 0.2s: 0.5 per level + 8/11/14/17 + 12% Ability Power → 0.5 per level + 11/14/17/20 + 12% Ability Power
 Burst damage: 15/20/25/30 (increasing at Levels 5, 9, and 13) + 45/55/65/75 + 35% Ability Power + (3% Stardust stacks)% maximum Health → 15/20/25/30 (increasing at Levels 5, 9, and 13) + 55/65/75/85 + 35% Ability Power + (3% Stardust stacks)% maximum Health

[Removed] Celestial Expansion
 [New] Astral Flight
 [New] Active: Aurelion Sol flies in a direction. While flying, Breath of Light has no cooldown and its damage increases by 112.5%/115%/117.5%/120%. His flight speed is reduced by 50% if Breath of Light is cast while flying. Recast: Ends the flight early.
 If a champion is killed within 3 seconds of taking damage from Aurelion Sol, 90% of this ability's cooldown is refunded.
 Aurelion Sol's flight speed is 300 + 100% Movement Speed.

 [HOTFIX] Cooldown: 22/20/18/16s → 18/17/16/15s

[Removed] Comet of Legend
 [New] Singularity
 [New] Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, dealing (2/3.5/5/6.5 + 5% Ability Power) magic damage every 0.2 seconds. The black hole drags enemies toward the center of the black hole for 5 seconds. Enemies in the center die instantly when below (5 + 2.6% of Stardust stacks)% of their maximum Health.
 As the black hole absorbs Stardust, for every second an enemy champion is trapped within the black hole's range, Aurelion Sol gains a stack of Stardust. When enemies are killed within the black hole's range, Aurelion Sol gains 5 stacks of Stardust for every champion or epic monster killed; 3 stacks of Stardust for every siege minion or large monster killed; and 2 stacks of Stardust for every minion or small monster killed.
 [HOTFIX] Damage per 0.2s: 2/3.5/5/6.5 + 5% Ability Power → 4/5.5/7/8.5 + 5% Ability Power

[Removed] Voice of Light
 [New] Falling Star/The Skies Descend
 [New] Falling Star: Aurelion Sol plucks a star from the heavens and crashes it into the earth, dealing (150/250/350 + 65% Ability Power) magic damage and stunning enemies within range for 1 second. For every enemy champion hit, Aurelion Sol gains 8 stacks of Stardust.
 [New] The Skies Descend: Whenever Aurelion Sol collects 65 stacks of Stardust, the next Falling Star transforms into The Skies Descend. Aurelion Sol rains down cosmic fury on the earth, dealing (187.5/312.5/437.5 + 81.25% Ability Power) magic damage over a larger area and knocking enemies hit Airborne for 1 second. He also emits a huge shockwave at the same time, dealing (150/250/350 + 65% Ability Power) magic damage to enemy champions and epic monsters. All enemies hit are slowed by 50% for 1 second and revealed for 1.5 seconds.
When Gragas dashes using Body Slam, he can also cast Barrel Roll.

[Removed] Launches a powerful roundhouse kick at an enemy champion, dealing (200/425/650 + 200% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage and knocking them back. Enemies the target collides with along the way are knocked Airborne for 1 second and take (200/425/650 + 200% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage, and bonus physical damage equal to 12/15/18% of the target's bonus Health.
 [New] Launches a powerful roundhouse kick at an enemy champion, dealing (100/300/500 + 200% bonus Attack Damage + 10/13/16% of the target's maximum Health) physical damage and knocking them back. Enemies the target collides with along the way are knocked Airborne for 1 second and take physical damage equal to (100/300/500 + 200% bonus Attack Damage + 10/13/16% of the target's maximum Health). Damage dealt to monsters is capped at 800.

textBlocks:
First new patch of the year and it’s gonna be a big one! Hold on to your hats because we got new items, a new champion, new skins, and a TON of gameplay updates.

Welcome to the first patch of the year, Patch 5.0!

And suddenly it’s 2024?!?! Did you miss us? We missed you! We have a big patch for you today. Get ready for a new champion, new items, new map changes, new game mechanic changes, and MORE! Welcome to the first patch of the year, Patch 5.0! Go do yourself a favor and run to the washroom and get some water. This is gonna be a long one.

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 SYNDRA, THE DARK SOVEREIGN

 Syndra is a fearsome Ionian mage with incredible power at her command. As a child, she disturbed the village elders with her reckless and wild magic. She was sent away to be taught greater control, but eventually discovered her supposed mentor was restraining her abilities. Forming her feelings of betrayal and hurt into dark spheres of energy, Syndra has sworn to destroy all who would try to control her.

 Syndra will be released on January 18 at 00:01 UTC.

 NEW FEATURES

 COMPANIONS

 Companions (beta test) are officially live! Your most loyal buddies are now ready to witness all your moments of glory by your side. A total of 29 Companions will make their debut in Patch 5.0.0. Meet Draghorn and Fluffiee, magical creatures that come in a range of styles!

 Your Companion will follow you around in-game and cheer for you!

 Your Companion will not reveal your position. When you're not visible to the enemy, your Companion won't be visible to them either.

 Your Companion will temporarily go into hiding at the right time so that you can focus on battle.

 Companions do not appear in Legendary Ranked and Arena.

 The Companion system, Exploring Expedition, will be available shortly after the patch goes live. Look forward to unlocking your Travel Journal and plenty of rewards! What are you waiting for? It's time to gather your Companions and go for a walk around the Rift!

 RANKED SEASON 12

 We'll be kicking off Ranked Season 12 real soon! Give a warm welcome to Glorious Crown Xin Zhao, our newest season-exclusive skin. We’ll also be saying goodbye and rotating out the Glorious skins and poses from Season Year 1 in the Ranked Store. Glorious Armada Twisted Fate from S9 will also be making a return, so don't forget to keep a lookout for announcements in the Ranked games portal when S12 starts!

 Ranked Season 12 will kick off on January 19 at 00:01 UTC.

 WILD PASS

 The new Wild Pass, Food Spirits Veigar, will be available after the patch update. Level up your Wild Pass to Lv. 75 to unlock Ascended Food Spirits Veigar and many more rewards! Once more, a new Battle Ensign, Food Spirits Veigar, will also be added to the Wild Pass Emporium, along with the limited-time return of Ascended Supervillain Graves, Ascended Superhero Vi, Supervillain Graves, Superhero Vi, Hexplorer Jax, and Hexplorer Teemo!

 A new Blackfrost Renekton Mini Pass will go live after the Food Spirits Veigar Wild Pass ends.

 EVENTS

 WILD PUZZLE

 Play games, earn puzzle pizza, and win prizes!

 The Wild Puzzle event begins January 18 at 00:01 UTC

When enemies are killed within the black hole's range, Aurelion Sol gains 5 stacks of Stardust for every champion or epic monster killed; 3 stacks of Stardust for every siege minion or large monster killed; and 2 stacks of Stardust for every minion or small monster killed.

 [New] The Skies Descend: Whenever Aurelion Sol collects 65 stacks of Stardust, the next Falling Star transforms into The Skies Descend. Aurelion Sol rains down cosmic fury on the earth, dealing (187.5/312.5/437.5 + 81.25% Ability Power) magic damage over a larger area and knocking enemies hit Airborne for 1 second. He also emits a huge shockwave at the same time, dealing (150/250/350 + 65% Ability Power) magic damage to enemy champions and epic monsters. All enemies hit are slowed by 50% for 1 second and revealed for 1.5 seconds.

ULTIMATE SPELLBOOK CHANGES

 Poro Energy can now be used for spell rerolls.

 ARENA CHANGES

 CHAMPION CAMEOS

 AURELION SOL

 Aurelion Sol sporadically generates a cosmic field that grants Movement Speed to players within and helps them ignore obstacles.

 KAI’SA

 When a player takes down Kai'Sa, they gain the following buff for 15 seconds: Every time they deal damage, they automatically cast Icathian Rain at all players.

 PANTHEON

 Pantheon thrusts his spear at the target location, dealing damage to the target based on their max Health. Upon landing, the spear sweeps across its surroundings and deals damage to enemies within range based on their max Health.

 NASUS

 Nasus makes random appearances on the battlefield, and taking him down grants Ascension.

 Ascension: 200% size and increased Armor and Magic Resist; and the cooldown of your first ability is reduced to 1 second. If the ability stores charges, charge(s) will also be refunded. The buffs last 10 seconds.

 MORGANA

 Players near Morgana gain crowd control immunity.

 NEW AUGMENTS

 ARCANE OVERFLOW

 Build up Comet Force after casting an ability. Dealing ability damage to a champion launches several comets toward their position, dealing magic damage that scales with bonus Attack Damage and bonus Ability Power. Comet Force builds up infinitely.

 ARTILLERY COVERAGE

 Fires Ashe's, Ezreal's, Jinx's, Lux's, and Senna's Ultimate abilities at a target location at the same time.

 BACKUP BATTERY

 Upon death, reanimate temporarily with increased stats while bleeding for 7 seconds, after which you die again.

 BATTLE MAGE

 Gain bonus Health, Armor, and Magic Resist based on Ability Power.

 BLACK HOLE

 Summon a Black Hole centered around you, pulling enemies nearby toward you while stealing their Armor and Magic Resist.

 BUTTER ROLL

 Your first ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

 CHEESE ROLL

 Your third ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

 DUAL WIELD

 Gain increased Attack Speed and max Attack Speed, but Attack Damage and Ability Power are reduced.

 MIRROR IMAGE

 At regular intervals, become invisible for a few seconds and project a mirror clone that moves toward the enemy. The mirror clone explodes near enemies or when destroyed, blinding nearby enemies.

 FORTUNE COIN

 Toss a Fortune Coin. If it lands face up, heal for 10% of your max Health. If it lands face down, a bolt of lightning strikes at your current position, dealing true damage equal to 10% of your max Health. There is a small chance to trigger an Easter Egg for additional bonuses.

 FULL STEAM AHEAD

 Become Unstoppable while moving freely and gain sustained Movement Speed. You can only stop moving upon recast or collision with enemies or terrain, after which you deal magic damage to nearby enemy champions.

 HEAD BLOWN

 Attacks have a 60% chance to stun for 0.2 second(s).

 JAM ROLL

 Your second ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

 MANA AEGIS

 When you have more than 40% Mana, 40% of your damage taken is converted into Mana loss instead. When you're healed, 40% of your healing received is gained as Mana as well. (Mana loss does not trigger events based on Mana consumption, but Mana regeneration triggered by heals will increase based on healing bonuses.)

 PLANETARY RING

 Gain 3 aerial bullets that orbit you, dealing magic damage to enemies they hit. The bullets orbit at max attack range and do not apply any on-hit effects. Orbital speed scales with Attack Speed.

 REPRISAL ARMOR

 Store a percentage of damage taken over a period of time as Fury. At regular intervals, consume all Fury to deal magic damage to enemies nearby.

 SCHRODINGER’S HEALTH BAR

 Your Health bar is permanently Camouflaged and hidden from enemy view.

 SUBJUGATE

 Drain life equal to 30% of their max Health from a target (dealt as magic damage) and steal 40% of their Armor and Magic Resist. Half of the damage and stealing happen immediately and the other half happens over 5 seconds. The stolen Armor and Magic Resist are returned to the target 4 seconds after the drain ends.

 TROPICAL PUNCH

 Gain increased effects from Power Flowers and share them with your ally.

 UNBROKEN

 All excess incoming damage above 15% of your max Health is reduced by 50% (all damage exceeding this threshold will be reduced by 50%, including true damage).

 UNKNOWN DAMAGE

 Deal damage ranging between 50% and 175%.

 WHALE

 Increases your item limit and grants you a random item before the start of every battle. You can have a max of 12 items at any one time. You also deal 1 bonus damage for every 500 gold you have more than your target.

 AUGMENT CHANGES

 AUGMENTS QUANTITY

 Quantity is increased to 6. Compared to during the early access season, most teams can now obtain all the Augments before they're eliminated.

 RECOMMENDED AUGMENTS

 Augments suitable for your champion are marked with indicators. If no Augment is selected when time is up, the recommended Augment will be selected by default.

 AUGMENT REFRESH

 While Augments can be refreshed three times, if the player loses a round in between 2 Augment selection rounds, they'll gain 2 more refresh chances.

 SURRENDER

 You can surrender the game if your teammate goes AFK or enables AI control of their champion.

 CAMERA

 You can pan the camera, or zoom in and out while spectating.

 Added a camera displaying the champion that places first.

 POWER FLOWER

 A new notification will pop up when Power Flowers are available, and more Power Flowers will be added.

 SYSTEM FEATURES

 CHAMPION BALANCE

 In this update, we've made balance adjustments to 76 champions for Arena. We've also implemented fixes for mages, marksmen, and support champions so that they won't find themselves facing disadvantageous situations so easily anymore, unlike during the early access season.

 Melee champions will receive bonus base Health, bonus Armor and Magic Resist, and bonus base Health Regen.

 Ranged champions will receive bonus base Health, bonus Armor and Magic Resist, bonus Movement Speed, and bonus Ability Haste.

 Champion Critical Strike Damage is increased from 175% to 190%.

 Fully upgraded items now cost 3,000 gold each, and their stats have been rebalanced: every Ability Power item in this mode will now provide 7% Magic Pen and 7% Critical Rate. In addition, items can also be sold at their original price during the shop phase.

 NEW TEAMFIGHT PHASE

 Added a casual teamfight round. Teams that haven't been eliminated will enter the same battlefield for an all-out brawl. Survive as best as you can during this round to earn more rewards!

 This round has a fixed duration of 60 seconds. No reductions will be made to team Health when the round ends.

 This round will always take place on the same map (Ancestral Woods).

 There is no win/loss mechanic in the teamfight round, and the round will not break win streaks.

 The map will randomly spawn new heal items (restore 350 Health) and hats. (The outer, middle, and inner rings all randomly respawn hats and heal items at 5-second intervals at a respawn chance of 50%.)

 Killing enemies will cause them to drop 50% of their hats first and then spawn 4 additional hats. Hats that have been picked up will carry forward after the teamfight round.

 After the teamfight round, the surviving team with the most hats (>0) gains 25 team Health. If there is more than one team with the same number of hats, and this number is the highest out of all the teams, all the teams with this number of hats will gain 25 team Health (max team Health can exceed 100).

 Champions cannot be resurrected during the teamfight round. The round ends when time is up, or when there is only one surviving team.

 EASTER EGGS

 STACK ‘EM HATS

 Minions will randomly spawn with hats. Kill the hatted units to wear the hats yourself!

 Lunar Dumpling

 When a minion or monster is killed, there is a chance that it'll drop a dumpling. Pick it up to restore Health and gain a temporary Movement Speed boost.

 Red Envelope Clash

 When a unit with a red envelope is killed, all champions within range gain a random amount of gold.

 [HOTFIX] HEARTSTEEL

 Base stats

 700 Health

 While within 700 units of an enemy champion, charges for 3 seconds before dealing a huge strike against the enemy champion. This charged attack deals bonus physical damage equal to 120 + 5% of maximum Health, and grants maximum Health equal to 12% → 15% of the damage dealt. The charge for each target has a 20-second cooldown.

 MANTLE OF THE TWELFTH HOUR

 Lifeline

 [Removed] Damage that puts you under 35% Health grants a heal for 200 + 50% bonus Health over 3 seconds, and provides 50% Slow Resist and 30 Movement Speed for 3 seconds. (90s cooldown)

 [New] Damage that puts you under 35% Health grants bonus max Health equal to 200 + 50% bonus Health over 3 seconds, and provides 50% Slow Resist and 30 Movement Speed for 3 seconds. (90s cooldown)

 [New] When you are critically struck, gain Determination equal to 25% (melee)/18% (ranged) of the pre-mitigation damage for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 500. When you attack an enemy champion, consume all Determination and heal yourself for the same amount. If you still have unconsumed Determination after 5 seconds, automatically consume all Determination to heal yourself for half of the amount.

 [New] This item upgrades to Black Mist Scythe after 750 gold is earned.

 MAP CHANGES

 BARON LANE ALCOVE

 An alcove is added to the Baron lane to provide more opportunities for outplays and gank strategies.

 RELOCATION OF HONEYFRUITS IN THE BARON LANE

 We've relocated the Honeyfruit behind the turret, with the aim of preventing champions with longer attack ranges from easily destroying their opponent's fruits.

 GAME MECHANICS CHANGES

 NEW MINION: CANNON MINION

 During the laning phase, there is a significant discrepancy between the strength of the siege minion wave and the other minion wave. This poses challenges for players in making decisions about when to recall, roam, or provide support for their teammates. By replacing them with cannon minions, players should hopefully be able to concentrate on laning during the early game while having better control of the minion wave. This adjustment will also enhance lane experience points and gold, increasing the BaronLaner’s impact.

 Siege minions that appear between 50s and 12min 5s from the start of the game are replaced with cannon minions.

 The cannon minion has a ranged attack and is weaker than the siege minion, but is stronger than the melee minion. Overall, the strength of the minion waves remains consistent as before.

 MINION WAVES EXPERIENCE POINTS

 We are modifying the minion experience ratio in the different lanes.

 In the first 7 minutes of the game, shared experience points from minion waves are reduced while solo laners gain higher experience points in the top and mid lanes. After 7 minutes, this experience points change will expire.

 ADJUSTED EXPERIENCE CATCH-UP MECHANIC

 The experience catch-up mechanic will trigger immediately when the champion falls below the average level by 1 level (previously was 0.75 level)

 ADJUSTED EXPERIENCE POINTS FOR LEVELING UP

 The experience points required to reach level 10 and above have increased. Champions need more experience to level up after reaching level 9.

 SOLO ASSIST GOLD CHANGES

 When only one champion assists with a takedown, the gold awarded for the assist will change from 50% of the bounty to 35% of the bounty.

 There is no change when more than one champion assists with the takedown.

 IN-GAME RUNE STATS FEATURE OPTIMIZATION

 In Patch 4.4, we launched the Rune Stats feature and in this patch, we've improved it.

 New stats added to several runes

 Optimized statistical rules for some of the rune stats

 STRATEGIC OBJECTIVES CHANGES

 Taking into account player feedback and our analysis of game data, we've tweaked strategic objectives and fine-tuned how they trigger based on certain conditions.

 Strategic objectives can be triggered earlier now.

 The gold earned through some champion abilities and rune effects no longer affect strategic objectives, including:

 Champion abilities: Twisted Fate's (P) Loaded Dice; Draven's (P) League of Draven; Pyke's (4) Death from Below

 Rune effects: First Strike, Sweet Tooth

 DRAGON SOULS BALANCE CHANGES

 Infernal Dragon Soul

 Damaging an enemy champion with attacks or abilities creates an explosion of 250 radius around the target, dealing adaptive damage equal to (110 + 20% bonus Attack Damage + 10% Ability Power → 135 + 25% bonus Attack Damage + 12.5% Ability Power ). 5s cooldown.

 Mountain Dragon Soul

 After 5 seconds of not taking damage from enemy champions or turrets, gain a normal shield that absorbs (210 → 260 ) damage.

 Ocean Dragon Soul

 Recover Health equal to (150 + 30% bonus Attack Damage + 15% Ability Power + 6% bonus Health → 190 + 36% bonus Attack Damage + 18% Ability Power + 7.5% bonus Health ) within 4 seconds of damaging an enemy champion with attacks or abilities. 6s cooldown.

 Ice Dragon Soul

 Damaging an enemy champion with an attack or ability marks them for 3 seconds. When the mark disappears, they are slowed by 50% briefly and take bonus true damage equal to (12%→ 15% ) of the damage they take while marked. 15s → 12s cooldown.

 CHANGES TO STACKING DAMAGE REDUCTION

 This patch introduces new items with damage reduction and when combined with the champions' damage reduction abilities, it all becomes a little too much. So we are changing how damage reduction stacks.

 We've tweaked the calculations for stacking multiple percentage-based damage reduction effects. This adjustment will slightly reduce the overall benefit when damage reduction is stacked.

 GHOST PORO CHANGES

 The Ghost Poro is getting a makeover and will become the Jungle Spirit.

 While patrolling, the Jungle Spirit will quickly move in front of enemies it detects and fear them before returning to its patrol route.

 A new jungle camp has been added. When the Jungle Spirit is killed, it will charge at this jungle champ. Once the charging is complete, the Jungle Spirit will respawn from the camp.

 RIFT HERALD OPTIMIZATION

 We've adjusted how the Rift Herald selects its target and attacks to focus its aggro on turrets instead of minions (champions can still take a swing at them).

 We've also added a minimap icon that appears when the Rift Herald is summoned. This gives players a clearer heads-up when it happens.

 RUNE STACKS OPTIMIZATION

 We've made adjustments so that the stacks for Conqueror and Kraken Slayer fall off at a rate of 1 stack per 0.5 seconds, the same as Lethal Tempo. (Previously, all stacks fell off.)

 STORE OPTIMIZATION

 In the first 30 seconds of the game, items can be sold at the original price.

 The next purchasable fully upgraded item will be shown in advance near the store portal, along with the amount of remaining gold required.

 PRACTICE MODE CHANGES

 In Practice mode, players can purchase boot enchantments immediately at the start of the game.

 NEW ITEM VFX

 Lifeline

 When taking damage greater than what the shield can absorb, a VFX of the shield breaking will occur.

 Items that will be affected: Seraph's Embrace, Sterak's Gage, and Immortal Shieldbow.

 SPELL VFX

 Barrier

 When taking damage greater than what the shield can absorb, a VFX of the shield breaking will occur.

 HEXFLASH RUNE

 The Hexflash rune replaces the Flash spell with Hexflash when Flash is on cooldown. However, when Hexflash is active, players cannot see the remaining cooldown of Flash.

 Hexflash

 An ignited fuse effect is added for Hexflash, showing the remaining cooldown time for Flash

 IN-GAME ANNOUNCEMENTS OPTIMIZATION

 Redundant in-game announcements are removed and several kill announcements are merged.

 Highlighted the key milestone announcements that needed to be emphasized in-game.

 Improved announcement intensity/format of value effects:

 [New] When the dragon soul is obtained, a dragon soul effect is added to the obtainment announcement.

 [New] Bounty information is added to kill announcements and new animation effects are added for players with bounty on the scoreboard.

 Improved display effect of in-game chat kill announcements.

 Improved announcements for turret damage or when inhibitor turrets are under attack.

 BUFF STACKS DISPLAY OPTIMIZATION

 The buff stacks number will be shown within 3 digits. Buff stacks that are 4 digits and above are abbreviated in thousands (K), such as 32.1K. The previous display was 999+.

 POST-GAME ITEM STACKS DISPLAY OPTIMIZATION

 Items with stacks will now display the stack count on the bottom right of their item icon at the end of game screen.

 BARON NASHOR/ELDER DRAGON BUFF DISPLAY OPTIMIZATION

 When a team obtains the Baron Nashor/Elder Dragon buff in a game, a countdown timer for that buff will appear.

 CUSTOMIZED HUD, UPGRADED INTERACTIVE EXPERIENCE

 We've improved the in-game interface and interactive experience, as well as added new controls and an interface settings page.

 When less than 10 seconds of cooldown remains for a player's teammates' Ultimate or spells, the number of seconds will appear next to their icons beside the minimap and on the scoreboard.

 An 'in-game interface' section is added to the 'Controls' tab on the Settings page.

 Players can customize the transparency of the HUD, the strategy panel, and the store, switch on or off the strategy panel timeline, and adjust the indicator style for attacking units.

 Provide a default clean and simple HUD configuration for new players.

 For existing players, their current settings are unchanged.

 FLASH COMBO

 If auto-aim is active while casting certain combo abilities, the champion will locate the most optimal enemy champion within range and dash toward them.

 Jarvan IV's Demacian Standard-Dragon Strike combo

 Camille's second dash during Hookshot

 Gragas' Body Slam

 Galio's Justice Punch

 Vi's Vault Breaker

 Yasuo's Sweeping Blade-Steel Tempest combo

 SOCIAL SYSTEM OPTIMIZATION

 MOTIVATIONAL INTERACTION FEATURE

 A motivational interaction feature has been added to the game loading screen. Players can tap the cheering or taunting Poro button to send out motivational or taunting messages, allowing them to interact with their teammates and opponents.

 A motivational interaction effect has been added to the start of the game. Tap the Poro button in the top right corner to activate a special fireworks effect and boost morale! When all 5 team members tap the button, it triggers a continuous fireworks display!

 OPTIMIZATION OF PARTY FORMATION

 The open party panel in the lobby is upgraded to a party recruitment panel. In addition to the current open party settings, players can also view recruiting teams in the new tab.

 Players can start an open party directly on the Party Finder screen.

 NEW GUILD FEATURES

 [New] Guild Profile

 Players can check a guild's basic information and quickly join a guild on the guild profile.

 [New] Wall of Fame

 The Guild Leader can assign Wall of Fame slots to 5 members and set custom titles for them. The Wall of Fame is displayed on the Guild homepage and profile and is viewable by others.

 OPTIMIZATION OF PRE-GAME INTERACTIONS

 During the champion selection phase, an enhanced animation is added to the double smite notification, emphasizing the alert to make it more visible for the player and their teammates to check.

 During the champion selection phase, prompts to improve unusual team lineups are added to prevent players from making the wrong choice.

 COLLECTIONS

 Gallery collections can now be set as home screen backgrounds.

 Added a new portal to "Patch Collections" to the Main Menu. Tap the portal to enter and view all collections newly added in this patch.

 Added a new feature to the top of Collections: "Patch Collections". This feature lets you view all the new skins and goodies added in the newest patch and provides a way to quickly access this content.

 Collection Score (based on seasons) is used in Patch Collections. Once you've collected enough Collection Score from the current patch, you'll unlock rewards such as key visual artworks and animated emotes.

 Collecting the required Collection Score for the patch will also light up a gold Poro icon, which will be displayed on the Collector leaderboard.

patches.title: Wild Rift Patch Notes 4.4d

championChanges.summary: Our recent buffs to Aatrox have made him a popular pick. But he’s been trampling through the jungle. This adjustment will bring back balance to nature.
Amumu’s experience in the jungle has been a bit of a sad tale. These changes will hopefully cheer him up a little (or at least you).

Do you suffer from buyer’s remorse? This is a QOL adjustment that will make casting Darius’ ult feel a little less like a waste if it fizzles out early... Darius changes will be available January 4 at 00:01 UTC.

changes.text: When casting Noxian Guillotine and the target dies, moves out of range, becomes untargetable, or activates Zhonya’s Hourglass or Guardian Angel, the mana cost will be refunded and go on a 5s cooldown.

championChanges.summary: Sorry guys, it’s still TOO scary. These adjustments will make sure we stop shaking in our boots when we see the enemy pick Fiddlesticks in champ select.
To keep Demacia in balance, we had to give Garen the same QOL as Darius. Garen changes will be available January 4 at 00:01 UTC.

championChanges.summary: In our November News, we shared some thoughts from John, our Product Lead regarding Sona’s rework. And as promised, here are the details!

changes.text:
[Removed] After casting basic abilities for 3 times, Sona’s empowered attack will gain a bonus effect from the last ability she casts.

 [New] After casting basic abilities for 3 times, Sona’s next attack will be empowered, dealing (20~160 + 15% Ability Power) bonus magic damage, stunning the target for 0.5s. Casting basic abilities creates a non-stacking buff aura for 3s.

 [New] CD of basic abilities will be reduced (level *2%).

Mana cost: 55/60/65/70 → 60/65/70/75

[Removed] Passive: Reduce 10/20/30% basic Cooldown of basic abilities.

 [Removed] Active: Strikes an irresistible chord, dealing (150/250/350+50% Ability Power) magic damage to enemies hit and stunning them for 1s.

 [New] Passive: The aura will be reinforced for 20s after casting the ability, providing a higher buff effect than usual.

 [New] Active: Plays a chord that emits a soundwave every 0.75s as it travels to the target location. The soundwave deals (40/80/120 + 15% Ability Power) magic damage and stuns enemies hit for the first time for 1s. Enemies caught inside the chord are also slowed.

championChanges.summary: Varus has been known to miss the target here and there. We’ve adjusted his arrows to always strike true!

textBlocks: This patch is a doozy! Welcome to the first patch of December.

I scream, you scream, we all scream for… Patch 4.4c? We got champion adjustments, item changes, and a new skin coming your way! As always, meet you on the Rift!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 ZYRA, RISE OF THE THORNS

 Born in an ancient, sorcerous catastrophe, Zyra is the wrath of nature given form—an alluring hybrid of plant and human, kindling new life with every step. She views the many mortals of Valoran as little more than prey for her seeded progeny, and thinks nothing of slaying them with flurries of deadly spines. Though her true purpose has not been revealed, Zyra wanders the world, indulging her most primal urges to colonize, and strangle all other life from it.

textBlocks: This patch we are sprinting onto the Rift with Sivir! Lots of balance updates coming your way as well. Strap in and welcome to Patch 4.4b!

Get ready, set, go! It’s patch 4.4b!

 This patch we are sprinting onto the Rift with Sivir, the Battle Mistress. Accompanying her will be a fun new event and two brand-spanking new Blood Moon skins! And as always, your regularly scheduled balance updates. Welcome to Patch 4.4b!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 SIVIR, THE BATTLE MISTRESS

 Sivir is a renowned fortune hunter and mercenary captain who plies her trade in the deserts of Shurima. Armed with her legendary jeweled crossblade, she has fought and won countless battles for those who can afford her exorbitant price. Known for her fearless resolve and endless ambition, she prides herself on recovering buried treasures from the perilous tombs of Shurima—for a generous bounty. With ancient forces stirring the very bones of Shurima, Sivir finds herself torn between conflicting destinies.

 Sivir will be released on November 24 at 00:01 UTC.

 EVENTS

 SIVIR’S HUNT

 Chase down your enemies and claim your bounty!

 The Sivir's Hunt event begins November 24 at 00:01 UTC

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 GAME MODES

 Our new game mode, Arena, will be coming out with this patch. You’ll be able to queue up solo or with your favorite duo in a brand-new mode! Arena is a 2v2v2v2 mode, where each player will be placed in teams of two where they will then duke it out in a series of duels in different arenas on each map. Every round won will decrease the enemies’ total health, and the last team standing will be the winner! There will be different augments that players can select, making each game fun and unique!

 Arena will be available on November 10 at 00:01 UTC.

textBlocks: BOO! This patch is full of surprises! Fiddlesticks arrives on the Rift, we’re celebrating our third-year anniversary, the mage update is here, and much more! Welcome to Patch 4.4!

BOO! This patch is full of surprises, whether you’re looking for a fright or a Powerspike delight, we’ve got you covered!

 We’re unleashing Fiddlesticks on the Rift, so watch your back, he’ll sneak up on you and give you and the champion you’re playing a good scare when you least expect it. We’re also celebrating our third-year anniversary this patch! Thank you for playing with us these past few years, you’ve made the Rift what it is, and we’re so excited to celebrate with you all. We’ve been buzzing about the goodies we’ll be giving out this year, so make sure to log in every day so you earn them all!

 The update to mages is here, as well as a bunch of updates to items and some other systems across the Rift. We’ve also got a new Wild Pass, Ranked Season, and much more! Welcome to Patch 4.4!

 We still have more in store for the other updates coming in 4.4, check out what else is to come in our latest Patch Preview:

Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 FIDDLESTICKS, THE ANCIENT FEAR

 Something has awoken in Runeterra. Something ancient. Something terrible. The ageless horror known as Fiddlesticks stalks the edges of mortal society, drawn to areas thick with paranoia where it feeds upon terrorized victims. Wielding a jagged scythe, the haggard, makeshift creature reaps fear itself, shattering the minds of those unlucky enough to survive in its wake. Beware the sounding of the crow, or the whispering of the shape that appears almost human… Fiddlesticks has returned.

 Fiddlesticks will be released on October 25 at 00:01 UTC.

 NEW FEATURES

 WILD PASS

 Those Dream Raiders are still on our tail…thank god our private eye is finally in town, we needed the help! Psychic Detective Ekko is now available and will be your reward for completing this Wild Pass! You can also earn his Ascended version and an array of other goodies throughout the pass and in the Wild Pass Emporium! This Wild Pass Emporium will also include Dream Raider Nasus, Superhero Jayce, and Supervillain Jhin!

 The Wild Pass will be available on October 25 at 00:01 UTC.

 RANKED

 We’ve got an ash-ingment for you: climb the ranks and prove your skill in Ranked Season 11! As you play games, you’ll be able to earn this season's new skin Glorious Armada Ashe, and as always, her upgraded version will be available in the Ranked Store along with Glorious Crimson Nami!

 Ranked S11 will be available on October 27 at 08:00 AM CST.

 GAME MODES

 Later in Patch 4.4, you’ll be able to queue up solo or with your favorite duo in a brand-new mode! Arena is a 2v2v2v2 mode, where each player will be placed in teams of two where they will then duke it out in a series of duels in different arenas each map. Every round won will decrease the enemies’ health total, and the last team standing will be the winner! There will be different augments that players can select, making each game fun and unique!

 Arena will be available on November 10 at 00:01 UTC.

 Additionally, we’ve added some easter eggs for you that can trigger in some modes, so keep an eye out and let us know what surprises you encounter!

 QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES

 We’ve added new rank rewards for guilds, as well as made some adjustments to the length of a guild season.

 You can now customize the page you share with your friends after each game.

 We’ve added a new champion score reward system.

 This new system will grant you a Champion Score Protection Card when your highest Champion Score record in that season reaches 4000, 6000, 8000, and 10,000.

 You can use this card to recover 50% of the points deducted from the champion score after a loss. You cannot use it if your champion score exceeds 10,000, if you have negative behavior in-game, and is only available for Ranked and Legendary Queues.

 We’ve also adjusted the champion score growth rules for Legendary Queue in the new season.

 EVENTS

 COCA-COLA PLAY AS ONE EVENT

 Complete missions and earn bubbly rewards!

 The Coca-Cola Play As One Event begins October 25 at 00:01 UTC.

 ANNIVERSARY EVENT

 It’s not a party without some presents! Thanks for playing with us for these past three years, we’re so happy to celebrate you! Happy Third Year Anniversary!

 The Anniversary Event begins October 25 at 00:01 UTC.

 GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 We’ve noticed that mages have not been performing well, and this patch we wanted to focus on showing them some love and helping them shine. Our main goals with our adjustments were to give them more survivability and mobility, so we’ve given a handful of mages extra movement speed, as well as some adjustments to wind up time on casting abilities and mobile cast. These changes should give some mages more opportunities to kite their enemies, especially in the later stages of the game.

 We also wanted to give mages some more build options, since right now they’re lacking items to help them against heavily shielded foes, or in early-game skirmishes. A lot of builds are also tied to always having Rabadon’s Deathcap and Void Staff. One of the items we’re going to be adding to the shopkeeper's inventory is a classic, Mejai’s Soulstealer. If you’re feeling risky, you can pick it up and snowball your advantage if you get some early kills. Mages have also often struggled with pushing and clearing waves, because of the smaller map in Wild Rift, so we’ve also adjusted the positions of the bushes on both sides of the Mid Lane, which should give you more space to duke it out in 1v1s versus your lane opponent.

[HOTFIX] Fiddlesticks has been crushing his enemies in early team fights. As a result, he’s been snowballing into too big of a monster in the late game and players are finding him difficult to counter. We’ve adjusted some numbers on his abilities to make him easier to deal with.

RUNE CHANGES

 Last patch we launched the new rune system, which added lots of new runes to grant your champ more ways to deal damage to enemies. To make it easier to see where your damage may be coming from or the value your runes are giving you in-game, we’ve added a new feature for rune effect stats. During game, you’ll now be able to view the benefits each Rune you’ve taken has given you in real time through the rune tab in the Strategy panel. And don’t worry if you forgot to check in-game or were too busy carrying to have a chance to check it out, you’ll also be able to view these stats after your game, as well as the stats from the runes your teammates and opponents that game took.

 SYSTEM CHANGES

 DRAGON SOUL REWORK

 [NEW]: When a team kills three dragons successively, they will gain a bonus Dragon Soul Buff, which grants a new bonus effect.

 The element of the dragon soul buff is the same as the first dragon that spawns, which is the one that changes the environment of the map.

 If both teams don’t kill all the three dragons in a game, the Dragon Soul Buff will not be granted to any team.

 Dragon soul buffs

 Infernal Dragon Soul buff effect: Gain 3% Attack Damage and Ability Power.

 DAMAGE TO TURRETS ADJUSTMENT

 In previous patches, there were some issues with damage from champions to structures. The first was that champions with hybrid damage could not deal damage with part of their Attack Damage or Ability Power to turrets. The second issue was from champions with Ability Power items dealing damage to structures. The amount of damage they could deal, especially in the later stages of the game, was much higher than Attack Damage champs. So, we’ve made adjustments to address these problems.

 [OLD] Basic damage from champion to structure = champion basic Attack Damage + ("bonus Attack Damage" and "50％ Ability Power", choose the higher from the two) → [NEW] Basic damage from champion to structure = champion basic Attack Damage + Bonus Attack Damage + 40％ Ability Power.

Healing is halved for champions recently affected by Heal.

 SMITE

 When you have the spell Smite equipped, monsters’ health will display the execute health threshold for Smite.

 RIFT HERALD

 It can be frustrating when the enemy team summons Rift Herald to attack the Nexus directly without minions. This also isn’t healthy for the pace of the game, so we’ve made some adjustments to Shelly.

 Damage to Nexus: 775-1125 (based on level) → Maximum health of Nexus × 25%

 When enemy champions are continuously attacked by turrets, the last attack will not be interrupted by distance as enemy champions exceed the attack range.

textBlocks: It’s the last patch of the Fighting Spirit Update! We’ve got a rework to Janna, balance updates, and new skins! Welcome to Patch 4.3d!

We’ve been fearless during the Fighting Spirit update and have loved debuting new content for you during this patch cycle. However, we must speak now and let you all know that it’s the end of an era. This will be the last balance patch during the 4.3 cycle, but don’t worry we’ve already started entering our new era and can’t wait to start the party with you in the coming weeks!

 Before we close out 4.3, we wanted to blow you all away, so Janna’s rework will be launching this patch, along with seemingly some balance updates, and some new skins. Welcome to Patch 4.3d!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

Hecarim is highly mobile and tanky, which makes it difficult for his enemies to take him down. So we’re going to “rein” him in and are nerfing some of his resistances and regen that he gains during a teamfight.

Damage and magic resistance: 20/25/30/35 → 6/12/18/24
 Health regeneration: 10/15/20/25 + 1% Bonus maximum health → 5/10/15/20 + 1% Bonus maximum health
 Health regeneration from damage dealt to enemy targets: Damage dealt (25% + 0.02% Bonus Attack Damage) → Damage dealt (20% + 0.02% Bonus Attack Damage)

Janna is The Storm’s Fury, and she harnesses the power of wind to support her teammates throughout the game. We felt there was some room to adjust some of her abilities to make her more supportive and lean into her strengths. We’ve reworked all of her abilities to make sure she is still that protective wind mage, while also increasing her survivability and flexibility, so that Janna is in it to “wind” it and playable in more situations.

Bonus movement speed gained: 8% → 5%
 [REMOVED] Ally champions gain 8% movement speed bonus when moving towards Janna.
 [NEW] Nearby ally champions gain 5% movement speed bonus.

Magic damage: 60/90/120/150+40% Ability Power → 60/100/140/180 + 50% Ability Power
 Time it takes for the storm to reach its destination: 1s → 0.5s
 [REMOVED] Damage from the storm, knockup effect and range depend on its charging time, reaching maximum potency at 3s.
 [NEW] Charging time for the storm is fixed as 0.75s. Howling Gale gains 1 charge every 12s to cast, with maximum 2 charging stacks.

Magic damage: 55/105/155/205 + 60% Ability Power +25% Bonus movement speed → 50/90/130/170+50% Ability Power + 20% Bonus movement speed
 Cooldown: 7.5/7/6.5/6s → 9/8.5/8/7.5s
 [REMOVED] Passive: After ability cooldown, Janna gains 6% bonus movement speed, dealing bonus magic damage when attacking the enemies.
 [REMOVED] Dealing damage and slowing down the chosen target for 2s.
 [NEW] Increasing Janna’s movement speed by 15%/20%/25%/30% for 2s.
 [NEW] Automatically searching 3 nearby allies or enemies. Janna will increase her ally champions movement speed by 15%/20%/25%/30%, or deal magic damage to the enemies.

Shield value: 90/140/190/240 + 80% Ability Power → 65/90/115/140 + 60% Ability Power
 [REMOVED] Janna provides a shield to an ally champion or turret that absorbs damage, the shield decays over 5s.
 [NEW] Janna now provides a shield that absorbs damage to herself and an ally champion with lowest health, if there is a turret nearby, the same shield will also be provided to the turret. The shield lasts for 3s without any decay.

Health regeneration per second: 100/150/200 + 50% Ability Power → 50/75/100 + 30% Ability Power
 [REMOVED] During the Monsoon, Janna needs to continuously channel it.
 [NEW] Janna can now move freely after casting the Monsoon.

Katarina players always find a way to “katapult” themselves into the fight and slash their enemies apart, especially in higher levels of play. Because of this, we’re slightly adjusting her damage so that her foes have a chance to fight back.

Base damage: 50 + 12 × Level → 40 + 10 × Level
 Ability Power ratio: (45 + 3 × Level)% → (30 + 3 × Level)%
Kayn’s Darkin form is weaker compared to his other form, so we’re increasing his sustainability which should make teamfights easier to maneuver.
Darkin base health regeneration: 18% → 20%
Darkin damage of target’s maximum health: (5% + 0.04% Bonus Attack Damage)% → (6% + 0.06% Bonus Attack Damage)%

Renekton has been struggling in the Baron Lane. We’ve seen that he hasn’t been able to apply enough pressure in the early and mid stages of the game. To lend this croc a hand, we’re increasing his sustainability and damage so that Renekton can regain his glory as one of best fighters on the Rift.
We’re making some adjustments to increase Wukong’s damage, sustainability, and flexibility so that he can take more fights comfortably.

Even though Xin Zhao has been a popular pick, he has been struggling to be a threat against his foes since the systematic changes that have occurred over the past few patches. We’re increasing some of his damage so that he can feel more confident taking those jungle skirmish fights.
Slash damage: 40/50/60/70 + 30% Attack Damage → 50/60/70/80 + 40% Attack Damage

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 ITEMS

 ANCIENT COIN

 We’re increasing the amount of gold gained from one time from Ancient Coin, and increasing the healing given to the holder. This should help players have a smoother laning phase.

 One time gold gained: 55 → 65

 One time health regeneration: 15-65 → 20-80

 BERSERKER’S GREAVES

 The effect Berserker’s Greaves grants is now a little too weak, so we’re buffing it to make it a better pick up for champs that are looking for more attack speed in their builds.

 Base stats:

 Attack Damage: 15 → 18

 BOOTS OF DYNAMISM

 The outburst power provided by these boots is now lower than our previous expectation, so we need to provide a little help to the Boots of Dynamism, so they meet the needs of assassins.

 Base stats:

 Cost: 1500g → 1400g

 Pounce:

 Armor penetration: 8 → 10

 DUSKBLADE OF DRAKTHARR

 Duskblade has been struggling when compared to the other armor penetration items, since it mainly provides burst damage and it's been more difficult for players to benefit from these effects. So, we’re strengthening Duskblade’s specific effect and base armor penetration, so that you can capitalize and feel the impact from its damage in the early and mid stages of the game.

 Razor:

 Armor penetration: 15 → 18

 Nightstalker:

 Base damage: 20-125 → 60-160

 Slowdown time: 0.25s → 0.35s

 HARMONIC ECHO

 While Harmonic Echo provides a healing effect, we feel it’s not enough. So we’re increasing the amount of healing it grants and lowering its costs, so that support players can pick it up earlier and benefit from its healing effects sooner.

 Base stats:

 Cost: 2900g → 2700g

 Harmonic Echo:

 Healing amount: 70 + 10% Ability Power → 130 + 10% Ability Power

 MAGNETRON ENCHANT

 While Magnetron Enchant can provide champions in the jungle with some strong movement, it’s still not performing well. We’re making some adjustments so that we can strengthen Magnetron Enchant’s unique power, and now its maximum movement distance can cover most areas in the jungle. We’re also adjusting its cooldown time so you can not only move farther around the map, but also faster.

 Magnetron:

 Maximum movement distance: 500 → 550

 Cooldown: 60s → 50s

 MERCURY’S TREADS

 When you’re up against someone who has Mercury’s Treads, sometimes the game just feels lost and that you can’t do much damage against your opponents. We want defensive strategies to be an option, but we also want to make sure that your foes building defensive items don’t make the game feel impossible. So, we’re adjusting the damage reduction to make sure attackers don’t feel overly frustrated, while also providing some extra health so that the holder still has enough room to survive bursts of magic damage from their foes.

 Base stats:

 Maximum health: 150 → 200

 Resolve:

 Reducing magic damage by: 15% → 12%

 PLATED STEELCAPS

 With its broad use case, Plated Steelcaps has an amazing defensive ability. Our goal with these adjustments is to give players more options in the boots category, so that Plated Steelcaps isn’t always the best in slot pick up.

 Block:

 Reduces physical damage by: 12% → 10%

 RELIC SHIELD

 Relic Shield’s ability gives players a lot of lane control since it helps you execute minions and give you and your carry gold, which has made it a popular pick up for supports. Since it provides the holder with bonus health, and is already outperforming the other support items we’re adjusting its healing effect. This should make it so it's not an insta pick for every support, and more situational depending on the champion you pick game to game.

 One time health regeneration: 20-80 → 15-65

 RUNE CHANGES

 DOMINATION: EYEBALL COLLECTION

 Overall, Domination runes are not performing well. We’re strengthening a few of them with the hope that we increase the advantage they grant to players.

 Attack Damage gained from each takedown: 0.5 → 1 (Maximum 15 → 20 )

 Ability Power gained from each takedown: 1 → 2 (Maximum 30 → 40 )

 DOMINATION: INGENIOUS HUNTER

 Overall, Domination runes are not performing well. We’re strengthening a few of them with the hope that we increase the advantage they grant to players.

 Item ability haste gain from each takedown 4 → 5 (Maximum 40 → 45 )

 DOMINATION: ZOMBIE WARD

 Overall, Domination runes are not performing well. We’re strengthening a few of them with the hope that we increase the advantage they grant to players.

 Attack Damage gained from removing ward each time: 2 → 3 (Maximum 20 → 25 )
 Ability Power gained from removing ward each time: 4 → 6 (Maximum 40 → 50 )

 INSPIRATION: HEXTECH FLASHTRAPTION

 The long channel time on this rune can lead to missed opportunities for you to make those game winning plays. So, we’re decreasing the channeling time for Hextech Flashtraption to flash to the maximum distance, this should allow you to seize more opportunities for flashy plays when you see them.

 Channeling time of longer flash distance: 3s → 2s

 Maintaining time for flashing to the longest distance: 3.5s → 4.5s

patches.title: Wild Rift Patch Notes 4.3c

championChanges.summary: No need to “wahri”, we’re buffing some of Ahri’s regen and flexibility, so that she can pounce around teamfights and kite her enemies more smoothly.

changes.text: Regeneration from takedowns: 70/110/150/190 + 30% Ability Power → 80/120/160/200 + 35% Ability Power

championChanges.summary: After her rework, Annie has been burning her foes to a crisp with her high damage burst and pouncing Tibbers. To give her opponents more options when they’re playing against her we’re lowering some of the damage she and her furry friend can deal.

changes.text:
Damage on first release: 140/250/360 + 60% Ability Power → 130/230/330 + 60% Ability Power
 Damage on second release: 120/170/220 + 40% Ability Power → 110/150/190 + 30% Ability Power
 Casting range of pounce: 800 → 700

championChanges.summary: Jhin is overpowering other marksmen in the early and mid game with his damage, and we “four-shadow” if we don’t make any adjustments this will continue. So we’re nerfing some of the damage he can deal.

changes.text: Bonus damage of the last bullet: 14% + level × 1% (reach the upper limit of 25% on level 11) Health loss → 10% + level × 1% (reach the upper limit of 25% on level 15) Health loss

championChanges.summary: As the game progresses into the later stages, Ninja Tabis begin to become weaker, since everyone has reached or is close to reaching their full builds. So we’ve made some adjustments so that Lee Sin doesn’t fall off as much when other champions reach their full builds.

Compared to her peers, Morgana is not performing well in the early and mid stages of the game. We’re buffing the damage from her abilities and her shield so that she can better protect her teammates in the earlier stages of the game.

In our previous patches, we nerfed Ornn’s damage so that he would fit into the role of the beefy tank for your team, but we’ve seen that he is still surviving much better than any other tank champions in the game. So, we’re nerfing his ability to stay in longer teamfights, and also nerfing his laning and pushing ability in the earlier stages of the game.

changes.text: Bonus health, armor and magic resistance ratio: 7/14/21/28% → 7/12/17/22%

Brittle damage: 5% - 24% Maximum health → 5% - 20% Maximum health
 Minimum damage to minions: 110/160/210/260 → 80/130/180/230

championChanges.summary: Samira has been struggling when going up against her foes in the Dragon Lane. championChanges.summary: Annie was one of the first champions to join League of Legends and Wild Rift! And while she and her beary best friends are and always will be iconic, we also saw some room to make some adjustments to her kit. We’ve reworked her third ability and her ultimate, which should make her kit feel smoother and more flexible. The changes to her ultimate will allow Annie to send Tibbers at one of her foes, which should allow him to protect her more and also give your enemies a little bit of a jump scare.

changes.text:
Health per level: 105 → 96
 Armor per level: 3.9 → 3.5

[REMOVED]: Annie shields Tibbers or an ally champion for 3s, absorbing (50/110/170/230+40%AP) damage. Enemies who attack the shield take (25/40/55/70+30%AP) magic damage.
 [NEW]: Annie shields herself and Tibbers, absorbing (50/110/170/230 + 40% Ability Power) damage and gaining 30/35/40/45% movement speed. Speed bonus decays after 3s.

 [NEW] 2s after casting Tibbers, Annie can activate this ability again, ordering Tibbers to pounce on a target, dealing (120/170/220 + 40% Ability Power) magic damage, and also making the target airborne for 1s.
