textBlocks: Vladimir joins the fight this patch, Annie’s rework is almost here, ghost Poros, and of course balance updates! Welcome to Patch 4.3a!

Poros, Bears, and Reapers…oh my! Welcome to Patch 4.3a!

 This patch we’re reworking a staple champion, Annie! However, please note that her rework will not be live until August 10 00:01 UTC . But once it’s live we can’t wait to see your un- bear -ably cool plays and hear what you think! And if Annie isn’t your Mid Lane mage of choice, it’s okay, you don’t b -negative about it, because Vladimir, The Crimson Reaper will also be joining the Rift!

 Ghost Poros will be joining the Rift this patch too! These fluffy new friends will grant you and your team some extra vision, if you find yourself at a disadvantage. We’re also making some adjustments to some champions and boots after our big updates to the rune system last patch.

 That’s all for now but we’ll see you back here for Patch 4.3b!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 VLADIMIR, THE CRIMSON REAPER

 A fiend with a thirst for mortal blood, Vladimir has influenced the affairs of Noxus since the empire’s earliest days. In addition to unnaturally extending his life, his mastery of hemomancy allows him to control the minds and bodies of others as easily as his own. In the flamboyant salons of the Noxian aristocracy, this enabled him to build a fanatical cult of personality around himself—while in the lowest back alleys, it allows him to bleed his enemies dry.

 Vladimir will be released on August 17 at 00:01 UTC.

 EVENTS

 VLADIMIR’S TRIVIA

 Think you know everything about The Crimson Reaper? Now's your chance to show off!

 The Vladimir’s Trivia event begins August 17 at 00:01 UTC

Annie was one of the first champions to join League of Legends and Wild Rift! And while she and her beary best friends are and always will be iconic, we also saw some room to make some adjustments to her kit. We’ve reworked her third ability and her ultimate, which should make her kit feel smoother and more flexible. The changes to her ultimate will allow Annie to send Tibbers at one of her foes, which should allow him to protect her more and also give your enemies a little bit of a jump scare.

Health per level: 105 → 96
 Armor per level: 3.9 → 3.5

[REMOVED]: Annie shields Tibbers or an ally champion for 3s, absorbing (50/110/170/230+40%AP) damage. Enemies who attack the shield take (25/40/55/70+30%AP) magic damage.
 [NEW]: Annie shields herself and Tibbers, absorbing (50/110/170/230 + 40% Ability Power) damage and gaining 30/35/40/45% movement speed. Speed bonus decays after 3s.

Tibbers stays: 30s → 20s
 Attack Damage of Tibbers: 50/75/100 + 20% Ability Power → 70/100/130 + 20% Ability Power
 Enraging Tibbers trigger conditions: Just summoned/Annie casts abilities with [Pyromania] on enemies/when Annie dies → Just summoned/pounces on enemies/ when Annie dies
 [REMOVED] Tibbers burns nearby enemies, dealing (24/40/56 + 12% Ability Power) magic damage per second
 [NEW] 2s after casting Tibbers, Annie can activate this ability again, ordering Tibbers to pounce on a target, dealing (120/170/220 + 40% Ability Power) magic damage, and also making the target airborne for 1s.

The Sheriff of Piltover is always ready to catch and take down any foes that get in her way. However, we wanted to give her traps a little boost so that it’s harder for enemies to escape Piltover’s finest.
We’re giving Grave’s damage a boost so his foes should be a little more careful when facing him or it might just be the end of the line for them.
Second half bonus Attack Damage: 70/100/130/160% → 80/110/140/170%

In the earlier stages of the game we’ve noticed that Gwen is too squishy, which makes it hard for her to lane and participate in early-game skirmishes. So, we’re buffing some of her base stats so that she can look to take more aggressive fights and cut her foes in half during the laning phase.
[NEW] Damage ratio to monsters: 80%

Cooldown: 20/18/16/14s → 17/16/15/14s
 Bonus armor and magic resistance: 11/14/17/20 → 14/16/18/20

Currently, Lee Sin is struggling to make an impact during teamfights, so we’re lending him a hand and boosting the damage on Sonic Wave/Resonating Strike. This should help deal more burst damage and have more of an impact during those important teamfights.

Sonic Wave bones Attack Damage: 100% → 105%
 Resonating Strike bonus: 100~200% → 105~210%

Before our changes to items, runes, and boots, we thought Leona was "sun-stoppable" and able to survive teamfights and lock down opponents for her teammates. But lately, she has been unable to pose a threat to her foes, so we’re giving her some buffs to help her get into the fight.

Base attack: 58 → 62
 Attack per level: 1.7 → 3

Nilah was the most recent champion to join the Rift, and she was ready to whip her foes into shape! We know she wants to be in the middle of the action, but since her arrival we’ve noticed she hasn’t been able to do that, so we’re slightly buffing her survivability. This should give her more room to show off her skills and be a little more aggressive!

Base armor: 34 → 37
 Base health regeneration: 6 → 10
[NEW] Active damage ratio of Formless Blade to monsters: 60%
After all our systematic adjustments last patch, this berserker is dealing too much damage. So we’re adjusting some of his damage to keep him from being too strong.

While we want this Freljordian demi-god to be the backbone for his team, we don’t want him to also deal the most damage. So we’re nerfing some of his damage to put him more in-line with the other tanks.

Base attack: 62 → 58
 Health per level: 128 → 112
Bellows Breath damage: 13/14/15/16% Maximum health → 10/11/12/13% Maximum health
Bonus damage: 50% Bonus armor and 50% Bonus magic resistance → 40% Bonus armor and 40% bonus magic resistance
Rakan has flourished with the new runes, so we’re slightly adjusting some of his survivability.
Base health: 570 → 540

Rammus has been zooming around the Rift since the last patch, and his movement speed is too strong, especially when compared to other champions. We’re adjusting how fast he can roll around so it's more in-line with his speed in previous patches.
Movement speed during rolling state increases to: 60 + 90/14 × (Level - 1) → 35 + Level × 2

Compared to other marksmen Samira has a shorter attack range, so we want to empower her to use her abilities to avoid damage in fights. Which we think that will give her the edge she needs in those duels against foes with longer range.

This demi-god of Freljord is conquering the jungle, but he seems to still be struggling in the Baron lane. We’re increasing some of his sustainability during the laning phase, so that he can perform better when dueling against his lane opponent.

Base health regeneration: 10/20/30/40 → 20/30/40/50
 [NEW] Damage ratio to monsters: 80%

Skilled Zoe players often deal too much damage in the early stage of fight. We are slightly adjusting her damage curve so now she can no longer blow bubbles to the enemies without any punishment in the early stages.

Damage: 60/115/170/225 + 45% Ability Power → 40/95/150/205 + 50% Ability Power
 Second half damage: 60/115/170/225 + 45% Ability Power → 40/95/150/205 + 50% Ability Power

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 ITEM CHANGES

 GLUTTONOUS GREAVES

 After seeing how some of the new boot options have landed, we think that Gluttonous Greaves isn’t providing players enough, especially when compared to the other options. So, we’re giving it a boost!

 Stats

 Attack Damage: 30 → 35

 BOOTS OF MANA

 Boots of Mana have been too overpowering, so for now we’re adjusting just the stats they provide you, since we still think these new stats will provide a lot for the cost.

 Stats

 Ability Power: 60 → 55

 Base mana regeneration: 200% → 150%

 PLATED STEELCAPS

 Currently, Plated Steelcaps are too strong of a pick up, especially when facing assassins, fighters and marksmen. So, we’re slightly adjusting its stats to tone down some of its power.

 Block

 Block to reduce physical damage: 15% → 12%

 SYSTEM CHANGES

 When you fall behind in-game, most of the map will be dark, making it hard for your team to attempt a comeback or make plays, because anyone could be hiding in your jungle looking to pick you off. So, we’re adding a new mechanic to help when you’re at a disadvantage, which we hope will give you the opportunity to make more comebacks and plays with your teammates. Just don’t forget to give your new friends a head pat or tasty Poro snack!

 Ghost Poro mechanic:

 When an inner turret was destroyed, a ghost Poro will be spawned in the corresponding jungle to provide vision, and it will patrol around the jungle.

 When found by Poro, the enemy champions will have a small eye effect on their heads to remind them that they have been seen.

 SKINS

 Hextech Annie

 Releasing August 10 @ 00:01 UTC

 Nightbringer Vladimir

 Releasing August 17 @ 00:01 UTC

textBlocks: We’re celebrating the launch of Soul Fighter with a new mode, event, and skins! Plus we’re revamping our rune system and so much more! Welcome to Patch 4.3—The Fighting Spirit Update!

Welcome to Patch 4.3—The Fighting Spirit Update! We hope you’re ready for the fight of your life, because this patch we’re packing with some extra punch!

 Ready to skip into the Baron Lane and rain terror on her foes is Nilah! She’s joining Wild Rift this patch and we’re sure she's going to bring lots of joy to all of your games, and help you whip your foes into shape! We also have a flurry of gameplay updates, including our revamp of the rune system, some changes to boot enchantments, as well as your regularly scheduled balance adjustments. We can’t wait to see all the new builds you concoct in the new rune system, so be sure to share your favorites with us!

 All our fighters are geared up and ready for the legendary Tournament of Souls! We have new skins showing our fighters in their best fighting garb, a new event, promotion, gamemode and more! We can’t wait for you to hop into the action when the update goes live later today!

 While that’s all for now, this is just the first patch of the Fighting Spirit update and you can check out more of the content still to come in our latest Patch Preview:

Enjoy the action and we’ll see you back here for Patch 4.3a!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 NILAH, THE JOY UNBOUND

 Nilah is an ascetic warrior from a distant land, seeking the world’s deadliest, most titanic opponents so that she might challenge and destroy them. Having won her power through an encounter with the long-imprisoned demon of joy, she has no emotions other than unceasing jubilation—a small price to pay for the vast strength she now possesses. Channeling the demon’s liquid form into a blade of unparalleled might, she stands defiant against ancient threats long forgotten.

 Nilah will be released on July 21 at 00:01 UTC.

 WILD PASS

 Here to steal your dreams—Dream Raider Thresh! He’s sure to give you a fright, and turn any dream into a nightmare, but he’s bringing lots of goodies with him! Don’t sleep on these rewards, queue up and earn progress your way through to end! You can also pick up Unleashed Dream Raider Thresh from the Wild Pass Emporium!

 As a reminder this will be our first Wild Pass of Patch 4.3, so Food Spirits Yuumi will be available later on!

 The Wild Pass will be available on July 18 at 00:01 UTC

 RANKED SEASON 10

 Patch 4.3 is bringing with it the start of a new ranked season! Play games, reach your goals, and earn a brand new ranked skin along the way—Glorious Basilisk Jarvan! In addition to the new season and ranked skin, we also have made changes to the ranked system, added a new tier above challenger, and made some tweaks to Legendary Queue! You can learn more about all our Ranked changes in our Ranked Update and FAQ blog !

 Ranked S10 will begin on July 18 at 00:01 UTC

 TAG DUEL

 We hope you’ve been training and are ready to duke it out, because Tag Duel is here! This is a 1v1 mode where the goal is for you to kill your opponent multiple times! With this new mode comes some new rules though:

 You’ll get to select three champions and be able to swap between them during the game.

 Swapping between champions will consume super meter charges.

 The super meter charges automatically and can be seen at the top of the screen.

 When you swap between champions, all your cooldowns are refunded.

 All champions will auto-buy and auto-level up during the game.

 All champions share a single health bar, once it’s depleted you’ll lose a life and all champions will respawn with full health and cooldowns.

 This mode will take place in a small arena with no minions, so you can focus on the fighting!

 And of course we had to add some proper theming to match Soul Fighter!

 Tag Duel will be available on July 21 at 00:01 UTC until August 7

 SOUL FIGHTER BOUNTY

 Everybody, let's make some noise for DRAAAVEN! The Soul Fighter Bounty is a promotion where you’ll have a chance to get Soul Fighter Draven (Special Edition)—even though Draven would probably argue that all of his skins are “special edition.” To participate you’ll need to purchase boxes that will cost 400 Wild Cores a piece. Cooldown: 11/10/9/8s → 12/11/10/9s

Healing effect: 70/110/150/190 + 70% Ability Power → 50/85/120/155 + 55% Ability Power
Soraka’s performance and how players have utilized her abilities hasn’t been optimal. So we’re making some adjustments to make her ap-peel-ing and perform better in games!
[NEW]: Cooldown will be reduced when it hits enemy champions.

Cooldown: 5/4/3/2s → 6/5/4/3s

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 RUNES

 We’ve heard a lot of feedback that you all want more from runes, so we’ve re-designed the rune system to give you more options! We hope this new system gives you more room to explore runes and experiment your build paths on champions. And if you don’t want to experiment or cook up your own rune path, you can also choose to use the general guaranteeing minimum runes that we put at the first row at any time.

 [NEW] GLACIAL AUGMENT

 Attack slows enemy champions by 20% for 1.5 seconds. For the same champion, the slowdown triggers only once every 10 seconds.

 Immobilizing an enemy will trigger 3 glacial rays to emanate from them towards you and this enemy champion, creating icy zones that last for 3 seconds.

 Enemies in icy zones are slowed (1% bonus health of carrier +20%), and their damage is reduced by 15% against your allies. The slowdown effect will last for 1.5 seconds after leaving the icy zone. (20 seconds cooldown)

 [NEW] FIRST STRIKE

 In 0.25 seconds of entering a battle against enemy champions, damage caused on enemy will grant 5 gold and first strike effect lasting 3 seconds, which makes you deal bonus 9% true damage on enemy. After the effect, gold from the effect duration time will be granted (melee 100%/ ranged attack 85%). (20-13 seconds cooldown)

 [NEW] LAST STAND

 Extra 5-11% adaptive damage against enemy champions when health is lower than 60%.

 Maximum bonus damage will be provided when health is lower than 30%.

 [NEW] LEGEND: ALACRITY

 Gain 3% Attack Speed; when engaging in taking down monsters, enemy champions and minions, up to bonus 20% at maximum stacks.

 [NEW] LEGEND: TENACITY

 Gain 3% tenacity and 3% slow resist, up to bonus 15% tenacity and 20% slow resist when engaging in taking down monsters, enemy champions and minions.

 [NEW] LEGEND: BLOODLINE

 Gain 1% omnivamp, up to bonus 7% of omnivamp when engaging in taking down monsters, enemy champions and minions.

 [NEW] LEGEND: SHIELD BASH

 After gaining shield or heal, the next attack against the enemy will be reinforced and deal bonus 5 - 30 + 20% Bonus Attack Damage +10% Adaptive Ability Power. (7 seconds cooldown)

 [NEW] MARK OF THE WEAK

 Using abilities to deal damage to enemies will mark them as weak, increasing damage taken by them by 4 - 7%, the mark disappears after they take ability damage 3 times or after 7 seconds have passed. (20 seconds cooldown)

 [NEW] EMPOWERED ATTACK

 Every 10 seconds, the next attack will be reinforced, dealing 35 - 50 bonus adaptive damage.

 [NEW] CHEAP SHOT

 Deals 10 - 45 bonus true damage to enemies whose movement is impaired. (7 seconds cooldown)

 [NEW] EYEBALL COLLECTOR

 Gains 0.5 Attack Damage or Ability Power when an enemy is taken down, up to 10 stacks, and gains a bonus 10 Attack Damage or 20 Ability Power reaching 10 stacks.

 [NEW] INGENIOUS HUNTER

 20 Item ability haste. Gains a bonus 4 item ability haste when an enemy is taken down. Stacks up to 5 times.

 [NEW] ZOMBIE WARD

 After removing an enemy ward, spawns a zombie ward in its place, granting vision of the surrounding area for 120 seconds. Also gains 2 Attack Damage or 4 Ability Power. Stacks up to 5 times. Gives a bonus 10 Attack Damage or 20 Ability Power upon reading 5 stacks.

 [NEW] COURAGE OF THE COLOSSUS

 Gains a shield that absorbs up to 25-45+1% max health for 3 seconds when immobilizing an enemy. (10 seconds cooldown)

 [NEW] REVITALIZE

 Gains a 5% amplification effect when casting heal or shield. If the target’s health is lower than 40%, amplifies its effect by an additional 10%.

 [NEW] OVERGROWTH

 When 1 monster or 2 minions are taken down nearby, gains permanent 2 max health. Max health can be increased infinitely. Gains bonus 3.5% max health upon reaching 30 stacks.

 [NEW] HEXTECH FLASTRAPTION

 Replaces Flash with Hex Flash when the Flash spell is still on cooldown. You can blink to a new location after channeling for 3 seconds. (20 seconds of cooldown)

 [NEW] ITEM CRAFTING

 Gains a chance to buy 1 item outside of the fountain every 3 minutes but it will cost 150 bonus gold.

 [NEW] COUP DE GRACE

 When an enemy has less than 40% health, deals 7% bonus adaptive damage.

 [NEW] FUTURE’S MARKET

 You can purchase items on credit. Credit limit: 145+7/minutes. Credit purchase is available 2 minutes in game.

 [NEW] NULLIFYING ORB

 Shield: 60 + 50% bonus Attack Damage + 30% Ability Power → 60 - 190 (with level up)

 FONT OF LIFE

 Team heal: 6% Maximum health + 30% Ability Power → 3% Maximum health + 15% your Ability Power

 Self heal: 2% Maximum health + 10% Ability Power → 1% Maximum health + 5% Ability Power

 TRIUMPH

 [OLD]: After participating in the defeat of an enemy champion, restore 10% of lost health, and deal an additional 5% damage to champions with less than 35% health → [NEW]: After participating in the defeat of an enemy champion, restore 10% of lost health, 10% of maximum mana and energy.

 ITEMS

 DUSKBLADE OF DRAKTHARR

 Nightstalker：

 [NEW]: First basic attack against an enemy champion causes 20 - 125 bonus physical damage and slows enemies by 99% for 0.25 seconds. Cooldown will be refreshed when an enemy has been taken down.

 [REMOVED]: Being unseen for 1 second causes your next basic attack against a champion to deal 20 - 125 bonus physical damage and slows them by 99% for 0.25 seconds. Buff lasts for 5 seconds if you are in the view of one enemy, and ranged attacks do not slow enemies.

 SUPPORT ITEM ADJUSTMENT

 This patch we want to offer support players some more items and also make sure the build paths are smoother while also providing them more support during the laning phase. To do this, we’ll be adding a new support item: Ancient Coin, and adjusting the effects of Spectral Sickle and Relic Shield. We’re also accelerating the upgrading speed of the quest items and giving the advanced support items a sustaining growing effect. This will give supports the flexibility to choose their items depending on the champions they pick, their individual play styles, and their lane matchups.

 ANCIENT COIN

 Price: 500g

 Stats:

 80 Health

 5 Ability haste

 Passive:

 Charge once per 30 seconds (max 3 charges). Every minion nearby taken down will grant 55 gold by consuming 1 charge, and regenerate 15-65 health. Champions equipped with Ancient Coin do not engage in minion bounty allocation and grant 50% of bounty solely, the bounty from minions taken down will be fully provided to the nearest ally. Grant only 50% gold from monsters.

 Quest:

 Transform to Talisman of Ascension after granting 500 gold.

 SPECTRAL SICKLE

 Price: 500g

 Versatile：

patches.title: Wild Rift Patch Notes 4.2b

championChanges.summary: Aatrox struggled to find his footing last patch and his blade is not cutting as deep as expected. We want to make sure that when the Darkin Blade is unleashed in all its grand and terrifying glory, that it strikes a deeper chord of dread in the hearts of foes, so we’re making an adjustment to its damage.

Our favorite frosty marksman has been frostbitten and stuck as a Baron Laner or support. So we’re honing her arrows and making some adjustments to her so that she can better fulfill her role as the chilling harbinger of damage in the Dragon Lane.
We’re boosting Camille's jungle clearing pace in the early stages of the game, to allow her more time to overshadow her laning opponents.
Draven's early-game damage was over the top, even outshining some of our fighters. We’re adjusting his Attack Damage while still ensuring that his axes keep their edge in team fights.

changes.text:
Attack Damage: 70 → 66
 Attack Damage per level: 4 → 4.5

championChanges.summary: We’re sharpening Fiora, the Grand Duelist’s fencing finesse, so that she can display speedier swordplay in the duels she takes versus her foes.

changes.text:
Cooldown: 14/12/10/8s → 12/10/8/6s
 Cooldown return on skill hit: 60% → 50%

championChanges.summary: Lately Fizz's performance in the Mid Lane has been fishy, and he needs a surge in his Ability Power. However, we don't want this buff to make Fizz a go-to pick in the jungle, so we’re slightly reducing his damage to monsters.

We’re doing a mini-rework to The Lady of Luminosity! These changes will go live July 6 PST, and while we’re still tweaking some of the numbers, we wanted to give you a high-level summary, before her update goes live! We’ll include all the number changes in our next set of Patch Notes.

changes.text: Previously Lux’s passive only allowed her to proc it on auto attacks, so we’re updating it so that Light Binding and Lucent Singularity will now also consume the passive mark and refresh it.
Light Binding can now move through minions. You’ll still deal damage to any minions you hit, it will just no longer bind them. Instead you will now snare the first two enemy champions hit.

Currently, Lux’s Lucent Singularity has two casts, the first when you throw it out, and the second whenever you decide to detonate it. We’re keeping the first cast the same, but changing the second. Now whenever any enemy stays or moves in the Lucent Singularity, it will automatically detonate.

championChanges.summary: In early-game jungle confrontations, this fawn is too fragile and can’t take the fights other junglers can. So, we’re bolstering her brawling ability and making her a more formidable opponent when engaging with enemy champions in the jungle.

We’ve missed seeing our favorite Yeti roaming through the jungle, and we think it's time we give Nunu and Willump a slight push to get them out of their icy hideaway and back onto the Rift where they can school enemies on the true might of a well-thrown snowball.

Ever since Olaf's rework, he's been swinging his axes with Freljordian power, and while there is a lot of power behind those swings, it’s still hard to master. We’re slightly reducing his damage but making it easier for him to pursue enemies with his ultimate.

championChanges.summary: Rammus is rolling too fast across the map, making his early-game ganks too efficient. We’re reducing his ganking power, but still keeping his identity as a physical damage nemesis.

Since arriving on the Rift, the Noxian Grand General has shown how strong in multiple lanes. We’re nerfing Swain's damage and survivability so that other champions don’t feel so helpless when they're up against this general and his ravens.

championChanges.summary: We want to bring marksmen back in-line after our bigger adjustments in previous patches, which have left some stronger than others. So, we’re amplifying Tristana's traits as a scaling marksman, but we’re also making her an easier target if she’s left to lane alone.

Vayne loves to daringly dance on the edge of fights, so we’re fine-tuning her skills to resonate with that high-risk, high-reward heroic gameplay she likes to lean on. In the earlier stages of the game, she should be honing her hunting skills and relying on her support, rather than venturing out alone.

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 ITEMS

 DEATH’S DANCE

 We’ve seen fighters struggling during this update, so we’re slightly increasing the sustainability of Death’s Dance to give a leg-up to those bold enough to wield it. And provide them with more opportunities to shine in the battle.

 Dance restore based on maximum health: 10% → 1 2%

 HULLBREAKER

 We want to make sure that Hullbreaker is a tactical choice for when you want to solo push a lane in your game, so we’re dialing down some of its early-game dueling potency. Rest assured though, if you pick up Hullbreaker you’ll still pack a powerful push when left unchallenged on the Rift.

 BOARDING PARTY

 RANDUIN’S OMEN

 Randuin’s Omen is a defensive item that's dedicated to reducing critical damage. We want to further amplify some of its unique strengths and increase its price.

 SERPENT’S FANG

 In the current meta, a lot of items and skills have shielding effects. So, we’re improving the cost-effectiveness of Serpent’s Fang so that it's a more favorable pick up in the earlier stages of the game and your builds!

 Stab armor penetration: 12 → 15

 YOUMUU’S GHOSTBLADE

 Youmuu’s Ghostblade is the starting item for a lot of champions, but it currently falls short when compared to some of the other items in the shop. We’re buffing up its stats to give it a competitive edge, while ensuring players can still pick it up before the first team fight.

patches.title: Wild Rift Patch Notes 4.2a

championChanges.summary: Akali has been struggling in the earlier stages of the game, especially when up against foes with longer range. We’re making some adjustments to help her survive during the laning phase while also giving her the ability to clear minion waves a little easier. We hope this help makes her early game smoother.

In the current Baron Lane meta, Darius is falling behind the pack. We’re lending this fighter a hand, and increasing his damage. But, we’re also reducing the amount of damage he can do to monsters so we can make sure this boost doesn’t push him into a different lane.

changes.text:
Bleed damage per stack: 11.5 - 31 → 14.5 - 34
 Damage to monsters: 200% → 150%

championChanges.summary: While we adjusted a lot of stats for marksmen last patch, we didn't make any adjustments to Ezreal’s base stats. We’re noticing that because of this he is falling slightly behind other marksmen, so we’ve mapped out some buffs that we think will help this explorer out.

changes.text:
Attack Damage per level: 3.6 → 4
 Base attack speed: 20% → 30%

championChanges.summary: We’ve seen Galio struggling in the current meta, so we’re reducing the cooldown on his ultimate so that he can make a grand entrance and peel for his teammates more often.

Due to some of the changes we made to items and runes, Gragas can now spam his third ability, Body Slam when he gains a lot of Ability Haste over the course of the game. Because of this, we’re adding a new rule to this ability so that we can prevent him from slamming into you over and over and well…over again without any cooldown.

changes.text: [NEW] Cooldown: Will always have a minimum cooldown of 1.25s.

championChanges.summary: Last patch we made adjustments to crit across the board and also adjusted Grave’s base critical strike damage. In doing this, it ended up weakening Graves way more than we expected, even with the new items. So we’re reverting the changes we made last patch to adjust this.

changes.text:
Crit: 6 bullets, 120% damage each → 6 bullets, 130% damage each
 Crit with Infinity Edge: 6 bullets, 130% damage each → 6 bullets, 140% damage each

championChanges.summary: Jhin has been per-four-ming too strongly, especially in lower levels of play, so we want to cut back on some of his damage so that he’s not such a menace during fights. We’re also going to increase the movement speed Jhin’s passive grants him so that there is still room for players in higher levels to outplay their opponents.

changes.text:
Attack Damage bonus: 5% per level → 4% per level
 Movement bonus crit ratio: 10% → 15%

championChanges.summary: After our adjustments to Kai’Sa last patch she is one of the strongest carries, by far. We’re tuning back some of her base stats to bring her more in line with her fellow marksmen, and also making some adjustments to her ability to kill jungle monsters so efficiently.

changes.text:
Attack Damage bonus: 130% → 110%
 Ability Power bonus: 70% → 60%

championChanges.summary: Our adjustments to marksmen last patch make it more difficult for Shadow Assassin Kayn to recharge and transform. However, once he does manage to transform into this form it's still an uphill battle, because his abilities aren’t strong enough to target and kill opponents with longer range. So, we’ve adjusted his transformation efficiency and increased his damage across the board.

changes.text:
Energy required for transformation: 8000 → 7000
 Energy gained from damaging ranged champions: 18 → 24
 Energy gained taking down ranged champions: 90 → 120
 Shadow Assassin bonus damage: 38 - 52% → 44 - 56%

Mana cost: 80 → 50
 Bonus Attack Damage ratio: 40% → 50%

championChanges.summary: Our previous adjustments seemed to have squashed this bug, so we’re back to give him some more damage to help with his jungle clears and ganks.
Master Yi hasn’t been performing well in higher levels of play. We’re improving his jungle clear speed and giving him room to use his abilities to dodge damage from foes more often in teamfights.

Miss Fortune hasn’t been a viable pick in higher levels of play, even after our adjustments last patch. We also feel the new items don’t suit her as well as they do everyone else, so we’re giving her some love and increasing some of her damage.

changes.text: Bonus damage when attacking a new target: 44% - 100% Attack Damage → 49% - 105% Attack Damage

championChanges.summary: Pantheon is struggling across the board and has been having a hard time finding his place on the Rift. To help The Unbreakable Spear out, we’re making his spear stronger and giving him some more mana so he can cast it more throughout the game.

changes.text:

 Mortal Will bonus Attack Damage ratio: 110% → 120%
 Cooldown return on not releasing: 50% → 60%
Spear damage bonus Attack Damage ratio: 110% → 120%

championChanges.summary: Pyke has been having a hard time finding a way to enter fights in the later stages of the game since he's on the squishier side. We’re slightly increasing his resistances and damage so that we can help improve his performance in the late game.

changes.text:
Armor per level: 4.3 → 5
 Magic resist per level: 1.6 → 2.5
Stored damage cap: 60% Health and 140 + 800% the lower value of the bonus Attack Damage → 65% Health and 160 + 800% the lower value of the bonus Attack Damage

championChanges.summary: While we’re still sett-ling in from the changes last patch, we’ve been feeling like this brawler's punches aren’t packing enough punch, so we’re giving him some more damage.

changes.text: Right hook bonus damage: Level 5 + 50% Bonus Attack Damage → Level 7 + 50% Bonus Attack Damage
Ability damage: (25% + 0.2% Bonus Attack Damage) of Grit consumption → (25% + 0.25% Bonus Attack Damage) of Grit consumption

championChanges.summary: Sneaky sneaky! Twitch uses stealth…it’s very effective! This rat has been ambushing opponents left and right from the jungle and it’s a little strong. So we’re reducing some of his jungle and gank effectiveness.

changes.text: Movement speed bonus when not detected by enemy champions: 30% → 20%

championChanges.summary: While Urgot crab walked his way onto the Rift, he’s been struggling to hit his stride, so we’re lending him a hand… we mean claw and increasing some of his damage.
The ability that Varus has to execute foes is too high, so we’re decreasing some of his burst damage.

changes.text: Blight Detonation damage: (4.5/5/5.5/6% + 0.02% Ability Power) Maximum health → (4/4.5/5/5.5% + 0.01% Ability Power) Maximum health

championChanges.summary: Vayne doesn’t rely on crit as much as other marksmen do, so she didn’t benefit much from our changes last patch. And since the strength of marksmen have increased overall, we’re going to give some buffs to Vayne’s stats to put her on the same level as everyone else.

changes.text:

textBlocks: Hot off our big marksmen update we’ve got some balance changes, the arrival of two titan brothers, the return of the leaderboard event, and some new skins! Welcome to Patch 4.2a!

Un bear ably wild—Welcome to Patch 4.2a!

 We’re hot off our big update to marksmen and have loved seeing all your new builds, experimentations, and clips! However, we’ve seen that some champions have been toeing the line and been benefiting way too much from our updates, so we’re here with some balance adjustments. We also have the release of two titans: Ornn and Volibear. They have a bit of history, so watch out as there's a chance a nemesis duel could trigger if you’re in a game with these two! We’ve also got the return of the leaderboard event and some fun new skins!

 Good luck in your games and we’ll see you here soon for Patch 4.2b!

 * Please note that some of the changes to Gragas and Kai’Sa will not appear in-game, but they are live. The updates to in-game text strings will come in a following patch

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 ORNN, THE FIRE BELOW THE MOUNTAIN

 Ornn is the Freljordian demi-god of forging and craftsmanship. He works in the solitude of a massive smithy, hammered out from the lava caverns beneath the volcano Hearth-Home. There he stokes bubbling cauldrons of molten rock to purify ores and fashion items of unsurpassed quality. When other deities—especially Volibear—walk the earth and meddle in mortal affairs, Ornn arises to put these impetuous beings back in their place, either with his trusty hammer or the fiery power of the mountains themselves.

 Ornn will be released on June 20 at 00:01 UTC.

 VOLIBEAR, THE RELENTLESS STORM

 To those who still revere him, the Volibear is the storm made manifest. Destructive, wild, and stubbornly resolute, he existed before mortals walked the Freljord’s tundra, and is fiercely protective of the lands that he and his demi-god kin created. Cultivating a deep hatred of civilization and the weakness it brought with it, he now fights to return to the old ways—when the land was untamed, and blood spilled freely—and eagerly battles all who oppose him, with tooth, claw, and thundering domination.

 Volibear will be released on June 20 at 00:01 UTC.

 EVENTS

 FORGE & FURY

 Will you make it to the top of the leaderboard?

 Forge & Fury will begin on June 20 at 00:01 UTC

 JOIN THE FLUFT DEMACIA

 Gear up to go on another adventure with everyone's favorite fluffy friends!

 Join the Fluft Demacia will begin on June 22 at 00:01 UTC

Akali has been struggling in the earlier stages of the game, especially when up against foes with longer range. We’re making some adjustments to help her survive during the laning phase while also giving her the ability to clear minion waves a little easier. We hope this help makes her early game smoother.
Base armor: 30 → 34

In the current Baron Lane meta, Darius is falling behind the pack. We’re lending this fighter a hand, and increasing his damage. But, we’re also reducing the amount of damage he can do to monsters so we can make sure this boost doesn’t push him into a different lane.

Bleed damage per stack: 11.5 - 31 → 14.5 - 34
 Damage to monsters: 200% → 150%

While we adjusted a lot of stats for marksmen last patch, we didn't make any adjustments to Ezreal’s base stats. We’re noticing that because of this he is falling slightly behind other marksmen, so we’ve mapped out some buffs that we think will help this explorer out.

Attack Damage per level: 3.6 → 4
 Base attack speed: 20% → 30%
We’ve seen Galio struggling in the current meta, so we’re reducing the cooldown on his ultimate so that he can make a grand entrance and peel for his teammates more often.

Due to some of the changes we made to items and runes, Gragas can now spam his third ability, Body Slam when he gains a lot of Ability Haste over the course of the game. Because of this, we’re adding a new rule to this ability so that we can prevent him from slamming into you over and over and well…over again without any cooldown.
[NEW] Cooldown: Will always have a minimum cooldown of 1.25s.

Last patch we made adjustments to crit across the board and also adjusted Grave’s base critical strike damage. In doing this, it ended up weakening Graves way more than we expected, even with the new items. So we’re reverting the changes we made last patch to adjust this.

Crit: 6 bullets, 120% damage each → 6 bullets, 130% damage each
 Crit with Infinity Edge: 6 bullets, 130% damage each → 6 bullets, 140% damage each

Jhin has been per-four-ming too strongly, especially in lower levels of play, so we want to cut back on some of his damage so that he’s not such a menace during fights. We’re also going to increase the movement speed Jhin’s passive grants him so that there is still room for players in higher levels to outplay their opponents.

Attack Damage bonus: 5% per level → 4% per level
 Movement bonus crit ratio: 10% → 15%

After our adjustments to Kai’Sa last patch she is one of the strongest carries, by far. We’re tuning back some of her base stats to bring her more in line with her fellow marksmen, and also making some adjustments to her ability to kill jungle monsters so efficiently.
Base attack speed: 30% → 20%
[NEW] Damage factor to monsters: 50%

Attack Damage bonus: 130% → 110%
 Ability Power bonus: 70% → 60%

Our adjustments to marksmen last patch make it more difficult for Shadow Assassin Kayn to recharge and transform. However, once he does manage to transform into this form it's still an uphill battle, because his abilities aren’t strong enough to target and kill opponents with longer range. So, we’ve adjusted his transformation efficiency and increased his damage across the board.

Energy required for transformation: 8000 → 7000
 Energy gained from damaging ranged champions: 18 → 24
 Energy gained taking down ranged champions: 90 → 120
 Shadow Assassin bonus damage: 38 - 52% → 44 - 56%
Bonus Attack Damage ratio: 120% → 130%

Mana cost: 80 → 50
 Bonus Attack Damage ratio: 40% → 50%
Our previous adjustments seemed to have squashed this bug, so we’re back to give him some more damage to help with his jungle clears and ganks.
Master Yi hasn’t been performing well in higher levels of play. We’re improving his jungle clear speed and giving him room to use his abilities to dodge damage from foes more often in teamfights.
Attack Damage: 52 → 54

Miss Fortune hasn’t been a viable pick in higher levels of play, even after our adjustments last patch. We also feel the new items don’t suit her as well as they do everyone else, so we’re giving her some love and increasing some of her damage.
Base Attack Damage: 52 → 54
Bonus damage when attacking a new target: 44% - 100% Attack Damage → 49% - 105% Attack Damage

Pantheon is struggling across the board and has been having a hard time finding his place on the Rift. To help The Unbreakable Spear out, we’re making his spear stronger and giving him some more mana so he can cast it more throughout the game.

Base mana: 390 → 420
 Base mana regeneration: 9 → 12

Bonus Attack Damage ratio: 110% → 120%
 Mortal Will bonus Attack Damage ratio: 110% → 120%
 Cooldown return on not releasing: 50% → 60%
Spear damage bonus Attack Damage ratio: 110% → 120%

Pyke has been having a hard time finding a way to enter fights in the later stages of the game since he's on the squishier side. We’re slightly increasing his resistances and damage so that we can help improve his performance in the late game.

Armor per level: 4.3 → 5
 Magic resist per level: 1.6 → 2.5
Stored damage cap: 60% Health and 140 + 800% the lower value of the bonus Attack Damage → 65% Health and 160 + 800% the lower value of the bonus Attack Damage
Execute threshold: 250/375/500 → 250/400/550
While we’re still sett-ling in from the changes last patch, we’ve been feeling like this brawler's punches aren’t packing enough punch, so we’re giving him some more damage.
Right hook bonus damage: Level 5 + 50% Bonus Attack Damage → Level 7 + 50% Bonus Attack Damage
Ability damage: (25% + 0.2% Bonus Attack Damage) of Grit consumption → (25% + 0.25% Bonus Attack Damage) of Grit consumption

Sneaky sneaky! Twitch uses stealth…it’s very effective! This rat has been ambushing opponents left and right from the jungle and it’s a little strong. So we’re reducing some of his jungle and gank effectiveness.
Monster damage modification: 170% → 130%
Movement speed bonus when not detected by enemy champions: 30% → 20%
Damage factor to monsters: 170% → 130%
While Urgot crab walked his way onto the Rift, he’s been struggling to hit his stride, so we’re lending him a hand… we mean claw and increasing some of his damage.
On-hit effect ratio: 50% → 70%
Bonus Attack Damage ratio: 50% → 70%
The ability that Varus has to execute foes is too high, so we’re decreasing some of his burst damage.
Blight Detonation damage: (4.5/5/5.5/6% + 0.02% Ability Power) Maximum health → (4/4.5/5/5.5% + 0.01% Ability Power) Maximum health

Vayne doesn’t rely on crit as much as other marksmen do, so she didn’t benefit much from our changes last patch. And since the strength of marksmen have increased overall, we’re going to give some buffs to Vayne’s stats to put her on the same level as everyone else.

Base attack speed: 20% → 30%
 Attack speed per level: 2.2% → 3.2%
With the addition of the new items, we’ve seen Yone become an unstoppable force in the jungle, so we’re slashing some of his power.
Maximum damage to monsters: 80 - 290 → 30 - 280

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 ITEMS

 BLOODTHIRSTER

 After adding a Shieldbow and some other new vamp items, the amount of vamp Bloodthirster grants is too high, so we’re making some adjustments to its stats.

 Stats: 50 Attack Damage → 55 Attack Damage

 Bloody: 15% Physical vamp → 12% Physical vamp

 ESSENCE REAVER

 Our adjustments to Essence Reaver last patch did not meet our goals, so we’re adjusting its value some more. We hope these changes make it a more desirable pick up in the earlier stages of the game.

 Essence Flare cooldown: 6s → 4s

 Ability Damage ratio: Crit rate × 30% → 20% + Crit rate × 10%

 IMMORTAL SHIELDBOW

 Similarly to Bloodthirster, when Shieldbow is paired with other vamp items, the amount of vamp a player can end up stacking is too high. In addition to this, the shield that this item grants some champions like Yasuo and Yone is too high. So we’re reducing its vamp and shield power.

 Lifeline shield value: 200 + 5 Points per 1% crit rate → 200 + 3 Points per 1% crit rate (200-500)

 Battle Furor physical vamp: 10% → 5%

 PHANTOM DANCER

 When picked up as a first item, Phantom Dancer has proven to be too strong. So we’re increasing its cost and lowering how much attack speed it grants.

 Additional cost: 400g → 500g

 Total cost: 2900g → 3000g

 Spectral Waltz bonus attack speed: 30% → 25%

 SYSTEM CHANGES

 RIFT HERALD

 After reducing the overall health of turrets last patch, Rift Herald has too many benefits for whoever summons it, especially if there isn’t anyone defending the enemy turret. So we’ve made sure that Rift Herald is guaranteed to die when hitting the second turret.

 Health loss on charge: Current health level × 70% → 70% of the Current health or 30% of the maximum health, the higher of the two

textBlocks: This patch we’ve got our bows and arrows ready and are envisioning our way to a chilly victory…with soda pop for the reward! We’ve got the long awaited marksman update, Swain, Ice Dragon, the arrival of a new Wild Pass, and more!

Chill out—Welcome to Patch 4.2!

 This patch we’ve got our bows and arrows ready and are envisioning our way to a chilly victory…with soda pop for the reward! We’ve got the long awaited marksman update, Swain, Ice Dragon, the arrival of a new Wild Pass, and more!

 This is just the first update during the Playhem patch, check out our Patch Preview to see what else is still in store. See ya in patch 4.2a!

Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 SWAIN, THE NOXIAN GRAND GENERAL

 Jericho Swain is the visionary ruler of Noxus, an expansionist nation that reveres only strength. Though he was cast down and crippled in the Ionian wars, his left arm severed, he seized control of the empire with ruthless determination… and a new, demonic hand. Now, Swain commands from the front lines, marching against a coming darkness that only he can see—in glimpses gathered by shadowy ravens from the corpses all around him. In a swirl of sacrifice and secrets, the greatest secret of all is that the true enemy lies within.

 Swain will be released on May 26 at 00:01 UTC.

 ICE DRAGON

 It's time to chill out with the arrival of Ice Dragon! You can read more about Ice Dragon from our gameplay team here, but below is a quick summary of what this frigid beast will bring to your games:

 Slaying Ice Dragon will granting you Ability Haste.

 If Ice Dragon is the first dragon to spawn and be defeated in the game, Elemental Rift will transform and spawn Icy Paths, which will grant you movement speed.

 When the Ice Dragon is killed and the map transforms, the Cryoblossom will appear. After hitting the Cryoblossom and striking an enemy, it will apply a stasis effect to your foe.

 During the freezing time, the frozen enemy champion cannot be targeted and is immune to damage. Only enemy champions can be hit by this effect.

 WILD PASS

 Our cola-est Wild Pass skin yet—Soda Pop Ahri is here! She’s so-darn cute and you’ll earn tons of new goodies as you sip your way through the pass. If you want another flavor, you can also pick up the so-delightful Ascended version from the Wild Pass Emporium!

 The Wild Pass will be available on May 26 at 00:01 UTC

 HOMESCREEN CUSTOMIZATION

 We’re launching a new feature this patch called Atmosphere! It will allow you to pick any splash to customize your homescreen with! We’re picking our girl Sona, and can’t wait to admire her pretty splash art while we wait to play. Let us know what splash you’ll be picking and what you think about this new feature!

 BUTTON CUSTOMIZATION

 If you couldn’t tell we’re all about the aesthetics this patch. And like we mentioned, starting this patch we’re going to offer you the ability to change up your buttons to match more your style! We’ll be launching one for Battle Academia, and a departure/platinum button skin to start and you can obtain both of them from the collection system!

 HEXTECH CRAFTING

 Hextech Crafting is the new permanent feature we announced that will give collectors a new way to obtain unique skins, chromas, some of their favorite skins, and older skins that they have missed at the first pass! It’s launching this patch along with Iconic Garen! What can we say, he’s an icon, he’s a legend, and he is getting his moment to shine with the launch of this new system!

 For all the information regarding Hextech Crafting you can read our previous article here , or check out the Player Support article here ! We know this system is bringing a lot of new changes, so you can additionally reach out to our Player Support team to answer any questions you may have!

 EVENTS

 WILD PUZZLE

 Hmmm…this piece goes here? Well. Wait. No. It goes there! Uh…we’re not sure, hopefully you’ll be better at this wild puzzle than us!

 Wild Puzzle will begin on May 26 at 00:01 UTC

 PRIDE 2023

 It's almost June, and Pride is in the cards, you can learn more about in-game activations across Runeterra in the coming weeks!

 Pride 2023 event will begin on June 01 at 00:01 UTC

 INFINITY EDGE

 MURAMANA

 We’re reworking Muramana so that we can expand its user base to all Attack Damage champions who cast abilities.

 [NEW] Passive

When dealing skill damage to an enemy champion, consume 4% of current mana and cause additional physical damage of consumption +6% AD. This effect will only trigger when remaining mana is above 20%. A single skill can only be triggered once for the same champion.

 NASHOR’S TALON

 This is a new component for Nashor’s Tooth and will help make that item available for a wider range of champions.

 Price: 800g

 NASHOR’S TOOTH

 Similar to Essence Reaver, Nashor’s Tooth has only been a viable pick up for a select few champions. We want to expand who all can pick this item up, so we’re making some adjustments so that this item can be a viable option for some caster marksmen builds.

 NOONQUIVER

 STORMRAZOR

 Similar to Immortal Shieldbow, we wanted to make sure that Attack Damage players had some more options for early-to-mid-game items that would give them a little extra oomph in damage. We’re reducing the cost of its components so you don’t have to kill as many minions before you pick them up.

 THE COLLECTOR

 This patch we’re removing Hunter - Genius, since it isn’t a go-to rune in a lot of player builds. It also is not performing as well as we like, so we’re introducing a new rune to fill its spot that we think will be used by more champions, especially ones who use their abilities more frequently.

championChanges.summary: Aatrox’s late game kiting and crowd control abilities are too powerful, so we’ve come for him with our nerf blade!

The good Doctor has been struggling in higher levels of play, where players are better at playing around his passive. So, we’re shifting some of its power into his ultimate to make sure Mundo gets the maximum value out of Maximum Dosage.

changes.text:
Loss of current health when being immobilized: 7% → 3%
 Restore Dr. Mundo's health when picking up a chemical canister: 8% → 4%

Health gained: 15/20/25% Missing health → 25/30/35% Missing health
 Health regeneration: 20/40/60% of Maximum health → 15/35/55% of Maximum health

championChanges.summary: Despite Lee Sin’s fearsome reputation on the Rift, his win rate has been consistently low. To lend him a hand, we’re giving him a boost to his base damage which will make those early jungle clears feel smoother.

Nasus’ final form is looking too strong with Amaranth’s Twinguard. To make things a little less ruff for his opponents, we’re nerfing some of his late game power, and giving a slight buff to his early game to compensate.

After our recent round of buffs, we saw that we went too far and gave Pyke too much power, so we’re continuing to pull back on some of his power in the jungle and Mid Lane and moving it to his supportive assets.

changes.text:
With two or more enemy champions nearby, stored damage ratio: 45% + 0.65% × Fixed armor penetration → 50% + 0.65% × Fixed armor penetration
 Stored damage cap: The lower number of 60% maximum health and 80+8 × Additional Attack Damage → The lower number of 60% maximum health and 140+8 × Additional Attack Damage
With ally assists or when an ally kills the enemy champion within the X mark, Pyke gets a percentage of the kill gold: 120% → 140%

championChanges.summary: Compared to Rakan’s team-focused support build, AP Rakan has been flying high and getting all the limelight. We’re nerfing his damage so we can bring the two builds closer together.

We’ve noticed that Tryndamere has been struggling in the earlier stages of the laning phase compared to his fellow fighters in the Baron Lane. We’re increasing his base Attack Damage, which we hope helps him in those early lane skirmishes.

While Vi’s “punch first, ask questions while punching” attitude makes her a fearsome foe to encounter while you’re in the jungle alone, she lacks that same fighting power in teamfights. So, we’re giving her a buff to her cooldown speed which will provide her more displacement possibilities in team fights.
Compared to other junglers, Xin Zhao is struggling, so we're giving him some overall buffs to help him out.

You know that we love Zoe around here and want to see her win, we’ve only said it like a zillion times. However, as much as we love this bubbly, sparkly mage, she is still too much of a powerhouse in the Mid Lane, so we’re nerfing her damage across the board.

textBlocks: Sneaky Sneaky—Welcome to Patch 4.1b! Twitch arrives on the Rift, Ranked S9 is here, and we’re celebrating Nova Esports Icons win!

Sneaky Sneaky—Welcome to Patch 4.1b!

 Ahoy mateys! This patch we’ve got lots of updates ashore in store! Everyone’s favorite smelly rat has finally sneaked his way onto the Rift! He’s ready to bring the pain, and search for any moldy sandwiches… so keep an eye out.

 It’s also time for a new Ranked season and of course a new skin to earn during your climb! Along with the new season we also have a few updates to the highest tiers.

 And finally, we’re celebrating Nova Esports and their Icons 2022 win, with the launch of the Nova skinline! We hope using the Nova Morgana skinline will help us actually land a bind or two. Congratulations to them again!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW

 NEW CHAMPIONS

 TWITCH, THE PLAGUE RAT

 A Zaunite plague rat by birth, but a connoisseur of filth by passion, Twitch is not afraid to get his paws dirty. Aiming a chem-powered crossbow at the gilded heart of Piltover, he has vowed to show those in the city above just how filthy they really are. Always a sneaky sneak, when he’s not rooting around in the Sump, he’s digging deep into other people’s garbage for discarded treasures… and perhaps a moldy sandwich.

 Twitch will be released on April 20 at 00:01 UTC.

 RANKED SEASON 9

 It’s time for a new ranked season! Are you ready to climb to the top again? Or have you set a new goal to reach? Regardless of your plans, we wish you the best of luck as you set sail on your journey! And as you climb, Glorious Armada Twisted Fate will be your award for exploring the marvelous new seas of this ranked season!

 In addition to the new Ranked skin, as a reminder we also have a few changes for the highest tier in Season 9. Promotion to Grandmaster will now require 40 Marks. This means the number of marks required to be in that will stay the same throughout the season, rather than changing based on the top percent of players in your server.

 Also, with these adjustments to promote to Challenger you will need at least 60 Marks, up from 40 in previous seasons. We’ll continue to keep a close eye on how the Grandmaster adjustments will affect the distribution of top players in Ranked, and we’ll have more changes to come in Season 10!

 Ranked Season 9 will be begin on April 19 7:00 PM PST.

 LEGENDARY QUEUE

 A new season of Legendary Queue is also right around the corner, and we’re also making a few adjustments for the upcoming season:

 You will now need to reach Master (previously Diamond IV) to unlock Legendary Queue.

 You must maintain Diamond IV+ to continue queueing.

 If you drop below Diamond IV , you will be unable to queue up for Legendary Queue.
 The mastery score requirement has been raised from 400 to 1000.

Unleash Chemtech power—Welcome to Patch 4.1!

 We’re crab walking our way onto the Rift, as Urgot is joining the fray this patch! But beware, while he looks kinda like a crab (squint your eyes and you’ll see it just like us, promise), he’s actually a lean, green, killing machine with a whole lotta chemtech power that he’s ready to unleash.

 But have no fear, Superhero Vi is here! She’ll help you fight off the chemtech power or any other baddies that try to get in your way. We also are uncapping the leveling system this patch, so once you hit level 40 you’ll unlock a prestige level system, where additional levels will give you stars that are showcased in your profile and other visible areas! We can’t wait to see all your stars showcased on your profile!

 At the start of 4.0, we made some changes to our beefy friends in Baron Lane, and gave them some new items. However, this patch we’re continuing that and giving tanks some more item choices and updates in the shop, along with our regularly scheduled balance updates!

 This new content is just the start of what’s to come in Patch 4.1, to see what’s still in store, check out our latest Patch Preview:

Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.

 NEW
 NEW CHAMPIONS

 URGOT, THE DREADNOUGHT

 Once a powerful Noxian headsman, Urgot was betrayed by the empire for which he had killed so many. Bound in iron chains, he was forced to learn the true meaning of strength in the Dredge—a prison mine deep beneath Zaun. Emerging in a disaster that spread chaos throughout the city, he now casts an imposing shadow over its criminal underworld. Raising his victims on the very chains that once enslaved him, he will purge his new home of the unworthy, making it a crucible of pain.

 Urgot will be released on March 16 at 00:01 UTC.
 WILD PASS

 With all these villains on the loose it's about time another hero made an appearance to save the day or wreck it… Superhero Vi joins the fight this Wild Pass! You can earn her and the Ascended version as you punch your way through this Wild Pass!

 The Wild Pass will be available on March 16 at 00:01 UTC
 UNCAPPED LEVELS

 We’re changing how the account leveling system works. Hitting level 40 in Wild Rift is meant to be an important milestone, and since we’ve seen so many of you achieving it over the last year, we wanted to provide additional ways for you to feel and see the investment you’ve made in Wild Rift.

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 [NEW] MANTLE OF THE TWELFTH HOUR

Mantle of the Twelfth Hour grants a burst of healing, movement speed, and slow resistance when your health gets low to give tanks a fighting chance at escaping or running down one more kill.

 [NEW] AMARANTH TWINGUARD

Mages are able to pick up items like Rabadon’s Deathcap or Void Staff and Marksmen are able to buy Infinity Edge or Lord Dominik’s Regards. Amaranth Twinguard is a capstone item for tanks that allows them to multiply their effectiveness during combat as long as they can stick it out long enough to get the benefits of Endurance.

 [NEW] SHIMMERING SPARK

 Want to clear the jungle faster when playing a tank? If so, Shimmering Spark is the right item for you! It will increase your clear speed and grant you some tankiness!  Currently, Sunfire Aegis is the only choice for tanks that want to opt into more aggressive damage against champions. However, it also serves as the only tank item that offers meaningful wave- and jungle-clearing power, which puts it in a space where it’s serving two different niches at the same time.  Total cost: 3000g → 2700g

 FORCE OF NATURE

 [REMOVED] Current Absorb passive.
 [NEW] Passive: When receiving skill damage, you can get a 7-second firmness layer, which can be stacked up to 6 times; dealing damage to champions can refresh the duration of the layer. At 6 stacks, gain 10% movement speed and reduce all magic damage taken by 25%.

 We’re removing the generic magic damage amplification passive on Abyssal Mask in favor of a new passive that will allow it to store a percentage of magic damage taken, which can then be released as an explosion upon enemies when you immobilize a target. Boom!
 [REMOVED] Damage passive
 [NEW] Passive: When you take magic damage, gain 20% of the damage taken as remaining charges for 5 seconds. When you root an enemy Champion, consume your remaining charges to cause a 400 yard explosion near the first rooted target, dealing magic damage which is equal to the remaining charge.

 We’re making a few adjustments to Relic Shield to lend supports a hand. We know right now it can sometimes be hard to get an execute off on a minion, especially when the enemy marksmen keeps poking you, so we’re adjusting the threshold for when a minion is executed. We’re also making a few other quality of life updates for the item.

 Once the mid game hits, it can be hard to get off charges, so we’re making some adjustments so Spectral Sickle feels good, even after the earlier stages of the game.
 Charge cooldown: 10s → 15s
 Gold: 25g → 40g
 SYSTEM CHANGES
 INHIBITOR RESPAWN ADJUSTMENTS

 We’ve made some adjustments to inhibitors respawning and the countdown visual effects. Inhibitors will now no longer respawn after the 19 minute mark.
 JUNGLE MONSTER SPAWN ADJUSTMENTS

 We realized that the time in which each jungle monster is able to be attacked can have a difference of up to 2 seconds. If players choose a monster that is slow to spawn, then they can lose their early jungle farming advantage. So, we’re making some adjustments to how the spawns work.
 Shortened the difference between when jungle monsters first spawn and is able to be attacked.

 Cooldown: 18/16/14/12s → 16/14/12/10s
 Duration: 5s → 4s

Many Senna enjoyers have noted that Wild Rift’s Senna doesn’t have the Piercing Darkness slow that PC’s Senna has, this patch we’re solving that mist-ery. Since we were looking into buffing her, we’re adding this mechanic.
[NEW]: Enemies hit are slowed by 15% + 0.1% × Bonus Attack Damage + 0.06% × Ability Power for 0.75/1/1.25/1.5s

Compared to other Mid Laners in higher levels of play, Yasuo has been falling behind. To give players who have mastered The Unforgiven more room for skill expression, we’re now allowing the target immunity cooldown of Yasuo’s Sweeping Blade to scale with the level of the ability.
Target immunity cooldown: 8s → 8/7/6/5s

Players have spoken with their bans, and the bans say this cat is often off the table. Fur now, we’re reducing the effectiveness of Yuumi’s poke damage and some of the furr-ee value she gives to her attached ally to make playing against this feline less frustrating.

Enhanced current health damage: 1.5/3/4.5/6/7.5% → 2/3/4/5/6%
 Mana cost: 50 → 60
Passive adaptive force: 13/15/17/19% → 8/11/14/17%
Jungle Zed has been quietly dominating in higher levels of play. To slash down his ability to clear jungle camps, we’re reducing the damage Shadow Slash can deal to monsters.
[NEW]: Now deals 60% damage to monsters.

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 ITEMS

 BANSHEE’S VEIL

 Banshee’s Veil has been struggling to be that go to item for magic resistance, even in situations where the extra
 magic resistance should be good. So, we’re lowering the cost so that when you decide to deviate your build to opt in
 for more defense, your bank account doesn’t take as big of a hit.

 Total cost: 3000g → 2800g

 LOCKET ENCHANT

 Locket hasn’t felt as rewarding when compared to other enchants, even when you’re facing multiple magic damage
 threats where it should excel. So, we’re lowering its cost to help it compete with the other enchant options.

 Total cost: 800g → 500g

 RANDUIN’S OMEN

 Randuin’s Omen is not strong enough in its current state to compete with the other armor items, even when its
 anti-crit passive should be strong. So, to help it compete with the other options, we’re looking to increase the
 power of the anti-crit it has.

 Pre-mitigation critical strike damage gained as Determination: 12% (Melee)/8% (Ranged) → 16% (Melee)/10% (Ranged)

 SPIRIT VISAGE

 We previously held off on Spirit Visage buffs because we were planning on adding shielding amplification to its
 passive. Now that we’ve done that (in 4.0) and it’s still struggling, we’re giving it some raw power buffs.

 Ability Haste: 10 → 20

 Total cost: 2900g → 2800g

 RUNE CHANGES

 INSPIRATION: PATHFINDER

 Compared to the other choices in the Inspiration tree, Pathfinder hasn’t been a top pick, so we’re giving it a small
 buff to help it out.

 Regenerates missing health/mana per second: 1% → 1.5%

 RESOLVE: SECOND WIND

 Over time Second Wind has fallen off in power relative to other defensive rune options, with many players preferring
 to opt for more scaling or anti-burst options instead. We’re increasing the recovery from Second Wind to ensure it
 still has a place for champions that just need a little help getting through the lane.

 Missing health recovered over 5 seconds: 1.5% → 2%

 Missing health recovered over 5 seconds for melee: 3% → 4%

 SKINS

 Releasing February 17 @ 00:01 UTC

 Releasing February 17 @ 00:01 UTC

 PROJECT Renekton

 Releasing February 17 @ 00:01 UTC

 You can earn or purchase accessories from a bunch of different sources. Please check the relevant page in game for
 more information on how to get ‘em!

 Custom Recalls: RE/TURN

 All accessories will be released throughout the patch

textBlocks: We’re launching two new mechanics, base burning and inhibitor respawns as well as balance updates across the Rift! Welcome to Patch 4.0a!

Bases are burning and inhibitors are respawning—Welcome to Patch 4.0a!

 This patch we’re focusing on making adjustments to some champions that have been in need of a hand and to those that needed to be taken down a peg. We’re also launching base burning and inhibitor respawning, so there could be some new strategies and tactics that you try towards the later stages of your games. We know these are newer changes to the game, so we’ll be keeping a close eye on them and as always let us know what you think about them!

 Reminder: content will be released throughout the patch.
Aatrox continues to see strong win rates and high ban rates. To combat this, we’re reducing the healing he gains from his World Ender, which is one of his more frustrating strengths.
Increased Healing: 30/45/60% → 25/35/45%
Riff raff, street rats, scoundrels, take that! We know that chasing Scoundrels without mana is no fun, so we’re lending you a hand and giving you a little more to have.

Cooldown: 18/14/10/6s → 14/10/6/2s
 [NEW]: Gain 2% missing mana regen per second when chasing Scoundrels.
Support Ashe has been overperforming, so we’re shifting some of the power out of her Volley and into Ranger’s Focus. That way we can keep her role as a marksman on target.
Landing Rocket Grab is harder at higher levels of play, so we’re cranking up the movespeed after Overdrive’s acceleration decay.

Movement speed after the first acceleration decay: 10% → 25%
 Movement speed after the second acceleration decay: 25% → 50%
It’s Jungle O'clock! We’ve noticed that jungle Ekko’s clear speed has been lackluster, so it’s time for a buff.
Monster modification: 110% → 140%

While we’re happy with the performance of Darkin Slayer Kayn, Shadow Assassin Kayn is struggling to hold his own against his alter ego. We’re giving Shadow Assassin a handful of buffs to make the choice between this form and the Darkin Slayer form a meaningful one.

Shadow Assassin passive reset time: 6s → 5s
 Shadow Assassin passive bonus damage: 14%~42% → 32%~46%
 Increased the quantity of charges that Shadow Assassin receives when damaging ranged champions.
Shadow Assassin cooldown: 8s → 7s
Shadow Assassin range increased slightly
Lucian’s been under-target lately, so we’re making this marksman hit a little harder.

Mid Lux is in a good spot, but support Lux is in a bit of a bind. We’re shifting some of the power out of her Ability Power ratios and into her base damage to help, since the support role won’t have as much Ability Power.

Shield: 40/70/100/130 + 15% Ability Power → 40/75/110/145 + 10% Ability Power
 Return shield: 80/140/200/260 + 30% Ability Power → 80/150/220/290 + 20% Ability Power
Damage: 60/120/180/240 + 60% Ability Power → 65/130/195/260 + 55% Ability Power
Nautilus win rates have been floating up under the radar, so we’re anchoring it back down with some Dredge Line nerfs.
Rakan is still flying high despite recent nerfs, so we’re reducing the damage on Grand Entrance and increasing the cooldown of Battle Dance. This should ruffle some feathers.
Sett’s base Attack Damage is low especially when compared to other fighters, so we’re making him hit harder but slower. We want this boss to throw those heavy Haymakers, not fast jabs.

Base Attack Damage: 52 → 58
 Attack speed per level: 1.7% → 1.2%

Yone is on the strong side, and feedback from you all has been very clear that he’s extremely frustrating to play against in his current form. So, we’re slashing some of his waveclear and defensive capabilities to make sure that he exposes himself to proper risks.

Minimum damage to minions: 50~400 → 60~200
 Damage cap to monsters: 100~380 → 80~290
 Base shield: 40 + 70% bonus Attack Damage → 30 + 70% bonus Attack Damage
We’re big Zoe fans over here, and really hope she wins xd. But right now, she has a bug and those are no fun, so we’re fixing it this patch!
[BUG FIX] : Fixed an issue that prevented this ability from applying on-hit effects.

GAMEPLAY CHANGES

 ITEMS

 AWAKENED SOULSTEALER

 Now even more woke and giving you the refunds you deserve (unlike your upcoming taxes).

 Unique passive:

 Cooldown refund on kill: 20% → 25%

 HORIZON FOCUS

 We’ve been keeping a close eye on Horizon Focus and it looks like we’ve got some damage buffs on the horizon for this item.

 Unique passive:

 Damage: 80 + 20% Ability Power → 90 + 25% Ability Power

 LUDEN’S ECHO

 We feel that Luden’s Echo can use a little boost to help it stand out amongst the other Ability Power items so we’re giving it a bit more damage…damage…damage…

 Unique passive:

 Lightning damage: 100 + 10% Ability Power → 110 + 10% Ability Power

 SYSTEM

 BASE BURNING

 To limit turtling tactics in the later stages of the game and keep the overall length of games reasonable, we’re introducing the Base burning System. In the very late stages of the game, turrets will begin to burn, accelerating games to their conclusion.

 At 25 minutes the outermost turret in each lane loses 25 magic resistance and 25 armor and starts to lose 3% max health every 3 seconds.

 Inhibitor Turrets stop taking burning damage when their health drops below 25%.

 Base burning has no effect on the Nexus .

 INHIBITOR RESPAWN

 To provide more opportunities for interesting comebacks in the mid to late game, Inhibitors can now respawn. When an Inhibitor respawns, the respawned Inhibitor cannot deal damage to enemy units. Inhibitor respawn time scales up with game time, so losing an Inhibitor in the early stages of the game will have less of an impact while taking an enemy Inhibitor in the late game remains a powerful tactic to close out games.

 Inhibitors respawn after destruction based on game time.

 If an Inhibitor is destroyed within the first 13 minutes of the game, it respawns after 4 minutes .

 If an Inhibitor is destroyed between 13-18 minutes , it respawns after 5 minutes .

 If an Inhibitor is destroyed after 18 minutes , it respawns after 6 minutes .

 Respawned Inhibitors cannot attack.
